Kiswahili: Hakikisha bei nzuri kati ya vyama vya ushirika wa wakulima ni muhimu. Jifunze jinsi unavyoweza kutoa bei halisi zinazoweza kujadiliwa kwa nafaka zako na kujadili na wanunuzi wako.
Ekegusii: Tema kobeka rigori rigiya as abanyabiombe abwo bakogora rigesa riao buna ring'ana riengencho. Egera komanya buna oraikere rigori riabeene rierigesa riechinyke chiao riabeene na buna ogoaka rigori nabagori bao.
Somali: Hubinta qiimaha wanaagsan ee ururada iskaashatada beeraleyda waa muhiim. Baro sida ugu wanaagsan ee aad ugu bixin karto qiimo dhab ah oo la gorgortami karo oo la kala hadal la qaado iibsadayaashaada.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka inyalo chiwo nengo madier ma inyalo kwedo ne cham mipidho kendo wuo gi jolok ohala mari.

English: Lessons have been initiated to help small scale farmers to reach markets digitally for their produce.
Kiswahili: Masomo yameanzishwa ili kuwasaidia wakulima wadogo kufikia masoko kwa njia ya dijiti kwa ajili ya bidhaa zao.
Ekegusii: Okworokereria gwachakire gokonya abaremi bemegondo emeke gokera echiro goetera enchera yegedichitri koonia rigesa riabo.
Somali: Casharro ayaa la bilaabay si loo caawiyo beeraleyda yaryar inay si dijital ah suuqyada u gaaraan wax soo saarkooda.
Dholuo: Osetieko puonj mag konyo jopur matindo mondo ochop e ohala e yor digital mondo giyud olembe ma gigolo.

English: PSA is the new sales methd of avocado to markets abroad.
Kiswahili: PSA ni njia mpya ya mauzo ya avocado kwa masoko ya nje ya nchi.
Ekegusii: PSA nomoroberio omoyia bwokoonia afokado gochia echiro ya isiko .
Somali: PSA waa habka cusub ee loo iibiyo avocado suuqyada dibadda.
Dholuo: PSA en yo manyien mar ng'iewo avocado e pinje mamoko.

English: An association in Kenya (AMS) 2023-2032 focuses on the use of digital technology in improving productivity in markets for small scale farmers.
Kiswahili: Chama nchini Kenya (AMS) 2023-2032 kinazingatia matumizi ya teknolojia ya dijiti katika kuboresha tija katika masoko kwa wakulima wadogo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya ekio kerengete emeroberio yoboonia (AMS) 2023-2032 nkworokereria kere buna okoreng'ania obokoreri bwegedichitari na etekinorochia erio kwangoyia ogosoa echiro ase abaremi bemogondo emeke.
Somali: Urur ku yaal Kenya (AMS) 2023-2032 ayaa diiradda saaraya isticmaalka tiknoolajiyada dijitaalka ah ee kor u qaadista wax-soosaarka suuqyada ee beeraleyda yaryar.
Dholuo: Riwruok moro e piny Kenya (AMS) 2023-2032 jiwo tiyo gi teknoloji mar digital e medo nyak mar ohala e pinje mag jopur matindo.

English: Practice intercropping your maize foeld with banana stools to increase yields, reduce diseases as you expand a variety of harvests .
Kiswahili: Fanya mazoezi ya kula mahindi pamoja na mimea ya ndizi ili kuongeza mazao, punguza magonjwa unapopanua namna mbalimbali za mavuno .
Ekegusii: Rema ebituma amo namatoke amo (okoburukania) erio konyora rigesa rinene korwa omogondo oo, ekeanie amarwaire, na kogareia ebitoki korwa oboremi bwao.
Somali: Ku dhaqso inaad ku dhex darto goosashadaada hadhuudhka iyo foolalka baananka si aad u kordhiso wax soo saarka, yareyso cudurrada markaad ballaariso goosashada kala duwan.
Dholuo: Timuru kamano mondo umed pidho cham gi tong' mag olembe mondo umed nyak, kendo mondo umed thieth mag tuoche sama utimo dongruok e cham mopogore opogore.

English: Digital tools can bring a huge difference between small scale farmers and large scale farmers to attain transformative food crops.
Kiswahili: Zana za kidijitali zinaweza kuleta tofauti kubwa kati ya wakulima wadogo na wakulima wakubwa ili kupata mazao ya chakula yenye mabadiliko.
Ekegusii: Ebokoreri bwegechidichitari mbinyare koreta ogoonchororeria gati yabaremi bemegondo emeke naboigo abemegondo emene goikerania omoroberio oboererania bwendagera.
Somali: Qalabka dhijitaalka ah wuxuu farqi weyn ka dhigi karaa beeraleyda yaryar iyo beeraleyda waaweyn si loo gaaro dalagyo cunto oo isbedel ah.
Dholuo: Gik ma ji tiyogo e loso chiemo nyalo kelo pogruok maduong' e kind jopur matindo kod jopur madongo mondo giyud cham ma kelo lokruok.

English: Climate smart agriculture is one way to guard the relationship between farm manure as a means of food security and combart climate change.
Kiswahili: Kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa ni njia mojawapo ya kulinda uhusiano kati ya mbolea ya shamba kama njia ya usalama wa chakula na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Oboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura (CSA) nenchera erengete eyemo yokorenda oboamate bwemegondo obotobu bwemegondo yaito buna enchera eyemo yogoikerania omoigoto bwendagera naboigo gosegeta rire ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada caqli galka ah waa hal hab oo loo ilaaliyo xiriirka u dhexeeya bacriminta beeraha sida habka loo ilaaliyo amniga cuntada iyo la dagaalanka isbeddelka cimilada.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag timo pur ma nyiso rieko e wi lokruok mar alwora en yo achiel mar rito tudruok mantie e kind puothe mag puothe mag puothe kaka yo mar rito chiemo kendo kedo gi lokruok mar piny.

English: Guard your farm labourers and learn new ways of fair labour recruitment, provide a condusive environment and ensure their safety especially when spraying activities in the field.
Kiswahili: Walinde wafanyikazi wako wa shambani na ujifunze njia mpya za kuajiri wafanyikazi wa haki, toa mazingira mazuri na uhakikishe usalama wao haswa wakati wa kunyunyizia shughuli shambani.
Ekegusii: Renda nga obokoreri ase omogondo oo as okomanya chinchera chingiya chiokoarwa emeremo, korora nga ase emeremo egokorererwa nagaya, na korora nga baria bagokora emeremo mabri ase bokongu bonde bwensi ekero bagosiarera amache mogondo.
Somali: Ilaali shaqaalaha beerahaaga oo baro siyaabo cusub oo loo shaqaaleysiiyo shaqaale cadaalad ah, abuuro jawi wanaagsan oo hubiso badbaadooda gaar ahaan marka la buufiyo hawlaha beerta.
Dholuo: Rit jotich mag puodho kendo puonjri yore manyien mag yudo jotich e yo makare, mi ikonygi bedo gi ngima maber kendo ikonygi bedo gi ritruok, to moloyo sama itimo tij chwero.

English: Technology is in use in the production phases on crops and livestock. The goal is to discover agricultural technology applied in China compared to Kenya.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia inatumika katika awamu za uzalishaji wa mazao na mifugo. Lengo ni kugundua teknolojia ya kilimo inayotumika nchini China ikilinganishwa na Kenya.
Ekegusii: Tekinorochia yatumekire at ebitambokero bionsi ase ogokinia rigesa rioboremi amo na etugo. Ekerenga kia abatomwa nkeria ng'a baatanane oboremi bogokorwa aaria Chaina na tekinorochia bagotumia, erio barenge okobwekana neyaito aiga Kenya.
Somali: Tiknoolajiyada ayaa laga isticmaalaa marxaladaha wax-soo-saarka dalagyada iyo xoolaha. Hadafku waa in la ogaado tiknoolajiyada beeraha ee laga adeegsado Shiinaha marka loo eego Kenya.
Dholuo: Tekinoloji sani itiyogo e loso cham kod jamni.

English: In IFAD, this shows how digital agriculture needs to be put at bottom of the heart in our works. Whereas the poor of the world are surrounded by food scarcity.
Kiswahili: Katika IFAD, hii inaonyesha jinsi gani kilimo cha digital kinahitaji kuwekwa katika sehemu ya chini ya moyo wa kazi zetu, wakati maskini wa dunia wanazungukwa na upungufu wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Ase IFAD,eye nigo ekworokia egekogera obooremi bwegedicgitari boanetie kobekwa nkoro ase obokoreri bwaye. Buna abataka bense baonchokananire nenchara...
Somali: IFAD, tani waxay muujinaysaa sida beeraha dijitaalka ah loo baahan yahay in qalbiga hoose lagu dhigo shaqadeena. Halka dadka saboolka ah ee dunida ay ku wareegsan yihiin cunto yari.
Dholuo: E wi mano, e riwruok mar IFAD, mano nyiso kaka tijwa onego oriw lwedo ahinya tij chwoyo ji e yore mag digital, to joma odhier e piny ngima to yudo chiemo manok.

English: A robust plan embracing climate smart agriculture and climate change, be awarded government grants. To attain this CSA policy on agriculture align farming with climate chang8e resilient crops..
Kiswahili: Mpango thabiti unaokumbatia kilimo cha hali ya hewa na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, pewa ruzuku za serikali. Ili kufikia sera hii ya CSA juu ya kilimo, oanisha kilimo na mazao yanayostahimili hali ya hewa chang8e..
Ekegusii: Kwegera omoroberio bwoboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura nigo orengete okobwaterana chinsemo chinyinge buna, gosimeka ebimeri biria bikoremereria rire, oboremi bwetugo obuya, oborendi obuya bwemegondo/amache, na ogotumeka okuya gwechinguru chiomorero.
Somali: Qorshe adag oo ku lug leh beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka leh iyo isbeddelka cimilada, waxaa la siin doonaa deeq lacageed oo ka timid dawladda.
Dholuo: Mondo omi omi chenro mar CSA mar timo tijno ochopre gi chwoyo ma nyalo geng'o lokruok mar piny, onego omi chenro mar timo tijno oti gi pesa ma sirkal chiwo.

English: China has vaccinated her pigs against swine flu to attain production targets on pigs and stabilize pork production.
Kiswahili: China imewaua nguruwe zake dhidi ya mafua ya nguruve ili kufikia malengo ya uzalishaji wa nguruwa na kudumisha uzalishwaji wa nyama ya Nguruwe.
Ekegusii: Ense ya China nigop bagochancha chingurue chiabo erio korenda amarwaire echingurue erio erio goikerania oboremi obwo bwetugo yechingurue stabilize pork production.
Somali: Shiinaha ayaa tallaalay doofaaradeeda ka dhanka ah hargabka doofaarka si loo gaaro bartilmaameedyada wax soo saarka ee doofaarta iyo in la xasilooniyo wax soo saarkii hilibka doofaa.
Dholuo: Piny China osetiyo gi thieth mar tuo mar tugo mar ng'owo mondo ochopgo chenro mar chamo ng'ombe kod chamo ring'o.

English: Reduced taxation brings market freedom and entry, increase market products from outside,and increase competition among the sectors that compete and orders in the country to be strong.
Kiswahili: Kupunguza ushuru huleta uhuru wa kuingia na kuingia kwenye soko, huongeza bidhaa za soko kutoka nje, na huongeza ushindani kati ya sekta ambazo zinashindana na kuagiza nchi kuwa imara.
Ekegusii: Gokeania echogo nensemoeyemo ekwororobia gosoa echiro, ekwororbia obogori bwebinto mkorwa isiko aororo, emoerio yaigora okoreta endagera inkaase baria bagosindana kwangoyia...
Somali: Cashuurta la yareeyo waxay keentaa xorriyadda suuqa iyo gelitaanka suuqa, waxay kordhisaa badeecadaha suuqa ee ka imanaya dibadda, waxayna kordhineysaa tartanka ka dhexeeya qaybaha tartamaya iyo amarrada dalka si ay u noqdaan kuwo xooggan.
Dholuo: Chulo osuru madong' kelo thuolo kod thuolo mar donjo e chiro, kelo dongruok e ohala mag ohala moa e pinje mamoko, kendo medo medore piem e kind grube ma piem kendo ma chano mondo obed motegno e piny.

English: Changes in cattle rearing aimed at proper feeding ensures good yields, adding manure to the field and redusing soil erosion in livestock rearing..
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko katika ufugaji wa ng'ombe yanayolenga kulisha vizuri huhakikisha mavuno mazuri, kuongeza mbolea shambani na mmomonyoko wa udongo katika ufugaji wa mifugo..
Ekegusii: Ogoonchoreria buna okorisia gose gotuga etugo yao erengete korageria etgo yao buna ebwenerete korwa aa gochia asande erio konyora rigesa riengencho, kogesa obotobu ase riroba, na gokeania omogoko bweriroba ase omoroberio bwetugo.
Somali: Isbeddelada ku saabsan korinta lo'da ee loogu talagalay quudinta saxda ah ayaa xaqiijinaysa dalag wanaagsan, taasoo ku daraysa baahinta beeraha iyo ka hortagga nabaad-guurka ciidda ee korinta xoolaha..
Dholuo: Lokruok e pidho dhok mondo omi ji ochiem maber, miyo lowo bedo maber, kendo miyo lowo bedo marach e pidho dhok.

English: Climate smart agriculture is a way of providing transformative leadership on how farming is done and how food is distributed towards green and climate resilient practices.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha akili kwa ajili ya hali ya hewa ni njia ya kutoa uongozi wa mabadiliko juu ya jinsi kilimo kinavyofanywa na jinsi chakula kinavyosambazwa kuelekea mazoea ya kijani na ya kukabiliana na hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Oboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura (CSA) nenchera egokonya korwa oborai aerio goonchoreria engencho oboremi bogokorwa nenchera yokoererania chindagera erio towards green and climate resilient practices.
Somali: Beeraleyda caqliga leh ee cimilada waa hab lagu bixiyo hoggaan isbeddel leh oo ku saabsan sida beeralayda loo sameeyo iyo sida cuntada loogu qaybiyo dhaqamada cagaaran iyo kuwa cimilada u adkeysan.
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e bwo chal mar kor lwasi en yo mar chiwo telo mar lokruok e yo ma tij pur itimoe kod kaka chiemo ipogo e yo ma miyo ji bedo gi timbe mabeyo kendo ma ok kethre gi kit yamo.

English: Reduce soil erosion: reduce on tillage and practice mulching using leftovers after harvesting, as way of reducing soil erosion 80%. CA also harvest adds manure to the soil..
Kiswahili: Punguza mmomonyoko wa udongo: punguza kilimo na ujizoeze kuweka matandazo kwa kutumia mabaki baada ya kuvuna, kama njia ya kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo kwa 80%. CA pia mavuno huongeza mbolea kwenye udongo..
Ekegusii: Keania omogoko bweriroba riao: Keania korema riroba na egera gotuba rirob rario cover neubi eria egotigara korwa rigesa buna enchera eyemo yogokeania omogoko bweriroba riao goika 80%. CA boigo nigo ekogesa obotobu ase riroba riao ...
Somali: Yaree nabaad-guurka ciidda: yaree beerista oo ku tababar mulching adigoo isticmaalaya hadhaaga ka dib goosashada, si loo yareeyo nabaad-guurka ciidda 80%. CA sidoo kale goosashada waxay ku dartaa baalasha ciidda..
Dholuo: Med ng'ich lowo: med timo tij pur kendo ti gi gik modong' e lowo bang' keyo, mondo omi lowo odog chien gi 80% mar lowo.

English: Appreciate how mixed farming has helped farmers to reap big from small holding, increase yields and satisfaction.
Kiswahili: Thamini jinsi kilimo mchanganyiko kimesaidia wakulima kuvuna kubwa kutoka kwa umiliki mdogo, kuongeza mavuno na kuridhika.
Ekegusii: Rora buna okoburukania ebimeri mogondo biakonyire abaremi bemegondo emeke ase ebinyoro, gokinia ebitoki na omoigoto.
Somali: U mahad celi sida beeraha isku dhafan ay uga caawiyeen beeraleyda inay ka helaan waxyaabo badan oo ka soo baxa beeraha yaryar, kor u qaadaan wax soo saarka iyo qanacsanaanta.
Dholuo: Ne ane kaka tij pur moting'o gik mopogore opogore osekonyo jopur mondo okel cham mang'eny kuom puothe matindo, kendo okonygi bedo gi chuny mokuwe.

English: Plant maize and sweet potatoes thus making maximum utility of your field, reducing pests and diseases and enjoy yields from your intercropping.
Kiswahili: Panda mahindi na viazi vitamu na hivyo kufanya matumizi ya juu ya shamba lako, kupunguza wadudu na magonjwa na ufurahie mavuno kutoka kwa kilimo chako.
Ekegusii: Erma ebituma amo namarabwoni (okoburukania) erio gotumia omogondo oo buya, gokeania ebichuni na amakonde, na kogarei okonyora korwa oboremi bwao.
Somali: Beeraha ku beerso hadhuudh iyo baradho macaan si aad u isticmaasho dhulkaaga, yareyso cayayaanka iyo cudurrada, oo aad u raaxaysato goosashada beerahaaga.
Dholuo: Kuom mano, cham chamuru kodungu kod mbese mamit mondo uti gi puodhono e yo maber moloyo, mondo omi kik ubed gi tuoche kod tuoche mang'eny, kendo mondo uti gi nyak mar cham ma utiyogo e puodhono.

English: This dynamics aims at transforming food in Kenya to support good health for all, progressive environment, resilience, applying organic technology, which includes..
Kiswahili: Mchakato huu unalenga kubadilisha vyakula nchini Kenya kusaidia afya njema kwa wote, mazingira ya maendeleo, uvumilivu, kutumia teknolojia ya kikaboni, ambayo ni pamoja na ..
Ekegusii: Omoroberio oyo nogo orengete goonchoreria oboereria bwendagera koba obeafia engiya, ase bonsi, erendete amasingira,na ogwekomereria, gotumia amayo yeubi, ayakopburukania ...
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqan ayaa ujeedkiisu yahay in la beddelo cuntada Kenya si loo taageero caafimaadka wanaagsan ee qof walba, deegaanka horumarsan, adkeysiga, isticmaalka tikniyoolajiyadda dabiiciga ah, taas oo ay ka mid yihiin..
Dholuo: Chenrono dwaro loko chiemo e piny Kenya mondo okony ji duto obed gi ngima maber, alwora maber, teko mar nano, tiyo gi teknoloji mag gik mochido, ma oriwo...

English: Farmers are urged to shift use of hybrid seeds that are pest resistant to reduce harvets losses.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa wahamishe matumizi ya mbegu za mseto ambazo haziwezi kuharibiwa na wadudu ili kupunguza hasara za mazao.
Ekegusii: Abaremi basoroirwe goonchorerioboremi bwabo gochia embusuro eria ekoremereria amarwaire ebichuni erio gokeania ogosareka kwendagera mogondo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay beddelaan isticmaalka abuurka isku dhafan ee u adkaysta cayayaanka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha goosashada.
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo olok kodhi ma ok nyal kethore gi choko cham mondo kik cham cham kethre.

English: Branding vegetables in the market helps in identification. Learn on how best to brand package your produce to sell faster with ease.
Kiswahili: Kuweka chapa ya mboga kwenye soko husaidia kutambulisha. Jifunze jinsi ya kuweka chapa bora ya vifurushi vyako ili kuuza haraka na kwa urahisi.
Ekegusii: Gosiba chingeni as amarieta abo as echiro ngokonya ere goatanana ching'eni chiao. Egera buna oranyare kobekera ching'eni amarieta erio gokonya gosoa ase echiro buya kegima
Somali: Markaad calaamadeysid khudaarta suuqa waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad aqoonsato. Baro sida ugu fiican ee aad ugu calaamadin karto baakadaha alaabtaada si aad u iibiso si dhakhso leh oo fudud.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka inyalo keto ranyisi maber e wi gik miseng'o mondo ing'iewgi mapiyo kendo e yo mayot.

English: Increase your incomes from beans cultivation, by understanding market demands, reduce rotting of your beans harvest, to know how well you can harvest income from markets.
Kiswahili: Ongeza mapato yako kutoka kwa kilimo cha maharagwe, kwa kuelewa mahitaji ya soko, kupunguza uharibifu wa mavuno yako maharagwe, kujua jinsi vizuri unaweza kuvuna mapato kutoka masoko.
Ekegusii: Kinia okonyora kwao korwa oboremi bweching'ende ase okomanya boronge buna chiganeirie, gokeania ogosareka kwerigesa rieching'ende, agotema komanya buna oragese obuya bwaye nechiro ereo.
Somali: Kordhi dakhligaaga beerista digirta, adigoo fahamsanaya baahida suuqa, yaree burburka goosashada digirtaada, si aad u ogaato sida aad dakhliga suuqyada uga heli karto.
Dholuo: Meduru yuto ma un-go kuom pidho puothe, kuom ng'eyo dwaro mag ohala, kendo meduru kethruok mar keyo maru, mondo ung'e kaka unyalo yudo yuto maber kuom ohala.

English: Begin bee keeping. Learn how to safeguard bee hives, honey harvesting and sales and disposing honey by products.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi ya kulinda mizinga ya nyuki, uvunaji wa asali na mauzo na kutupa asali kwa bidhaa.
Ekegusii: Ansa gose kong'ia obotugi bwao bwechinchoke. Egera komanya buna okorenda emetana, kogesa oboke, na buna okoonia rigesa riechinchoke.
Somali: Bilow beerista shinniga, baro sida loo ilaaliyo beeraha shinniga, beerashada malabka iyo iibinta iyo baabi'inta malabka alaabta.
Dholuo: Chak pidho nyuki, puonjri rito ute mag nyuki, choko kendo uso meli, kendo ketogi e yo mopogore gi gik mitiyogo.

English: Apply fertiliser wisely to reduce on excessive manure, to mitigate on climate change effect on environment. Learn how you can gauge soil fertility.
Kiswahili: Omba mbolea kwa busara ili kupunguza mbolea nyingi, ili kupunguza athari ya mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa kwa mazingira. Jifunze jinsi unavyoweza kupima rutuba ya udongo.
Ekegusii: Tumia obwoyo buya erio gokeania okonyua obwoyo obonge ase ebituma erio gokeania omochndo bwogosareka kwamasingira. Soma buna orapime riroba riao goikerania ebirengo ebiya bwobwoyo.
Somali: Si xikmad leh u isticmaal bacriminta si aad u yareyso baahinta xad-dhaafka ah, si loo yareeyo saameynta isbeddelka cimilada ee deegaanka. Baro sida aad u qiyaasi karto bacrinta ciidda.
Dholuo: Ti gi yien e yo mariek mondo omi kik ichak chamo yien mang'eny, kendo mondo omi kik iketh lokruok mar alwora.

English: Understanding fair trade principles is crucial for small-scale farmers. This PSA outlines practices that ensure you get a fair price for your meat.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa kanuni za biashara ya haki ni muhimu kwa wakulima wadogo. PSA hii inaonyesha mazoea ambayo kuhakikisha kupata bei ya haki kwa nyama yako.
Ekegusii: Komanya amachiko amororo yogokora oboonchoreria negento kiengencho ase abaremi bemegondo emeke. Omoroberio oyo o'PSA nkorwa ore aya obwenerete gokora goikera amagori amaya yenyama.
Somali: Fahamka mabaadi'da ganacsiga cadaaladda ah waa muhiim beeraleyda yaryar. PSA-dan waxay qeexaysaa hababka lagu xaqiijinayo inaad hesho qiimo cadaalad ah oo hilibkaaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo puonj mag ohala makare en gima dwarore ahinya ne jopur matindo.

English: Research on tagging livestock , it's pros and cons , aimed at knowing and how it can influence farming and crops that control diseases from farms.
Kiswahili: Utafiti juu ya kuweka alama kwenye mifugo , ni faida na hasara , inalenga kujua na jinsi inavyoweza kuathiri kilimo na mazao ambayo yanadhibiti magonjwa kutoka kwa mashamba.

Dholuo: Gik moko duto madwarore e pur kod dongruok, dwaro kony e kinde mowinjore, mondo okony e chwoyo cham, nengo maber mar gik ma giloso kaachiel gi chiro.

English: Do you have the urge to apply organic manure apart from chemical fertiliser ? Know what's required, the quantities and available market for mushroom.
Kiswahili: Je, una hamu ya kupaka mbolea ya kikaboni mbali na mbolea ya kemikali? Jua kinachohitajika, kiasi na soko linalopatikana la uyoga.
Ekegusii: Nore nomoyo bwogokora oboremi botari gotumia obwoyo bwetuka obwo bobwate chikemikari? Manya igoro ya' ayaganeirie, ebirengo, ana echiro ereo ase oboremi obwo bamoba.
Somali: Ma dareemaysaa rabitaan aad u isticmaasho bacriminta organic marka laga reebo bacriminta kiimikada? Ogow waxa loo baahan yahay, tirada iyo suuqa mushroom-ka la heli karo.
Dholuo: Be in gi gombo mar tiyo gi yien mag chwech mopogore gi yien mag kemia?

English: Gain hands-on experience in mushroom farming by attending a practical workshop designed for farmers and agri-entrepreneurs.
Kiswahili: Pata uzoefu wa vitendo katika kilimo cha uyoga kwa kuhudhuria warsha ya vitendo iliyoundwa kwa wakulima na wajasiriamali wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Nyora obomanyi bwaime ase oboremi bwamoba as ogosoa amasomo arengete abaremi na abaremi bebiasara.
Somali: Hel waayo-aragnimo gacanta ah oo ku saabsan beerista mushroom-ka adigoo ka qayb qaadanaya aqoon-is-weydaarsi wax ku ool ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada beeraha.
Dholuo: Yud lony e tij pidho cham kuom dhi e chokruok mar tich motim ne jopur koda jomisonari mag weche mag pidho cham.

English: Climate change has affected maize production and a robust plan is technically required to increase yields and food security across the world.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yameathiri uzalishaji wa mahindi na mpango thabiti unahitajiwa kiufundi ili kuongeza mazao na usalama wa chakula ulimwenguni pote.
Ekegusii: Ogoonchoka kwerire gwakeirie rigesa riebituma na ase ayio omoroberio otekinorochia noganeririe erio gokinia rigesa na korwania oboremu bwendagera ase ense engima.
Somali: Isbeddelka cimilada ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay wax-soo-saarka galleyda, waxaana loo baahan yahay qorshe adag si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka iyo amniga cuntada adduunka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Lokruok mar alwora osechido yien mar cham kendo dwarore ni ng'ato oti gi chenro maber mondo omi okaw cham e piny mangima.

English: Farmers are advised to form farmers cooperative groups to open chances of horticultural products.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuunda vikundi vya ushirika wa wakulima ili kufungua nafasi za bidhaa za bustani.
Ekegusii: Abaremi basororirwe korosia ebiombe erio kwangoyia ogosoa echiro ase obwororo ase oboremi bwabo bwechigeni na amatunda.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay sameeyaan kooxo iskaashatada beeraleyda si loo furo fursadaha alaabta beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo ochak grube mag jo japur mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo gik ma gipuonjo e puothe.

English: Test your soil manure with KEPHIS to understand soil fertility, water content, available PH, to inform you on the type of fertiliser required on your banana farm.
Kiswahili: Jaribu uchafu wako wa udongo na KEPHIS ili kuelewa uzazi wa udongo, maji yaliyomo, PH iliyopo, ili kukujulisha aina ya mbolea inayohitajika kwenye shamba lako la ndizi.
Ekegusii: Tema korenga obotobu bweriroba riao na KEPHIS erio komanya ebirengo bwobotobu bwaye na ebirengo bia biobotobu, amache na oboikeranu bwendagera pH, bikorae buna okobeka obwoyo ase amaotoke ao.
Somali: Tijaabi baahinta ciiddaada adigoo adeegsanaya KEPHIS si aad u fahanto bacrinta ciidda, biyaha ku jira, PH-ga la heli karo, si aad kuugu wargeliso nooca bacriminta loo baahan yahay beertaada mooska.
Dholuo: Tem tem mar temo lowo gi KEPHIS mondo ing'e kaka lowo nyago, pi ma iye, pH ma in-go, mondo ing'e kit yien ma dwarore e puoth chamo olembe.

English: Lessons on how to control pests and harvest protection has been started in Nakuru county.
Kiswahili: Masomo ya jinsi ya kudhibiti wadudu na ulinzi wa mavuno yameanzishwa katika kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Ogosoma buna oratange amakonde na korenada rigesa tirisareka ochakire aaria ekaonti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Casharro ku saabsan xakameynta cayayaanka iyo ilaalinta goosashada ayaa laga bilaabay degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Puonj e wi kaka inyalo geng'o gik makelo hinyruok kod kaka inyalo geng'o keyo osechakore e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: A new study has confirmed that cultivating transgenic Pod Borer Resistant (PBR) Cowpea does not harm ecological species or disrupt biodiversity.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mpya umethibitisha kwamba kukuza kunde zenye vimelea sugu kwa vimelea vya Pod Borer (PBR) havidhuru spishi za ikolojia au kuharibu bayoanuwai.
Ekegusii: Obokongoria bwa bwango iga bwaorokirie ng'a korema ekemeri kia transgenic Pod Borer Provenant (PBR), Cowpe mbori gosaria ebire bitoonchokanaine buna emete gose ching'iti.
Somali: Daraasad cusub ayaa xaqiijisay in beerista budada loo yaqaan 'Pod Borer Resistant' (PBR) aan waxyeello u geysan noocyada deegaanka ama aanay burburin kala duwanaanshaha noolaha.
Dholuo: Nonro moro manyien osenyiso ni pidho dhok ma ok nyal geng'o kodhi mag Pod Borer Resistant (PBR) ok kel hinyruok ne le mag piny kata ketho kit ngima ji.

English: Exchange farm waste like maize husks and stocks to be farm yard manure and left over animal feeds and manage disposable waste to avoid dirtifyng surroundings environmental to maintain it forthwith.
Kiswahili: Badilisha taka za shambani kama maganda ya mahindi na hifadhi kuwa mbolea ya uwanja wa shamba na malisho ya mifugo iliyobaki na kudhibiti taka zinazoweza kutupwa ili kuepuka kuchafua mazingira ya mazingira ili kuyadumisha mara moja.
Ekegusii: Onchoreria ebogotigara korwa rigesa buna ebiemba gose amasaku koyaonchoreria boba obwoyo, ebinde kobionchoreria buna endagera yetugo ao ao na buna ogotuguta eubi korenda gose gokeania ogotiringa ebitoonchokanenete gose amasingira erio gokeania ogosareka kwebitoonchokanenete gose amasingira.
Somali: Beddel qashinka beeraha sida qolofka galleyda iyo kaydka si ay u noqdaan saxaro beerta beeraha iyo cuntooyinka xoolaha ee haray iyo maareeya qashinka la tuuri karo si looga fogaado wasakhda deegaanka si loo ilaaliyo si degdeg ah.
Dholuo: Golo gik mochido mag puothe kaka mag cham kod mag cham mondo obed chido mar puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe

English: Infrastructure improvements have been associated with improved market access and lower food prices. Transport investments often result to agricultural.
Kiswahili: Maboresho ya miundombinu yamehusishwa na uboreshaji wa upatikanaji wa soko na bei ya chini ya chakula. Uwekezaji wa usafiri mara nyingi husababishwa na kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ogotaba nomoroberio omuya ase chinyomba chiokogacha rigesa nechipara gochiboria gochia echiro ngokonya ore ase goikera echiro na gokeania rigori riendagera. Chipara chingiya botambe nigo chigosegeta boremi…….
Somali: Hagaajinta kaabayaasha ayaa la xiriirta helitaanka suuqa oo hagaagsan iyo qiimaha cuntada oo hoos u dhaca.
Dholuo: Tiegruok mar chenro mag piny oseriwore gi dongruok mar yudo pesa e chiro mar piny kod nengo mag chiemo.

English: In Europe vaccination is on-going among sheep herds to improve on the herds and wool harvest.
Kiswahili: Huko Uropa chanjo inaendelea kati ya mifugo ya kondoo ili kuboresha mifugo na mavuno ya pamba.
Ekegusii: Ense ya UK negenderete kobeta chisindani etugo yechingondi nomoroberio omogima bwobobwenia gokinia rigesa riamarionya korwa chingondi.
Somali: Yurub, tallaalka ayaa ka socda xoolaha idaha si loo hagaajiyo xoolaha iyo goosashada dhogorta.
Dholuo: E pinje mag Ulaya, ji medo thiedho rombe mondo omed bedo gi ber mar rombe kod yien.

English: Learn how to safeguard your environment to following land use management procedures, water and other ecosystem in the farm.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi ya kulinda mazingira yako kufuata taratibu za usimamizi wa matumizi ya ardhi, maji na mfumo mwingine wa ikolojia shambani.
Ekegusii: Egera obokoreri bwamasingira ase okobwatia chingencho omoroberio chiria okorenda riroba, amache, nebitonwa binde ase omogondo oo.
Somali: Baro sida aad u ilaaliso deegaankaaga adoo raacaya nidaamyada maaraynta isticmaalka dhulka, biyaha iyo nidaamyada kale ee deegaanka ee beerta.
Dholuo: Puonjri rito alwora mari kuom luwo yore mag locho gi lowo, pi, kod gik mamoko ma yudore e puodho.

English: Differentiate your fresh milk in the market by creating a strong brand identity. Learn basic branding principles and marketing techniques.
Kiswahili: Tofautisha maziwa yako mabichi sokoni kwa kuunda utambulisho imara wa chapa. Jifunze kanuni za msingi za chapa na mbinu za uuzaji.
Ekegusii: Atanana buna amabere ao akororekana ase echiro ase okobeka ekemanyererio kiabeene. Egera buna orabeke ekemanyererio ase amagena echingoko chiao na ayarengete oboonia oboikeranu.
Somali: Kala duwanaada caanahaaga cusub ee suuqa adoo abuuraya aqoonsi sumad xoog leh. Baro mabaadi'da aasaasiga ah ee sumadda iyo farsamooyinka suuqgeynta.
Dholuo: Puonjri pogo chak manyien ma in-go e chiro gi machielo kuom bedo gi ng'eyo motegno mar ng'at minyalo bedogo.

English: A policy on pesticides per crop(CSPM) is a leading pest control method which is cost effective and affordable on pest menace on crops new and current, thus reducing crop loss and increasing food security and farmers.
Kiswahili: Sera ya dawa za kuua wadudu kwa kila mazao (CSPM) ni njia ya kuongoza ya kudhibiti wadudu ambayo ni gharama nafuu na ya bei rahisi juu ya tishio la wadudu kwenye mazao mapya na ya sasa, na hivyo kupunguza hasara ya mazao na kuongeza usalama wa chakula na wakulima.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwariofgo arenge oboremi bwa kera ekemeri (CSPM) nigo bore oboikeranu lna ase rigori ribwenerete igor yamariogo aria areo agotanga amarwaire, na uigo kogesa rogesa na goikerania omoigoto bwendagera na abaremi …
Somali: Siyaasadda sunta cayayaanka halkii dalagga (CSPM) waa hab hormuud ah oo lagu xakameeyo cayayaanka, taasoo ah mid qiimo jaban oo la awoodi karo marka la eego khatarta cayayaanka ee dalagyada cusub iyo kuwa cusub, taasoo yareysa khasaaraha dalagga iyo kor u qaadista amniga cuntada iyo beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar tuoche kod tuoche e puothe manyien kod masani en yo maduong' mar thieth mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o nengo kendo ma ok nyal geng'o tuoche ma nyalo mako puothe manyien kod masani, kendo mano miyo ji ok nyal chamo cham kendo miyo chiemo kod jopur bedo maber.

English: Increase poultry yields by cross breeding with hybrid Cockerel and indigenous breeds to bring up a better breed in poultry house and good management.
Kiswahili: Ongeza mavuno ya kuku kwa kuzaliana msalaba na Cockerel mseto na mifugo ya asili ili kuleta aina bora katika nyumba ya kuku na usimamizi mzuri.
Ekegusii: Gokinia ebitoki ase oboremi bwechingoko ase enchera ya ogokeborana embusuro yaye ase engencho yengoko entwoni yegredi as engoko yekegusii korenta embusuro eng'a, okorageria, egesumu gwechingoko, na oborendi obuya.
Somali: Kordhinta wax soo saarka digaagga adoo isku dhafan u soo saara Cockerel hybrid iyo noocyada deegaanka si loo soo saaro nooc ka wanaagsan guriga digaagga iyo maaraynta wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Med nyak mar le mag le mag dhok kuom pidho le mag le mag Cockerel kod le mag anyuola mar oganda mondo omi nyithi le mag le mag dhok obed maber e udi mag le mag dhok kendo gibed gi rit maber.

English: A method of utilizing ripparian section and mixed farming. A swift plan need to be undertaken to control or prevent fall army worms ,this rests upon the farmers themselves.
Kiswahili: Njia ya kutumia sehemu ya ripparian na kilimo mchanganyiko. Mpango wa haraka unahitaji kufanywa ili kudhibiti au kuzuia minyoo ya jeshi la kuanguka ,hii inategemea wakulima wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Engencho yogotenerera ebomeri bia roche, amo nogosegeta engencho yokoburuknia ebimeri mogondo. Egetambokero kia boronge kebwenerete kobogorigigwa erio korenda gose gotanga amakonde mogondo (FAW) nogo otigarete ase omoremi omonyene erio ...
Somali: Nidaamka loo adeegsado qaybta ripparian iyo beeraha isku dhafan. qorshe deg deg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay in la sameeyo si loo xakameeyo ama looga hortago cayayaanka ciidanka fall army, tani waxay ku xiran tahay beeraleyda laftiisa.
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiyo gi yore mag ripparian kod pur moting'o gik mopogore opogore dwarore ni otim chenro mapiyo mar chungo kata geng'o chwanyruok mar jolweny, mano en gima otenore kuom jopur.

English: Government has issued hybrid high yielding maize to farmers in semi-arid areas.
Kiswahili: Serikali imetoa mahindi ya mseto yenye mavuno mengi kwa wakulima katika maeneo yenye ukame.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarure aembusuro yebituma yerigesa rinene ase chingongo chiria chinyomo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay siisay galley isku dhafan oo sare leh beeraleyda ku nool meelaha semi-arid.
Dholuo: Sirkal osechiwo kodhi ma nigi nyak mang'eny ne jopur manie gwenge ma otwo.

English: PSA encourages self made manure to use a variety of left overs, helps using a variety of stuff to restore soil health .
Kiswahili: PSA inahimiza manyoya ya kujitengenezea kutumia aina mbalimbali za mabaki ya kushoto, husaidia kutumia vitu mbalimbali kurudisha afya ya udongo.
Ekegusii: PSA ngosegeta ere oboremi bwobwoyo bwekweroseria ase ogotumia eubi erio gokonya gokeyioa ogosareka kweriroba.
Somali: PSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa bacriminta la sameeyay si loo isticmaalo noocyo kala duwan oo ka baxsan, waxay ka caawineysaa isticmaalka waxyaabaha kala duwan si loo soo celiyo caafimaadka ciidda.
Dholuo: PSA jiwo yien ma ng'ato owuon oseloso mondo oti gi gik mang'eny ma odong', konyo tiyo gi gik mopogore opogore e loso lowo obed gi ngima maber.

English: Opinions and latest news. Thoughtful detail. Digital agriculture: Great in helping small scale farmers to overcome challenges of COVID 19. As we approach..
Kiswahili: Maoni na habari za hivi punde. Maelezo ya kufikiria. Kilimo cha dijiti: Nzuri katika kusaidia wakulima wadogo kushinda changamoto za COVID 19. Tunapokaribia..
Ekegusii: Amangana amayia na amaikeranu. Ebirengererio bia'ime. Oboremi bwegechiditchiari: Ekenene ase ogokonya abaremi bemegondo emeke erio kobua omochando bweendwari ya COVID-19. Gatore ang'e goikera ...
Somali: Aragtiyo iyo wararkii ugu dambeeyay. Faahfaahin fikir leh. Beeraha dijitaalka ah: Aad bay ugu fiican tahay caawinta beeraleyda yaryar inay ka gudbaan caqabadaha COVID-19. Markaan soo dhowaanayno..
Dholuo: Paro kod weche manyien. Weche molony. Digital agriculture: Ber konyo jopur matindo loyo pek mag COVID 19. Kaka wamedo sudo machiegni...

English: Announcement to farmers in arid regions to embrace water conservation and practice irrigation.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwa wakulima katika maeneo kame kukumbatia uhifadhi wa maji na kufanya mazoezi ya umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa gochia abaremi igoro yogosiarera amache mogondo orengete obogachi obuya bwamache aria chinsemo chinyomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis loo dirayo beeraleyda gobollada qalalan si ay u taageeraan ilaalinta biyaha iyo inay ku dhaqmaan waraabka.
Dholuo: Owacho ne jopur manie gwenge motwo mondo omak pi kendo oti gi yo mar dhi nyime gi tij lwoko pi.

English: A solid business plan is essential for any agribusiness venture like grain production. Learn the key components and how to develop one.
Kiswahili: Mpango imara wa biashara ni muhimu kwa mradi wowote wa biashara ya kilimo kama vile uzalishaji wa nafaka. Jifunze vipengele muhimu na jinsi ya kuuendeleza.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omuya bwoboremi nobwengencho kegima as oboremi bwoboonchoreria as oboremi bwechinyeke. Egera igoreo yebiganeirie na buna bigora emeremo kogesa rigesa.
Somali: Qorshe ganacsi oo adag ayaa muhiim u ah ganacsi kasta oo beeraha ah sida soo saarista hadhuudhka. Baro qaybaha muhiimka ah iyo sida loo horumariyo mid.
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo ohala maber dwarore ahinya e tich moro amora mar loso cham, kaka loso cham.

English: Demonstratable knowledge on agriculture technology in Africa
Kiswahili: Maarifa yanayoonekana kuhusu teknolojia ya kilimo barani Afrika
Ekegusii: Obomanti bwa'beene ase oboremi aswe tekinorochia aiga Afrika
Somali: Aqoonta lagu muujiyo ee ku saabsan tikniyoolajiyadda beeraha ee Afrika
Dholuo: Ng'eyo ma nyalo nyiso ni ng'ato nigi lony e weche mag teknoloji e weche mag pur e Afrika

English: Europe has continued vaccination on sheep herds to prevent them.
Kiswahili: Ulaya imeendelea kutoa chanjo kwa makundi ya kondoo ili kuwalinda.
Ekegusii: Ense ya UK negenderete kobeta chisindani etugo yechingondi buna enchera eyemo yokorenda chiombe.
Somali: Yurub waxay sii waday tallaalka xoolaha idaha si looga hortago.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ogeng'gi, pinje mag Ulaya osebedo ka dhi nyime chango rombe.

English: USDA encourage soil fertility through restoration of cattle to keep soil health.
Kiswahili: USDA inahimiza rutuba ya udongo kupitia urejesho wa ng'ombe ili kudumisha afya ya udongo.
Ekegusii: USDA ngosira ere ebokoro biria bikorenda obotobu bweriroba ase etugo erio kobeka obotobu na afia.
Somali: USDA waxay dhiirigelisay dhalashada ciidda iyada oo la soo celinayo lo'da si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka ciidda.
Dholuo: USDA jiwo lowo mondo obed gi nyak kuom chango dhok mondo lowo obed gi ngima maber.

English: Farmers invited to attend workshops on smart agriculture technologies.
Kiswahili: Wakulima waalikwa kuhudhuria warsha kuhusu teknolojia bora za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abaremi baariganiigwe ase amasomo igoro ya oboremi bwegetekinorojia.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qaybgalaan aqoon isweydaarsiyo ku saabsan tiknoolajiyada beeraha ee caqliga leh.
Dholuo: Ne ogwel jopur mondo obi e chokruok mar timo nonro e wi teknoloji mag pur mariek.

English: Information about food markets and good eating habits in Kenya. Embrace team work amongst both genders about quality feeding and whats happening..
Kiswahili: Habari kuhusu masoko ya chakula na tabia nzuri za kula nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Ansa gose kong'ia obotugi bwao bwechinchoke.Egera komanya buna okorenda emetana, amasingira amaya yechinchoke, honey harvesting, kogesa oboke, na buna okoonia rigesa riechinchoke.
Somali: Macluumaad ku saabsan suuqyada cuntada iyo caadooyinka cuntada wanaagsan ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Puonj e wi ohala mag chiemo kod timbe mabeyo mag chiemo e piny Kenya.

English: Announcement to all: farmers being enlisted in government offered digital training on agricultural aspects.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwa wote: wakulima waliojiandikisha serikalini walitoa mafunzo ya kidigitali juu ya sehemu za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa ase bonsi: Omoroberio bweserikari goikerania chisemi chioboremi goetera egechidichitari.
Somali: Ogeysiis dhammaan: beeraleyda lagu qoray dowladda ayaa bixiyay tababar dijital ah oo ku saabsan dhinacyada beeraha.
Dholuo: Owacho ni: Jo-Farmer ma ne dhi tiyo e sirkal ne dhi yudo tiegruok e yore mag digital e weche mag pur.

English: Kenyan farmers have the opportunity of collaboration with coffee market worldwide.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wana fursa ya kushirikiana na soko la kahawa ulimwenguni pote.
Ekegusii: Abaremi ba'Kenyan fbasoire ase omoroberio bwechiro yense yechikagwa na okobwaterana.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxay fursad u leeyihiin inay la shaqeeyaan suuqyada qaxwaha adduunka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Jo-Kenya nigi thuolo mar tiyo kanyachiel gi ohala mar kofi e piny mangima.

English: Kenya continues with a robust plan to control livestock diseases .
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendelea na mpango thabiti wa kudhibiti magonjwa ya mifugo .
Ekegusii: Kenya negendererete gosegeta omoroberio bwogotanga amarwaire etugo.
Somali: Kenya waxay sii wadaa qorshe adag oo lagu xakameynayo cudurrada xoolaha .
Dholuo: Kenya dhi nyime gi chenro mar geng 'o tuoche mag jamni .

English: United kingdom vaccinated against respiratory diseases.
Kiswahili: Uingereza imepewa chanjo dhidi ya magonjwa ya kupumua.
Ekegusii: Ense ya UK negenderete kobeta chisindani chiendwari yekuba ekene ase etugo
Somali: Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ayaa la tallaalay cudurrada neefsashada.
Dholuo: Ingresa ma nigi chanjo mar thieth mar tuoche mag muya.

English: Kenya has made a stride in a continuous plan to identify and control livestock diseases.
Kiswahili: Kenya imepiga hatua katika mpango endelevu wa kutambua na kudhibiti magonjwa ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaangoirie omoroberio ogendererete bwokomanya na gotanga amarwaire yetugo.
Somali: Kenya waxay horumar ka qaaday qorshe joogto ah oo lagu aqoonsanayo laguna xakameynayo cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya osetimo dongruok e chenro mar chano kendo geng'o tuoche mag jamni.

English: US promotes bovine viral diarrhea vaccination for cattle.
Kiswahili: Marekani inakuza chanjo ya kuhara virusi vya ng'ombe kwa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: Amerika negenderete kobeta chisindani chiogotanga endwari yogosaa ase etugo.
Somali: US waxay dhiirrigelisaa tallaalka shubanka fayraska lo'da.
Dholuo: Amerka jiwo thieth mar tuo mar dhoho mar dhok.

English: Increase your coffee incomes and its markets, reduce farm losses of your harvest, and know how best you can harvest.

English: You desire to sell your eggs to diaspora markets? You wish to sell your milk in international markets? Learn on standard requirements, acceptability and what is needed to attain entry in Middle East.

English: How technology is utilized. Maize farming be done according to market to demands and other crops, not i a coercive manner.

English: Get tips on beans sales to large markets successfully, right from preparation, supply and packaging, promotion and pricing.
Kiswahili: Pata vidokezo juu ya mauzo ya maharagwe kwa masoko makubwa kwa mafanikio, moja kwa moja kutoka maandalizi, usambazaji na ufungaji, matangazo na bei.
Ekegusii: Nyora okomanya kwabeene ase okoonia ching'ende chiao gochia chituka chiria chinene, buna obwenerete gochichora na gochisiba, gochimanyekania na buna obwenerete gochiakera rigori.

English: The Ministry provides education about crop resilience and proper use of water.

Ekegusii: Eminisituri nigo ekorwaogosemia igoro yogwekomereria ekero kieguragura na yogotumia amache buya.

English: Differentiate your free-range eggs in the market by creating a strong brand identity. Learn basic branding principles and marketing techniques.

English: Discover appropriate times when you can supply milk from your dairy farm or eggs to (schools and hospitals) depending on their feeding program.

English: Learn one system of health guarding the ecosystem between human beings, livestock and our environment in a way of reducing cross infections from crops.
Kiswahili: Jifunze mfumo mmoja wa afya unaolinda mfumo wa ikolojia kati ya wanadamu, mifugo na mazingira yetu kwa njia ya kupunguza maambukizo ya msalaba kutoka kwa mazao.

English: Women have a bigger role in dairy farming. Learn available policy, requirements and markets that involves women in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu kubwa katika ufugaji wa maziwa. Jifunze sera zinazopatikana, mahitaji na masoko ambayo yanahusisha wanawake katika kilimo.

Dholuo: Mon nigi migawo maduong' e pur mar chak. Puonjri chike, dwaro kod ohala ma mon nigo e pur.

English: To guard against any eventuality to start bee keeping. Diversify your lessons to other assortment of farming, services, memorandum, and appreciate related risks like livestock diseases.
Kiswahili: Ili kujilinda dhidi ya tukio lolote la kuanza ufugaji nyuki. Badilisha masomo yako kwa anuwai zingine za kilimo, huduma, hati, na uthamini hatari zinazohusiana kama magonjwa ya mifugo.

English: Hastenning market access and basic infrastructure : invest in basic infrastructure in villages, like access roads and cold storages and announce digital platforms..
Kiswahili: Kuharakisha upatikanaji wa soko na miundombinu ya msingi: kuwekeza katika miundo ya msingi katika vijiji, kama vile barabara za ufikiaji na kuhifadhi baridi na kutangaza majukwaa ya digital..

English: Learn digital tools like M-Farm to help small scale farmers about prices and markets, to know about climate change, field intelligence from experts and online services.

English: Climate-smart agriculture is an approach that can help farmers and foresters build resilience and adapt to the effects of climate change.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa ni mbinu ambayo inaweza kusaidia wakulima na misitu kujenga ustahimilivu na kukabiliana na athari za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.

English: Learn new skills of health in coexistence between human health, livetock and environmental health like one way of minimising diseases from livestock.
Kiswahili: Jifunze ujuzi mpya wa afya katika kuishi pamoja kati ya afya ya binadamu, livetock na afya ya mazingira kama njia moja ya kupunguza magonjwa kutoka kwa mifugo.

English: USDA promotes regenerative agriculture practices.

English: TVETA oversees the development of new training manuals for vocational courses to meet industry demands.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Education promote school agricultural programs for food security and skills development.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Elimu huendeleza mipango ya kilimo ya shule kwa ajili ya usalama wa chakula na maendeleo ya ujuzi.

English: Ministry of Education develops tailored e-learning content for refugee learners in designated camps and resettlement areas.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu huendeleza maudhui ya kujifunza kwa njia ya elektroniki kwa wanafunzi wa wakimbizi katika kambi zilizoainishwa na maeneo ya kuhamisha.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorosia ere amasomo abeene arengete amasomo goetera eintaneti ase abana ba baria batamire korwa chinse chiabo babekire amo ase chikambi na asande anga buna ayio.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay horumarineysaa waxyaabaha barashada elektaroonigga ah ee loogu talagalay barayaasha qaxootiga ee xeryaha loo qoondeeyay iyo meelaha dib loo dejiyo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok timo chenro mar tiego ji e yor intanet mondo okony jopuonjre ma gin joma oringo thuchegi e kembe kod kuonde ma gidhiye.

English: 200 Stipendium Hungaricum scholarships open for Kenyan undergraduate students.
Kiswahili: Ufadhili wa masomo 200 wa Stipendium Hungaricum umefunguliwa kwa wanafunzi wa shahada ya kwanza wa Kenya.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bweserikari kobwaterana neserikari ya Hungary (Hungaricum scholarships) oigoirwe ase 200 ase baria basomeire edigrii entang'ani bachie gosoma.
Somali: 200 Stipendium Hungaricum deeq waxbarasho oo u furan ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Skund 200 mag Stipendium Hungaricum ne ochiw ne jopuonjre ma Kenya.

English: Council of Governors runs roadshows on devolution awareness.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana huendesha maonyesho ya barabara juu ya ufahamu wa uhamisho.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nkoba kere nokomanyia abanto amang'ana igoro yechikaonti chiabo ase ebinyoro.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay qabanqaabiyaan bandhigyo ku saabsan wacyiga wareejinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch dhi nyime gi chenro mar konyo ji mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo tiyo gi pesa e yo maber.

English: Free fashion design course launched at Nyandarua Institute of Science.
Kiswahili: Kozi ya bure ya usanifu wa mitindo ilizinduliwa katika Taasisi ya Sayansi ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Chikosi chia bosa chiobosoni chiansirwe ari Nyandarua at Nyandarua Institute of Science.
Somali: Koorso naqshadeyn moodada ah oo bilaash ah ayaa laga bilaabay Machadka Sayniska ee Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Kos mar loso fason ma onge chudo ochakre e Sikul mar Sayans mar Nyandarua.

English: Evaluate CBC implementation 2022.
Kiswahili: Tathmini utekelezaji wa CBC 2022.
Ekegusii: Renga CBC buna egoikeranigwa 2022.
Somali: Qiimeynta hirgelinta CBC 2022.
Dholuo: Nonro mar tich mar CBC 2022.

English: Painted stories of civic participation by women
Kiswahili: Hadithi zilizochorwa za ushiriki wa kiraia wa wanawake
Ekegusii: Emegano erikire buna abangina benyoreire amabaga gokora emeremo yyogokinia ebinyoro biabo.
Somali: Sheekooyin lagu sawiray oo ku saabsan ka qaybgalka muwaadiniinta haweenka
Dholuo: Sigendini molos gi piche manyiso kaka mon ne timo gik moko e ngima mar oganda

English: Part of civic education on fiscal responsibility
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya elimu ya kiraia juu ya wajibu wa kifedha
Ekegusii: Ensemo yechisemi chiobogesaku buna engencho yoborigereria igoro yechibesa chieserikari ase obokoreri bwabanto.
Somali: Qayb ka mid ah waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee mas'uuliyadda maaliyadeed
Dholuo: Puonj ma ji chiwo e wi wach ting' mar pesa

English: KNCHR starts clubs to teach students their constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KNCHR huanzisha klabu za kufundisha wanafunzi haki zao za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto KNCHR giachakire ebiombe goikera na gosomia abana igoro yoboronge bwabo bwa kemachiko.
Somali: KNCHR waxay bilaabeysaa kooxo lagu baro ardayda xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KNCHR chako grube mag puonjo jopuonjre chike mag sirkal.

English: The Ministry of Education partnered with Cisco to train 3000 TVET students in digital skills across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imeshirikiana na Cisco kuzoeza wanafunzi 3000 wa TVET katika ujuzi wa dijiti nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yabwatanire na ekeombe giense kiamangana aintaneti (Cisco) kwegeria abana 3000 ba TVET ochusi yegedichitari Kenya engima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa iskaashi la sameysay Cisco si ay u tababarto 3000 arday oo TVET ah xirfadaha dhijitaalka ah ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education noriwore gi Cisco e tiego jopuonjre 3000 mag TVET e yore mag digital e piny Kenya.

English: Ministry of Education organizes workshops on nutrition for school feeding program managers to enhance food quality and safety.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaandaa semina juu ya lishe kwa wasimamizi wa programu ya kulisha shule ili kuongeza ubora na usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoroberia ere amasomo yengaera eisaine omobere ase omoroberio bwokorageria chisukuru goikerania endagera ere nobotenenku na etabwati mochando ende.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabanqaabisaa aqoon isweydaarsiyo ku saabsan nafaqada maamulayaasha barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiyada si kor loogu qaado tayada iyo badbaadada cuntada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok timo chenro mar timo chokruok e wi wach chiemb chuny ne jotelo mag chenro mag chiemo e skunde mondo omed kelo ber kod ritruok mar chiemo.

English: Ministry of Education distributes science kits to primary schools to enhance practical learning.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hutoa vifaa vya sayansi kwa shule za msingi ili kuboresha kujifunza kwa vitendo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwa ere nakobaga ebinto biogosomera biegesayansi dgochia chisukuru chiboroso gokinia ogosoma ase ogokora.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qalabka sayniska u qaybiso dugsiyada hoose si loo xoojiyo barashada wax ku oolka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education osemiyo skunde mag sayans e skunde matindo mondo omed tiego nyithindo e yore mopogore opogore.

English: Free toolkits worth Ksh 100,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates in technical courses.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya bure vyenye thamani ya Ksh 100,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025 katika kozi za ufundi.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogochakia obosa bwechieiringi 100,000 ase abana bonsi omwaka 2025 ase abana baria bonsi bakorire amosomo (TVET).
Somali: Qalab qalab oo lacag la'aan ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 100,000 Ksh oo loogu talagalay dhammaan ardayda ka qalin jabisay barnaamijyada farsamada ee 2025.
Dholuo: Gige tich ma onge chudo ma romo Ksh 100,000 ne joma otieko tiegruok e tiegruogego duto e higa mar 2025.

English: UN supports grassroots civic education in 1,200 learning institutions.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa huunga mkono elimu ya raia katika taasisi 1,200 za elimu.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse (UN) ngosira chire amasomo obogesaku ome yechisukuru 1,200.
Somali: Qaramada Midoobay waxay taageertaa waxbarashada bulshada ee 1,200 oo hay'ado waxbarasho ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje (UN) riwo lwedo tiegruok mar oganda e riwruoge 1,200 mag puonjruok.

English: Ministry of ICT launches free online digital literacy courses designed specifically for women entrepreneurs and learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya TEHAMA yazindua kozi za bure za uandishi wa habari kidijitali mtandaoni zilizoundwa mahsusi kwa ajili ya wanawake wajasiriamali na wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) yaansire omoroberio obosa gosomia goeteera eintaneti igoro yechokosi chiegedichitari chirengete abangina abakori ebiasara na baria bagosoma.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay bilowday koorsooyin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan qorista iyo qorista dhijitaalka ah oo loogu talagalay haweenka ganacsatada ah iyo kuwa wax baranaya.
Dholuo: Od tich mar ICT ochako kos mag somo kod ndiko ma onge chudo ma olosi ahinya ne mon ma nigi ohala kod jopuonjre.

English: IEBC partners with 200 universities for voter education ahead of 2027 elections.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashirikiana na vyuo vikuu 200 kwa elimu ya wapiga kura kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2027.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) kibwatanire nechiyunifasiti 200 gosomia goaka chikura nyuma yobochori bwa 2027.
Somali: IEBC waxay iskaashi la sameysay 200 jaamacadood oo ku saabsan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ka hor doorashada 2027.
Dholuo: IEBC oseriwore gi yunivasiti 200 e tiego josiasa kapok itimo yiero mar 2027.

English: Encourage extracurricular activities.
Kiswahili: Kukuza shughuli za nje ya shule.
Ekegusii: Segeta abana gokora chigasi chinde isiko yamasomo.
Somali: Ku dhiirigelinta hawlaha dugsiga ka baxsan.
Dholuo: Jiw tije mamoko maok mag skul.

English: Live performance shared nationally
Kiswahili: Maonyesho ya moja kwa moja yanayoshirikiwa kitaifa
Ekegusii: Okworokia kwamaiso marore buna abana bagokora Kenya engima
Somali: Waxqabadka tooska ah ee la wadaago waddanka
Dholuo: Chokruok mitimo gi ji e piny mangima

English: Ministry of Education rolls out program to equip secondary schools with ICT labs and train teachers on usage.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inazindua mpango wa kuandaa shule za sekondari na maabara ya ICT na kuwazoeza walimu juu ya matumizi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkochakia ere omoroberio bwokobeka chisukuru chiesekenderi chibwate ebitabu biamasomo yokobwata na koenana amangana (ICT) naboigo kwegeria abarimi buna bakobitumia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay soo saartay barnaamij lagu qalabeynayo dugsiyada dhexe shaybaarada ICT iyo tababarka macalimiinta isticmaalka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education osechako chenro mar tiego skunde mag sekondari gi laboratori mag ICT kendo tiego jopuonj kuom kaka ginyalo tiyo gi teknoloji.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for course revision for 2022/2023 placement targeting 2021 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2021.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua jukwaa lake la marekebisho ya kozi kwa ajili ya nafasi za 2022/2023, ikilenga wagombea 2021 wa KCSE na wa zamani kutoka 2000 hadi 2021.
Ekegusii: emeroberio yaye yeintanetui gokonya abana gosaba amabaga yogosoa eyunifasiti kiaigoire emeroberio yaye ase abana baria barigetie koirorera chikosi oomwaka 2022/2023 ase abari bagochia gosoa ase abana bakorire esekenderi omwaka 2021 na baria banyuma korwa omwaka 2000 to 2021.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furtay boggeeda dib-u-eegista koorsooyinka 2022/2023 oo bartilmaameedsanaya 2021 musharixiinta KCSE iyo musharixinta hore laga bilaabo 2000 ilaa 2021.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oseyawo dhoot mare mar timo nonro mar tiegruok mar somo mar 2022/2023, moting'o jokanyo 2021 mag KCSE kod jogo mosedonjo e tiegruogno chakre higa mar 2000 nyaka 2021.

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development revised TVET curricula to align with industry needs for the 2020/2021 academic year.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mafunzo ya Kenya ilibadilisha mipango ya masomo ya TVET ili kuendana na mahitaji ya tasnia kwa mwaka wa masomo wa 2020/2021.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) gianchoreire omoroberio bwamasomo a TVET koreng'ana nokogania nokogania hwechifakitori omwaka bwamasomo 2020/2021.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu dib u eegay manhajka TVET si uu ula jaanqaado baahiyaha warshadaha sanadka waxbarasho ee 2020/2021.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ne oloko chenro mag tiegruok mag TVET mondo owinjre gi dwaro mag kambi e higa mar somo mar 2020/2021.

English: Government to establish more STEM resource centers in various regions to boost science education.
Kiswahili: Serikali kuanzisha vituo zaidi vya rasilimali za STEM katika mikoa mbalimbali ili kuongeza elimu ya sayansi.
Ekegusii: Esrikari neagache chisukuru chinyinge chibobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (STEM) chire nebitabu biogosoma gokinia chisemi chibosayansi.
Somali: Xukuumaddu waxay dhisi doontaa xarumo badan oo khayraadka STEM ah gobollada kala duwan si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada cilmiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mondo ochak kuonde mang'eny mag yudo mwandu mag STEM e gwenge mopogore opogore mondo omed jiwo tiegruok e weche sayans.

English: IEBC accredits 500 schools as voter education centers.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaidhinisha shule 500 kama vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) yaitabire chisukuru 500 gosomia igoro yogoakia chikura.
Somali: IEBC waxay aqoonsaneysaa 500 oo dugsi oo ah xarumo waxbarasho codbixiyeyaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC oyie gi skunde 500 kaka kuonde tiego josiasa.

English: TSC confirms automatic promotion for 25,000 teachers this month.
Kiswahili: TSC inathibitisha kukuza moja kwa moja kwa walimu 25,000 mwezi huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) kiaenekirie ogokinigwa kwabarimu 25,000 omotienyi oyo.
Somali: TSC waxay xaqiijineysaa horumarinta tooska ah ee 25,000 oo macalimiin ah bishaan.
Dholuo: TSC osenyiso ni jopuonj 25,000 biro yudo migepe mag tiegruok dwe ka dwe.

English: Prevent substance abuse in schools 2025.
Kiswahili: Kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya shuleni 2025.
Ekegusii: Tanga ogotumeka bobe kwa amariogo gose amarwa chisukuru omwaka 2025.
Somali: Ka hortagga isticmaalka maandooriyaha dugsiyada 2025.
Dholuo: Geng'o tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e skunde 2025.

English: Ministry of Education organizes training for school principals in leadership and management.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu huandaa mafunzo kwa wakuu wa shule katika uongozi na usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoroberia ere okwegeria kwabarimu abanene ase oborai nobotenereri .
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabanqaabisaa tababar loogu talagalay agaasimayaasha dugsiyada hogaaminta iyo maareynta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok chano tiegruok mar jotend skul e weche mag telo kod telo.

English: TVETA expands access to digital libraries for TVET students to improve research capacity and learning.
Kiswahili: TVETA huongeza upatikanaji wa maktaba za digital kwa wanafunzi wa TVET ili kuboresha uwezo wa utafiti na kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Aborai bwekeombe keria ekenene getenerete chikorechi chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria TVETA yagareirie na ogoikera chinyoma chiamasomo egedichitari ase abana bechikorechi chia TVET gokinia okorigia kwobong'aini oboyia gokong'ia okomanya nogosoma.
Somali: TVETA waxay ballaarineysaa helitaanka maktabadaha dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda TVET si loo wanaajiyo awoodda cilmi baarista iyo barashada.
Dholuo: TVETA miyo jopuonjre mag TVET thuolo mar yudo buge mag digital mondo omed bedo gi nyalo mar timo nonro kod puonjruok.

English: Council of Governors hosts sensitization sessions on devolved services.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana huandaa vikao vya ufahamu juu ya huduma zilizohamishwa.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire komanyia abanto igoro yobokorei bweserikari yechikaonti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay qabanqaabiyaan kalfadhiyo wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan adeegyada la wareejiyay.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch mar Pinje timo romo mar chiwo paro e wi tije mopogore opogore.

English: The Ministry of Education recruited 2500 TVET trainers to support vocational training programs across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imeajiri walimu 2500 wa TVET kusaidia mipango ya mafunzo ya kitaaluma kote Kenya.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yarigete abarimu 2500 ba TVET gosuira amasomo ochusi ao ao Kenya engima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay shaqaaleysiisay 2500 tababarayaal TVET si ay u taageeraan barnaamijyada tababarka xirfadeed ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ne ochoko jopuonj 2500 mag TVET mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag tiegruok mag tich e piny Kenya.

English: Ministry of Education publishes new career guidance textbooks for use in secondary schools nationwide.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inachapisha vitabu vipya vya mwongozo wa kazi kwa ajili ya matumizi katika shule za sekondari kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorweere oborai nemeroberio emeyia bwebinto abana bagochia gosomera ase chisukuru chionsi cjhiesekenderi Kenya engima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay daabacdaa buugaag cusub oo ku saabsan hagida xirfadda ee loo isticmaalo dugsiyada dhexe ee dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ogolo buge manyien mag tayo tije mag tich mondo otigo e skul mag sekondari e piny mangima.

English: Teachers Service Commission organizes digital content creation contest for innovative teaching materials.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inaandaa mashindano ya uundaji wa maudhui ya dijiti kwa vifaa vya kufundisha vya ubunifu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoroberia kere na kobwatania omoroberio bwogosindana ase ogosomia nebinto bigochia gosomigwa.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa tartan abuurista waxyaabaha dhijitaalka ah ee loogu talagalay agabyada waxbarasho ee hal-abuurka leh.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission chano piem mar loso gik manyien mag puonjo e yor digital.

English: TSC emphasizes the importance of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) integration in teaching and learning processes
Kiswahili: TSC inasisitiza umuhimu wa ujumuishaji wa Teknolojia ya Habari na Mawasiliano (ICT) katika mchakato wa kufundisha na kujifunza
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) kiabekire oborito ase etekinorochia yamangana na koererania (ICT) ase emeroberio yamasomo nenchera yogosomia.
Somali: TSC waxay xoojineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay isdhexgalka Teknolojiyada Macluumaadka iyo Isgaarsiinta (ICT) ee barashada iyo barashada
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ber mar tudruok mar Information and Communication Technology (ICT) e yore mag puonjo kod puonjruok

English: KICD develops specialized e-learning materials using sign language for deaf students.
Kiswahili: KICD huendeleza vifaa maalum vya e-kujifunza kwa kutumia lugha ya ishara kwa wanafunzi viziwi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nkorosia kere ebitabu biogosoma biabeene yegeintaneti goetera enkwana yebiorokererio ase abana baria batari koigwa (Emetino).
Somali: KICD waxay u soo saartaa agabyada barashada elektaroonigga ah ee gaarka loo leeyahay iyadoo la adeegsanayo luuqada calaamadaha ardayda maqalka la'aanta.
Dholuo: KICD tiyo gi dho momni e loso buge mag e-learning ne jopuonjre ma itgi odino.

English: Teachers Service Commission (TSC) to provide specialized training and resources for Special Needs Education (SNE) teachers.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu (TSC) kutoa mafunzo maalum na rasilimali kwa walimu wa Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalum (SNE).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu (TSC) mbarwe amasomo ebeene ase abarimu abeene na nechiofisi bakonyora okwegerigwa buna abana baria noborema ao ao bagosomigwa (SNE).
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka (TSC) si ay u siiyaan tababar iyo kheyraad takhasus leh macalimiinta Waxbarashada Baahiyaha Gaarka ah (SNE).
Dholuo: Commission for Teachers Service (TSC) mondo ochiw tiegruok makende kod mwandu ne jopuonj ma nigi dwaro makende mag somo (SNE).

English: National Treasury organizes awareness programs on tax and compliance.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Fedha ya Taifa huandaa mipango ya ufahamu juu ya ushuru na kufuata.
Ekegusii: Ekegancha ekenene nkoroberia kere igoro yokomanyia abanto amangana ogoikerani korwa ebango.
Somali: Hantidhawrka Qaranka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa barnaamijyo wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan canshuuraha iyo u hoggaansanaanta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar National Treasury chano chenro mag konyo ji ong'e weche motudore gi chulo osuru kod luwo chike mag sirkal.

English: National Education Strategic Plan 2023-2027 launched.
Kiswahili: Mpango Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Elimu 2023-2027 umezinduliwa.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwechisemi omonene okworokereria ebirengo neki bagochia gokora kere chingaki omwaka 2023-2027 oansire.
Somali: Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadda Waxbarashada Qaranka ee 2023-2027 oo la daahfuray.
Dholuo: Chenro mar somo mar piny mangima higa mar 2023-2027 osechako.

English: Non-compliant schools face closure.
Kiswahili: Shule zisizofuata sheria zinakabiliwa na kufungwa.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru chiataikeranie ogochika oko nabo chirasiekwe.
Somali: Dugsiyada aan u hoggaansamin waxay la kulmaan xiritaanka.
Dholuo: Skunde ma ok luw chike mag sirkal biro rumo.

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development revised TVET curricula to align with industry demands for the 2019/2020 academic year.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mafunzo ya Kenya ilibadilisha mipango ya masomo ya TVET ili kuendana na mahitaji ya tasnia kwa mwaka wa masomo wa 2019/2020.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiarosirie keboyia amasomo aTVET koreng'ana nokogania gwechifakitori ase omoroberio bwamasomo omwaka 2019/2020.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu dib u eegay manhajka TVET si uu ula jaanqaado baahida warshadaha sanadka tacliinta ee 2019/2020.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ne oloso chenro mag tiegruok mag TVET mondo oluwre gi dwaro mag ohala e higa mar somo mar 2019/2020.

English: Ministry of Education introduces digital platforms to enhance communication between parents and teachers.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaanzisha majukwaa ya dijiti ili kuboresha mawasiliano kati ya wazazi na walimu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwa ere emeroberio yogokong'ia okoererania amang'ana gati ya abaibori nabarimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay soo bandhigtay barnaamijyo dhijitaal ah si kor loogu qaado isgaarsiinta waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok chako tiyo gi yore mag digital mondo okony jonyuol gi jopuonj obed gi tudruok maber.

English: We will have the STEM pathways taking pure maths, and the other two pathways having a form of maths, so that we have maths in all three pathways in senior school
Kiswahili: Tutakuwa na njia STEM kuchukua hisabati safi, na njia nyingine mbili kuwa na aina ya hisabati, hivyo kuwa na hisabati katika njia zote tatu katika shule ya sekondari
Ekegusii: Ntotware omoroberio ebeene ase ebinto abana bagochia gosomera ase STEM goansera komanya buya goaka chisabu chiobobundi korora nga chisabu ngosomwa chire ase chisekenderi chinene.
Somali: Waxaan yeelan doonnaa wadooyinka STEM oo qaadanaya xisaabta nadiifka ah, iyo labada kale oo leh qaab xisaab ah, sidaa darteed waxaan haysan doonnaa xisaabta dhammaan saddexda wado ee dugsiga sare
Dholuo: Wabiro bedo gi yore mag STEM moting'o weche mag nonro, kendo yore mamoko ariyo biro bedo gi yo mar nonro.

English: IEBC uses door-to-door campaigns for remote voter awareness.
Kiswahili: IEBC hutumia kampeni za mlango kwa mlango ili kuongeza ufahamu wa wapiga kura kwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) goetera okomanyia abanto goetera omorangu ase omorangu aaria chingongo chia ime.
Somali: IEBC waxay isticmaashaa ololeyo albaab ilaa albaab si ay u ogaadaan codbixiyayaasha meel fog.
Dholuo: IEBC tiyo gi kampen mag dhoot ka dhoot mondo okony ji oyud thuolo mar yiero.

English: KICD provides guidelines and resources for continued home learning during the extended school closures.
Kiswahili: KICD hutoa miongozo na rasilimali za kuendelea kujifunza nyumbani wakati wa kufungwa kwa shule kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nkorwa kere oborai na ogokonya igoro yokogendera gosomera inka chingaki chisukuru chisiegete.
Somali: KICD waxay bixisaa tilmaamo iyo kheyraad si loo sii wado barashada guriga inta lagu jiro xiritaanka dugsiyada ee la kordhiyay.
Dholuo: KICD chiwo puonj koda mwandu mag dhi nyime gi puonjruok e ot e kinde mag tuech mag skul.

English: Universities urged to offer training on emerging technologies to prepare students for future job markets.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kutoa vifaa zaidi vya kozi vinavyopatikana kama Rasilimali Huria za Elimu (OER).
Ekegusii: Chiyunifasiti chiasoroirwe korwa amasomo igoro yechitekinorochi chiabono aerio koarigania abana kwebeka ang'e ase echiro yemeremo abwo motwe.
Somali: Jaamacadaha ayaa lagu booriyay inay bixiyaan tababar ku saabsan tiknoolajiyada soo koraya si ay ardayda ugu diyaariyaan suuqyada shaqada mustaqbalka.
Dholuo: Ne ojiw yunivasiti mondo ochiw tiegruok e wi teknoloji manyien mondo oik jopuonjre ne tije ma biro timore e kinde mabiro.

English: Includes civic dialogues and music
Kiswahili: Inajumuisha mazungumzo ya kiraia na muziki
Ekegusii: Gesa chinkwana chiobogesaku amo nechingero
Somali: Waxaa ka mid ah wada sheekaysiga muwaadiniinta iyo muusikada
Dholuo: Oting'o weche mag ji kod thum

English: National Treasury answers citizen queries on budget allocations.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Fedha ya Taifa hujibu maswali ya wananchi kuhusu uwekezaji wa bajeti.
Ekegusii: Ekegancha ekenene nkoiraneria kere abanainchi amaboria abo igoro yobobagi bwechibesa.
Somali: Hantida Qaranka waxay ka jawaabtaa su'aalaha muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan miisaaniyadda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar National Treasury dwoko penjo mag jopiny e wi pesa mitiyogo e loso bajet.

English: Integrate entrepreneurship 2023.
Kiswahili: Unganisha ujasiriamali 2023.
Ekegusii: Renta amo amasomo onsi 2023.
Somali: Isdhexgalka ganacsiga 2023.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi chenro mar bedo jatelo e higa mar 2023.

English: Mental health counselors deployed to 500 secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Washauri wa afya ya akili walitumwa katika shule 500 za sekondari.
Ekegusii: barimu bebirengererio nokweiranana batomirwe ase chisukuru chiesekenderi 500.
Somali: La-taliyayaasha caafimaadka dhimirka ayaa loo adeegsaday 500 dugsi oo dugsi sare ah.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma chiwo kony e weche thieth mag paro ne olendo e skunde 500 mag sekondari.

English: Includes dramatized short stories
Kiswahili: Inatia ndani hadithi fupi za kuigiza
Ekegusii: Gesa emegano yogoichania
Somali: Waxaa ka mid ah sheekooyinka gaagaaban ee riwaayadaha ah
Dholuo: Oting'o sigendni machuok

English: IEBC organizes forums on election integrity and preparedness for 2025.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaandaa vikao juu ya uadilifu wa uchaguzi na maandalizi ya 2025.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) yarosirie emesangererekano igoro yoboene nakwearigania ase obochori bwa 2025 2027.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabanqaabisaa madasha ku saabsan daacadnimada doorashada iyo diyaar garowga 2025.
Dholuo: IEBC chano chokruoge mag siasa e wi weche mag yiero kod ikruok ne yiero mar 2025.

English: KNEC begins pilot rollout of e-assessment systems in selected primary schools to improve evaluation methods.
Kiswahili: KNEC huanza utekelezaji wa majaribio ya mifumo ya tathmini ya elektroniki katika shule za msingi zilizochaguliwa ili kuboresha njia za tathamini.
Ekegusii: Amatemwa esekenderi KNEC giansire korenga chisukuru nke chiachoretwe goikerania okorengwa gwechisukuru.
Somali: KNEC waxay bilaabaneysaa barnaamijka tijaabada ah ee nidaamyada qiimeynta elektaroonigga ah ee dugsiyada hoose ee la doortay si loo hagaajiyo hababka qiimaynta.
Dholuo: KNEC chako tiyo gi yore mag e-evaluation e skunde ma ne oyier mondo okony e medo lony e yore mag timo nonro.

English: Kenya National Examinations Council starts collecting public feedback on the e-assessment system pilot phase.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Kitaifa la Majaribio ya Kenya linaanza kukusanya maoni ya umma juu ya awamu ya majaribio ya mfumo wa tathmini ya elektroniki.
Ekegusii: Ekembe keria ekenene getenerete amatemwa (KNEC) gichakire gorigia komanya buna abanto bari baikeretwe bakogeteba igoro yebikoreri biegechiditari bikorena amatemwa abana.
Somali: Golaha Imtixaannada Qaranka ee Kenya wuxuu bilaabay inuu ururiyo jawaab celinta dadweynaha ee ku saabsan marxaladda tijaabada ah ee nidaamka qiimeynta elektaroonigga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya National Examinations Council ochako choko paro mag ji e wi chenro mar e-evaluation.

English: Universities encouraged to develop and utilize Open Educational Resources (OER) for wider access to learning materials.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinahimizwa kutoa mafunzo kuhusu teknolojia zinazoibuka ili kuwaandaa wanafunzi kwa ajili ya masoko ya kazi ya siku zijazo.
Ekegusii: Chiyunifasity chiasegirwe korosia na gotumia ebinto biogosomera bigoikerwa na gosomwa bosa batari goakane kende (OER) kogarei na goikera gosomia na gosoma.
Somali: Jaamacadaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay horumariyaan oo ay adeegsadaan kheyraadka waxbarasho ee furan (OER) si ay u helaan waxyaabo waxbarasho oo ballaaran.
Dholuo: Ne ojiw universities mondo olos kendo oti gi Open Educational Resources (OER) mondo giyud thuolo momedore mar somo.

English: National Research Fund promotes cross-university research collaboration with shared funding and facilities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kitaifa wa Utafiti unaendeleza ushirikiano wa utafiti wa kati ya vyuo vikuu na fedha pamoja na vifaa.
Ekegusii: CChibesa chiomoroberio omonene bwa'masomo nkobwaterana bare na okorigia obomanyi oboyia ase ogosegeta obokongoria bwa amo korwa ekagancha ekemo nebikorerio bia amo.
Somali: Sanduuqa Cilmi-baarista Qaranka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa iskaashiga cilmi baarista ee jaamacadaha kala duwan iyada oo la wadaago maalgelinta iyo xarumaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Research Fund jiwo riwruok mar timo nonro e kind yunivasiti ka gitiyo gi pesa kaachiel gi gik makonyo.

English: KICD develops specialized digital learning content for visually impaired learners to enhance inclusivity.
Kiswahili: KICD huendeleza maudhui maalum ya kujifunza ya dijiti kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wa kuona ili kuongeza ujumuishaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nkorosia kere amasomo abeene egedichitari ase abana baria batari korora verio goikerania chisemi ase bonsi.
Somali: KICD waxay horumarineysaa waxyaabaha barashada dhijitaalka ah ee khaaska ah ee loogu talagalay bartayaasha indhaha la'aanta si loo kordhiyo ka mid noqoshada.
Dholuo: KICD loso weche mag somo moting'o weche mag digital ne jopuonjre ma nigi tuoche mag neno mondo okonygi bedo gi winjruok maber gi jomamoko.

English: [Free Education] Government reinforcement of free primary education policy with elimination of all levies and charges in public schools
Kiswahili: [Elimu ya bure] Serikali kuimarisha sera ya elimu ya msingi ya bure kwa kuondoa ushuru wote na ada katika shule za umma
Ekegusii: (Amasomo Abosa) Eserikari nesegetete amosomo abosa ase chisukuru chioboroso korengana nerichiko na korusia echogo ende yonsi ase chisukuru chioboroso chiserikari.
Somali: [Barashada Bilaashka ah] Xukuumadda oo xoojineysa siyaasadda waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah iyada oo la baabi'inayo dhammaan khidmadaha iyo kharashaadka iskuulada dadweynaha
Dholuo: [Tiegruok ma onge chudo] Sirkal medo jiwo chenro mar tiego nyithindo e tiegruok mapile maonge chudo, kendo tieko chudo kod chudo duto e skunde mag sirkal

English: KICD develops digital e-books with sign language videos embedded for deaf learners in primary schools.
Kiswahili: KICD huendeleza vitabu vya elektroniki vya digital na video za lugha ya ishara zilizoingizwa kwa wanafunzi viziwi katika shule za msingi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nkorosia ere ebitabu biegedichitari ase eintaneti ano na biria biechinkwana ase ebimanyererio nechifidio ase chisukuru.
Somali: KICD waxay horumarineysaa buugaag elektaroonig ah oo dhijitaal ah oo ay ku jiraan fiidiyowyada afka calaamadaha ee loogu talagalay ardayda maqalka la' ee dugsiyada hoose.
Dholuo: KICD loso buge mag e-book moting'o vidio mag dho momni ne joma itgi odino e skunde matindo.

English: Youth Agenda leverages TikTok to teach civic responsibility.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Vijana hutumia TikTok kufundisha uwajibikaji wa kiraia.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio nebirengererio biasase biarengananirie TikTok gosomia igoro yebinto babwenerete gokora gokinia ebinyoro biabo
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu TikTok ka faa'iideysanayaa barashada masuuliyadda muwaadinka.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere tiyo gi TikTok e puonjo ji bedo gi ting' mar bedo raia.

English: Govt releases 2025 academic calendar.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza kalenda ya masomo ya mwaka wa 2025.
Ekegusii: Eserikari gosokia omoroberio bwamasomo omwaka 2025.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo saartaa jadwalka waxbarashada ee 2025.
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo kalenda mar somo e higa mar 2025.

English: KICD and NGOs collaborate to develop inclusive learning aids for diverse learners including those with special needs.
Kiswahili: KICD na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali hushirikiana kutengeneza misaada ya kujifunza ya pamoja kwa wanafunzi mbalimbali ikiwa ni pamoja na wale walio na mahitaji maalum.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) amo NGOs biabwateranire korosia ebinto biria biokonya gosoma ase abana bonsi nabari bare noborema ao ao.
Somali: KICD iyo ururada aan dawliga ahayn waxay iskaashi la sameeyaan sidii ay u horumarin lahaayeen caawimaad waxbarasho oo ka kooban ardayda kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa u baahan baahiyo gaar ah.
Dholuo: KICD kod riwruoge maok nie sirkal tiyo kanyachiel e loso gik makonyo ji puonjore e yore mopogore opogore moriwo nyaka jogo ma nigi dwaro makende.

English: [CBC Implementation] Official implementation of Grades 4, 5, and 6 under Competency-Based Curriculum starting January 2020
Kiswahili: [Utekelezaji wa CBC] Utekelezaji rasmi wa Darasa la 4, 5 na 6 chini ya Mpango wa Elimu wa Msingi wa Uwezo kuanzia Januari 2020
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bweserikari okebetererio abana basome koreng'ana nokwenyara kwabo CBC goetera goikerania okgania kwaye ase abana bekerasi gia 4, 5, na 6 gochakera omotienyi bweritangani 2020
Somali: [Adeegsiga CBC] Hirgelinta rasmiga ah ee fasallada 4, 5 iyo 6 ee Manhajka ku salaysan aqoonta laga bilaabo Janaayo 2020
Dholuo: [CBC Implementation] Tiyo gi klas mar 4, 5 kod 6 e bwo chenro mar somo motenore kuom lony chakre Januar 2020

English: TSC to deploy 5,000 teachers to TVET institutions.
Kiswahili: TSC kutuma walimu 5,000 katika taasisi za Elimu ya Televisheni.
