Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) gotoma abarimu 5,000 tgochia chikorechi chiobobundi nochusi TVET.
Somali: TSC waxay 5,000 macallimiin u soo diri doontaa machadyada TVET.
Dholuo: TSC biro tiyo gi jopuonj 5,000 e tiegruok mag TVET.

English: KICD leads review of curricula to better integrate inclusive education principles for learners with disabilities.
Kiswahili: KICD huongoza ukaguzi wa programu za masomo ili kujumuisha vizuri kanuni za elimu ya pamoja kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) netangaine ase okorigereria buna abana bagomigwa erio korenta amo engencho yechisemi ase abana bonsi bari bare noboremaru ao ao.
Somali: KICD waxay hoggaaminaysaa dib u eegista manhajka waxbarasho si ay si ka wanaagsan ugu mideeyaan mabaadi'da waxbarashada oo dhanka ah ee ardayda naafada ah.
Dholuo: KICD tayo nonro mar chenro mag somo mondo oriw maber puonj mag tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre.

English: Government to expand the Digital Literacy Programme (DLP) to all primary schools, providing tablets and content for learners
Kiswahili: Serikali kupanua Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Dijiti (DLP) kwa shule zote za msingi, kutoa vidonge na maudhui kwa wanafunzi
Ekegusii: Eserikari negarei omoroberio bwechisemi chiegedichitari (DLP) ase chisukuru chioboroso chionsi, ase okorwa chikombiuta chiakoboko ase abana bonsi.
Somali: Dowladda oo ballaarin doonta Barnaamijka Aqoonsiga Dijital ah (DLP) dhammaan dugsiyada hoose, iyadoo la siinayo kiniiniyo iyo waxyaalo loogu talagalay ardayda
Dholuo: Sirkal mondo omed program mar Digital Literacy Programme (DLP) e skunde duto mag sekondari, ka gichiwo tablet kod gik manie iye ne jopuonjre

English: Ministry of ICT rolls out certification exams to validate digital literacy competencies among youth nationwide.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inazindua mitihani ya vyeti ili kuthibitisha uwezo wa kusoma na kuandika digital miongoni mwa vijana kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT yaansire omoroberio obeene bwokorenga chisemi na korwa chisatifketi ase abasae Kenya engima.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay soo saartay imtixaanada shahaadada si loo xaqiijiyo aqoonta akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dhalinyarada guud ahaan dalka.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT ochako penj mag yudo ratiro mondo onyis ni rowere nigi nyalo mar somo gi somo e yore mag digital e piny mangima.

English: [Digital Learning Initiative] Government rollout of 1.2 million digital devices including laptops for teachers and tablets for students to all 22,000 public primary schools
Kiswahili: [ Digital Learning Initiative] Serikali kutekeleza vifaa milioni 1.2 digital ikiwa ni pamoja na kompyuta ndogo kwa walimu na vidonge kwa wanafunzi kwa wote 22,000 shule za msingi za umma
Ekegusii: (Amasomo Abosa) Eserikari nesegerete amosomo abosa ase chisukuru chioboroso korengana nerichiko na korusia echogo ende yonsi ase chisukuru chioboroso chieserikari.
Somali: [Horshahaha Waxbarashada Dijital ah] Dawladdu waxay soo bandhigtay 1.2 milyan oo qalab dhijitaal ah oo ay ku jiraan laptops-ka macalimiinta iyo kiniiniyada ardayda dhammaan 22,000 dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha
Dholuo: [Digital Learning Initiative] Sirkal chako tiyo gi masinde mag digital milion 1.2 moriwo nyaka kompyuta moting'o kompyuta mag jopuonjre kod tablet mag nyithindo e skunde matindo duto 22,000 mag sirkal

English: Ministry of Education conducts training for teachers on digital formative and summative assessment techniques.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya mafunzo kwa walimu juu ya mbinu za digital formative na summative tathmini.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkwegeria ere abarimu buna obokoreri bwedichitari ase korenga amasomo abana ekero bare esukuru na motwe yamasomo abo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay macalimiinta u qabataa tababar ku saabsan farsamooyinka qiimeynta dhijitaalka ah iyo isku-darka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tayo tiegruok ne jopuonj e wi yore mag timo nonro e yore mag digital.

English: Kenya rebranded CBC to CBE to expand focus beyond curriculum into infrastructure and school systems.
Kiswahili: Kenya ilibadilisha jina la CBC kuwa CBE ili kupanua umakini zaidi ya mtaala katika miundombinu na mifumo ya shule.
Ekegusii: Kenya yakorire amaonchorerio yechisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara kwomwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) to CBE koigora ebirengererio motwe korora ng' amaagacho nobotenereri boigo biakeraniigwe.
Somali: Kenya waxay CBC u bedeshay CBE si loo ballaariyo diiradda ka baxsan manhajka dhismaha iyo nidaamyada dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya ne oloko nying mar CBC ni CBE mondo omed keto pachgi e weche mag tiegruok kod chenro mag skul.

English: At Muhomo Primary School in Lugari, World Vision and government stakeholders provided educational tablets preloaded with literacy and numeracy software (ABRA).
Kiswahili: Katika Shule ya Msingi ya Muhomo huko Lugari, World Vision na mashirika ya serikali yalitoa vidonge vya elimu vilivyojaa programu ya kusoma na kuandika (ABRA).
Ekegusii: Chikombiuta chinke chiakoboko chibekire amasomo kogokonya komanya chinamba (ABRA)
Somali: Dugsiga hoose ee Muhomo ee Lugari, World Vision iyo daneeyayaasha dowladda ayaa soo bandhigay kiniiniyo waxbarasho oo horay loo soo buuxiyey barnaamijka akhriska iyo xisaabinta (ABRA).
Dholuo: E skul mar Muhomo Primary School e Lugari, World Vision kod jotelo mag sirkal nochiwo tablet mag tiegruok moting'o software mar somo kod kwan (ABRA).

English: Council of Governors uses podcasts for public awareness.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri hutumia podcast kwa ajili ya ufahamu wa umma.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase chinkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay u adeegsadaan barnaamijyada podcasts-ka si ay dadku u ogaadaan.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch tiyo gi podcast mondo okony ji ong'e wachno.

English: Ministry of ICT collaborates with NGOs to hold nationwide workshops educating parents on digital tools and child online safety.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inashirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kufanya semina za kitaifa kuwaelimisha wazazi juu ya zana za dijiti na usalama wa watoto mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) nkbwaterana bare na NGOs ase okoumerana okonene gosomi abaibori igoro yebikoreri biedichitari na oborendi bwa'bana geintaneti.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay la shaqeyneysaa ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay u qabtaan aqoon isweydaarsiyo waddanka oo dhan oo loogu baro waalidiinta aaladaha dhijitaalka ah iyo badbaadada carruurta internetka.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT tiyo kanyachiel gi riwruoge maok nie sirkal mondo gitim chokruogego e piny mangima mondo gipuonj jonyuol e wi gige tigo mag digital kod ritruok mar nyithindo e Intanet.

English: NCIC introduces peace programs to prevent electoral violence.
Kiswahili: NCIC huanzisha mipango ya amani ili kuzuia vurugu za uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekepmbe giokoegerera abanto komenya amo buna abanto abamo (NCIC) giaansire emeroberio yogotanga chisegi chibwatekaine nobochori obonene.
Somali: NCIC waxay soo bandhigtaa barnaamijyo nabadeed si looga hortago rabshadaha doorashada.
Dholuo: NCIC chako chenro mag kuwe mar geng'o timbe mahundu mag yiero.

English: Prevent exam leakage 2020.
Kiswahili: Zuia uvujaji wa mtihani 2020.
Ekegusii: Tanga oboibi bwa amatemwa omwaka 2020.
Somali: Ka hortagga baxsiga imtixaanka 2020.
Dholuo: Geng'o weche mag penj mag 2020.

English: IEBC trains 10,000 teachers as voter educators nationwide.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawazoeza walimu 10,000 kama walimu wa wapiga kura nchini kote.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) kiaegerie abarimu 10,000 buna abasomia bechikura kenya engima.
Somali: IEBC waxay tababar u siineysaa 10,000 macallimiin oo ah barayaasha codbixiyayaasha dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: IEBC tiego jopuonj 10,000 e piny mangima kaka jopuonjo ji yiero.

English: Ministry of Education procures assistive technology devices to increase e-learning accessibility for students with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inachukua vifaa vya teknolojia ya kusaidia ili kuongeza upatikanaji wa e-kujifunza kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkogora ere ebinto biria bigikonya abaremaru gokora emeremo yabo amo namasomo erio gokinia ogosoma goetera eintanetiase abana abaremaru.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay soo iibsataa qalabka tikniyoolajiyadda taageerada si loo kordhiyo helitaanka barashada elektaroonigga ah ee ardayda naafada ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok yudo gik makonyo e yore mag teknoloji mondo okony jopuonjre ma nigi midekre obed gi thuolo mar puonjore e yor kompyuta.

English: National Research Fund expands grant opportunities focusing on interdisciplinary education research projects.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kitaifa wa Utafiti unaongeza fursa za misaada kwa kuzingatia miradi ya utafiti wa elimu ya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chiomoroberio omonene bwa'masomo okorigia okomanya okoyia namachibu yemechando ereo ogareirie okorwa chibesa ase abasomi orenegete chinsemo chiechisemi chionsi.
Somali: Sanduuqa Cilmi-baarista Qaranka wuxuu ballaarinayaa fursadaha deeqaha oo diiradda lagu saaray mashaariic cilmi baaris oo ku saabsan waxbarashada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Research Fund medo thuolo mag chiwo chiwo mag chiwo mag gweth ka giketo pachgi ahinya kuom tije mag timo nonro e wi tiegruok.

English: IEBC targets 80% youth voter turnout through campus outreach.
Kiswahili: IEBC inalenga 80% ya ushiriki wa wapiga kura vijana kupitia ufikiaji wa chuo kikuu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) nkerengete 80 ase emia goikera abasae buna abaaki chikura goetera omorobroberio bwokobaikera chiyunifasi chiabo.
Somali: IEBC waxay bartilmaameedsaneysaa 80% ka qaybgalka codbixiyayaasha dhalinyarada iyada oo loo marayo shabakadda.
Dholuo: IEBC dwaro ni rowere 80% oyud thuolo mar yiero kokalo kuom tiegruok e skundno.

English: Council of Governors releases e-learning content on devolution.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Wasimamizi huchapisha maudhui ya e-learning juu ya uhamisho.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire amasomo yegeintaneti igoro yobokoreri bwechikaonti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay sii daayaan waxyaabaha barashada elektaroonigga ah ee ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo weche mag e-learning.

English: NCIC partners with religious groups to promote peace.
Kiswahili: NCIC inashirikiana na vikundi vya kidini ili kuendeleza amani.
Ekegusii: Ekepmbe giokoegerera abanto komenya amo buna abanto abamo (NCIC) nkobwatana bare nebiombe biobonyasae kobeka omorembe.
Somali: NCIC waxay la shaqeysaa kooxo diimeed si loo horumariyo nabadda.
Dholuo: NCIC tiyo kanyachiel gi riwruoge mag din e jiwo kuwe.

English: Be alert! Communities, report trafficking risks to 116.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu! Jamii, ripoti hatari za usafirishaji haramu kwa 116.
Ekegusii: Renda kegima! Ebinyoro, karwe amang'ana gotanga okoibwa kwa abana goetera 116.
Somali: Bulshooyinka, ka warbixi khatarta ganacsiga 116.
Dholuo: Beduru motang', wachuru ne 116.

English: Teachers Service Commission launches digital skills bootcamp targeted at in-service teachers with limited ICT knowledge.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma kwa Walimu yazindua kambi ya mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kidijitali inayolenga walimu walio kazini wenye ujuzi mdogo wa TEHAMA.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu yaansire omoroberio obeene bwokwegeria abarimu gosomia amasomo egedichitari gose ochusiyegetekinorochia orengete abarimu baria bare emeremo korende bare nobomanyi oboke ase okoererania amangana (ICT).
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bilaabay tababar xirfadeed oo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay macallimiinta shaqada ku jira ee aqoonta ICT-ga xaddidan leh.
Dholuo: Komison mar Tich mar Jopuonj ochako bootcamp mar ng’eyo weche mag dijital ma ochung’ ne jopuonj ma ni e tich ma nigi rieko matin mar ICT.

English: Ministry of Education releases national guidelines for standardizing school infrastructure development.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza miongozo ya kitaifa ya kuboresha miundombinu ya shule.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwere omoroberio buna oboagachi bwebirasi bia abana bagomera bibwekaine Kenya engima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa soo saartay tilmaamo qaran oo ku saabsan hagaajinta horumarinta kaabayaasha dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ogolo chike ma tayo dongruok mar chenro mag tiegruok mag skul.

English: KPSEA and KILEA exams will run for five days starting October 27.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya KPSEA na KILEA yataendelea kwa siku tano kuanzia Oktoba 27.
Ekegusii: Amatemwa yekeombe giechisukuru chioboroso nokorengwa cisemi ase abana bechisikuru chioboroso KPSEA na keria gekorenga okomanya egesongo KILEA nigo oraire amatuko atano gochakera chitariki 27 chiomotienyi 10.
Somali: Imtixaannada KPSEA iyo KILEA waxay socon doonaan shan maalmood laga bilaabo Oktoobar 27.
Dholuo: KPSEA kod KILEA biro dhi nyime kuom ndalo abich kochakore Oktoba 27.

English: KICD calls for development of relevant e-learning content to support remote learning and digital education initiatives
Kiswahili: KICD inataka maendeleo ya maudhui muhimu ya e-learning kusaidia mipango ya kujifunza kwa mbali na elimu ya digital
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) yboririe okorosigwa ebitabu biegedichitari birengete amasomo goetera eintaneti gokonya abana baria bare risabu ime amo nayarengete chisemi goetera egedichitari.
Somali: KICD waxay ku baaqeysaa in la horumariyo waxyaabaha ku habboon barashada elektaroonigga ah si loo taageero barashada fog iyo dadaallada waxbarashada dhijitaalka ah
Dholuo: KICD dwaro ni oti gi e-learning mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag somo mabor kod tiegruok mar digital

English: Be alert! Report suspicious activities near schools to authorities.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu! Ripoti shughuli zinazotiliwa shaka karibu na shule kwa mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Ramokia amaiso! Manyia abagambi igoro yebinto biechitang'utang'u ang'e nesukuru.
Somali: Ka taxaddar! Warbixi dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh oo ku dhow dugsiyada mas'uuliyiinta.
Dholuo: Bed motang', nyis sirkal gik ma timore machiegni gi skunde.

English: CBC lessons on Radio Taifa from 10 AM daily.
Kiswahili: Masomo ya CBC kwenye Radio Taifa kuanzia saa 10 asubuhi kila siku.
Ekegusii: Ogosomia igoro yechisemi chirengete okobua (CBC) nkobe goetera Radio Taifa gochakera 4 chiamambia kera rituko.
Somali: Casharrada CBC ee Radio Taifa laga bilaabo 10 AM maalin kasta.
Dholuo: Puonj mag CBC e redio mar Taifa chakre sa apar okinyi pile ka pile.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2015 KCSE candidates to apply for TVET diploma and certificate courses with a deadline of May 31 2016.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2015 kutuma maombi ya kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Mei 31, 2016.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yaye yeintanetui gokonya abana baria bakorire amasomo esekenderi KCSE gotoma ogosaba kwabo ase omwaka 2015 gosoa TVET gosomera edipuloma nyuma yechitariki 31 chiomotieny 5 omwaka 2016.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay boggeeda u furtay musharixiinta 2015 KCSE si ay u dalbadaan koorsooyinka shahaadada iyo shahaadooyinka TVET iyadoo waqtigeedu yahay 31 May 2016.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ne oyawo websaitne ne jokanyo mag KCSE mar 2015 mondo oketgi e tiegruok mag diploma kod osetifiketi mag TVET gi giko tarik 31 dwe mar abich 2016.

English: Ministry of Education initiates review of ICT integration policies to align with new education technology trends.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaanzisha mapitio ya sera za ujumuishaji wa ICT ili kuendana na mwenendo mpya wa teknolojia ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoba ere nemeroberio yokorigereria keboyia kobwatania amachiko yamasomo yokobwata na kogacha amang'ana ICT koreng'ana nemeroberio yetekinorochia enyia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilaabaneysaa dib u eegis siyaasadaha isdhexgalka ICT si ay ula jaanqaadaan isbeddellada cusub ee tikniyoolajiyadda waxbarashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ochako nono chike mag tudruok e yore mag ICT mondo owinjre gi yore manyien mag tiegruok.

English: Street art blends youth themes and voting
Kiswahili: Sanaa ya barabarani huchanganya mandhari ya vijana na kupiga kura
Ekegusii: Chibicha chiatire gose konantigwa chinchera nechinyasi nkworokereria chire buna abasae babwenerete kobana goaka chikura
Somali: Farshaxanka jidadka wuxuu isku darayaa mawduucyada dhalinyarada iyo codbixinta
Dholuo: Lony mar nderni oriwo weche mag rowere kod yiero

English: Ministry of Education provides digital tools and training for PTAs to enhance communication and management.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hutoa zana za dijiti na mafunzo kwa PTA ili kuboresha mawasiliano na usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkogrwere ebonto bioegedichitari nokwegeria ase ebiombe bia'baibori na'barimu (PTAs) erio gokinia engencho yogokwanerana noborai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bixisaa qalab dhijitaal ah iyo tababar loogu talagalay PTAs si loo xoojiyo isgaarsiinta iyo maareynta.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education chiwo gige digital kod tiegruok ne PTAs mondo omed jiwo tudruok kod ritruok.

English: IEBC partners with KICD to include voter rights in Grade 8 Social Studies.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashirikiana na KICD kuingiza haki za kupiga kura katika masomo ya jamii ya darasa la 8.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) kiabwatanire nekeombe keria getenererte ebigosomigwa esukuru (KICD) kobeka boigo oboronge bwomoaki chikura ase amosomo ageredi 8 kobeka amasomo akemwanyabanto.
Somali: IEBC waxay iskaashi la yeelatay KICD si ay xuquuqda codbixiyeyaasha ugu darto daraasadaha bulshada ee fasalka 8.
Dholuo: IEBC noriwore gi KICD mondo oriw ratiro mag joma oyiero e tiegruok mar somo mar 8 mar social studies.

English: Signing of Return-to-Work Formula for universities.
Kiswahili: Kusainiwa kwa Fomula ya Kurudi Kazini kwa Vyuo Vikuu.
Ekegusii: Ogoitaba gwokoirana emeremo kwa abarimu bechiyunifasiti.
Somali: Saxiixidda qaabka dib u soo noqoshada shaqada ee jaamacadaha.
Dholuo: Riwo lwedo chenro mar duogo e tich e yunivasiti.

English: Teachers: Submit voter registration report by Nov 30 or face disciplinary action!
Kiswahili: Walimu: Wasilisha ripoti ya usajili wa wapiga kura ifikapo Novemba 30 la sivyo watachukuliwa hatua za kinidhamu!
Ekegusii: Abarimu: Toma erechesita ya baria bagochia goaka chikura bnyuma yechitariki 30 chiomotienyi 11 gose gose obogorerigwe egatambokero!
Somali: Macallimiinta: Warbixinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha soo gudbi 30-ka Nofeembar ama tallaabo cilmiga ah!
Dholuo: Jopuonj: Keturu ripot mar kwayo ji mondo oyier ji kapok tarik 30 Novemba ochopo!

English: Ministry of Education initiates mass distribution of e-books to complement paper-based textbooks for secondary learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaanzisha usambazaji mkubwa wa vitabu vya elektroniki ili kuongeza vitabu vya mafunzo vya karatasi kwa wanafunzi wa sekondari.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoba ere nemeroberio yokobaga ebitabi biegeintaneti erio gosira amasomo yebitabu biogomoma ase abana bechisekenderi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bilaabaysa qaybinta ballaaran ee buugaagta elektaroonigga ah si ay u dhammaystirto buugaag qoraal ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ochako chiwo buge mag e-book e okang' malach mondo omed konyo jopuonjre mag sekondari gi buge mag somo molos gi kalatese.

English: KUCCPS opened applications for artisan certificate courses for 2015 KCSE candidates with D- and below at TVET institutions closing May 31 2016.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua maombi ya kozi za vyeti vya ufundi kwa wagombea wa KCSE 2015 wenye D- na chini katika taasisi za TVET zilizofungwa Mei 31, 2016.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire ogotoma ogosaba gosoa chikosi chia artisan certificate omwaka 2015 ase abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa esekenderi KCSE baria banyore ekerengo gia D- na inse gosoa TVET omoroberio gosieka chitariki 31 chiomotienti 5 omwaka1 2016.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay codsiyada u furtay koorsooyinka shahaadada farsamada ee 2015 musharixiinta KCSE ee leh D- iyo ka hooseeya machadyada TVET ee la xiray 31 May 2016.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ne ochako kwayo mag tiegruok mag tij lwedo ne jogo ma ne dhi dhi dhi e KCSE e higa mar 2015 ma nigi digri mar D kata matin ne mano, e riwruoge mag TVET ma ne chiegni rumo tarik 31 dwe mar abich higa mar 2016.

English: Ministry of ICT seeks partnerships to expand digital infrastructure and connectivity to all schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inatafuta ushirikiano ili kupanua miundombinu ya dijiti na unganisho kwa shule zote.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT nkobwterana ere nerigetie sokobwaterana kogarei obokoreri bwegedichitari nogokereka chisukuru chionsi.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay raadineysaa wada shaqeyn si loo ballaariyo kaabayaasha dhijitaalka ah iyo isku xirnaanta dhammaan dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT dwaro riwruok mar owete mondo omed yaro chenro mag digital kod tudruok e skunde duto.

English: Ksh 430M allocated for primary literacy program (Grades 1-3).
Kiswahili: Ksh 430M hutolewa kwa ajili ya programu ya elimu ya msingi (Grades 1-3).
Ekegusii: Chisiringi chimirioni 430 gosira omoroberio bwamasomo ase chisukuru chioboroso chiarurwe ase abana bageredi (1-3).
Somali: Ksh 430M ayaa loo qoondeeyay barnaamijka akhriska aasaasiga ah (Fasalka 1-3).
Dholuo: Ksh 430M ne oket mondo otigo e tiego nyithindo e tiegruok mar somo kod somo (Grade 1-3).

English: The Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service opened its portal on January 24 2025 for 2024 KCSE students to apply for KMTC and TVET courses with a deadline of February 14 2025.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Uwekaji Kati ya Vyuo vikuu na vyuo vya Kenya ilifungua portal yake mnamo Januari 24, 2025 kwa wanafunzi 2024 wa KCSE kuomba kozi za KMTC na TVET na tarehe ya mwisho ya Februari 14, 2025.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gia Kenya ekenene getenenerete buna abana bagochorwa gosoa chiyunifasiti nechikorechi nkiaigorete omoroberio oye bweintaneti chitariki 24 omotienyi 1 omwaka 2025 for 2024 ase abana besekenderi KCSE gotoma ogsaba kwabo gosoa chikorechi ase chikosi chiobonyagitari KMTC na TVET nyuma yechitariki 14 chiomotienyi 1 omwaka 2025.
Somali: Adeegga Meelaynta Dhexe ee Jaamacadaha iyo Kulliyadaha Kenya wuxuu furay boggiisa Janaayo 24, 2025 ardayda 2024 ee KCSE si ay ugu dalbadaan koorsooyinka KMTC iyo TVET iyadoo taariikhdu tahay Febraayo 14, 2025.
Dholuo: Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service ne oyawo websait mare tarik 24 dwe mar Januar 2025 ne jopuonjre 2024 mag KCSE mondo okonygi e somo mag KMTC kod TVET gi giko tarik 14 dwe mar Februar 2025.

English: Ministry of Education organizes online continuous professional development training for teachers on CBC curriculum.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaandaa mafunzo ya maendeleo ya kitaaluma ya kuendelea kwa walimu kwa njia ya mtandao juu ya programu ya masomo ya CBC.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoroberia ere goetera eintaneti omeroberio bwamasomo akogenderera rioka igoro yogokinia chisemia ase abarimu igoro yomoroberio bwechisemi orengete okweneya gwa kere omwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC).
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabanqaabisaa tababarka horumarinta xirfadeed ee joogtada ah ee internetka ee macalimiinta ku saabsan manhajka CBC.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education chano tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiego jopuonj e yor intanet e wi chenro mar somo mar CBC.

English: Ministry of Energy collaborates with Ministry of Education to install renewable energy labs in secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Nishati inashirikiana na wizara ya elimu kuanzisha maabara ya nishati mbadala katika shule za sekondari.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechinguru chiomorero amo neminisitiri yechisemi chiabwateranire kobeka chinyomba chiobosansi chisekenderi chibwate chisola.
Somali: Wasaaradda Tamarta waxay la shaqeyneysaa wasaaradda waxbarashada si ay u rakibto shaybaarro tamar la cusboonaysiin karo dugsiyada dhexe.
Dholuo: Ministry of Energy tiyo kanyachiel gi Ministry of Education e keto laboratori mag teko manyien e skunde mag sekondari.

English: Machakos University launches Bachelor of Technology in Automotive Engineering.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Machakos chazindua Shahada ya Teknolojia katika Uhandisi wa Magari.
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Machakos yaansire amasomo etigiri ya tekinorochi ase oborosia bwechigari.
Somali: Jaamacadda Machakos waxay bilowday shahaadada koowaad ee cilmiga injineernimada baabuurta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti mar Machakos ochako somo mar teknolojia e weche mag loso mtoka.

English: TSC promotes 16,000 teachers to senior grades effective January 2026.
Kiswahili: TSC inakuza walimu 16,000 kwa darasa la mwisho kuanzia Januari 2026.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) giakinirie abarimu 16,000 gochia ebiredi biaigoro gochakera omotienyi omotang'ani 2026.
Somali: TSC waxay kor u qaadeysaa 16,000 oo macalin ah fasallada sare laga bilaabo Janaayo 2026.
Dholuo: TSC miyo jopuonj 16,000 dhi e klas madongo kochakore Januar 2026.

English: Submit TPAD data by June 30 to avoid payroll delays.
Kiswahili: Wasilisha data ya TPAD ifikapo Juni 30 ili kuepuka ucheleweshaji wa mishahara.
Ekegusii: Toma buna ogokora emeremo yao buna ogosomia buya (TPAD) nyuma yechitariki 30 chiomotienyi 6 gotanyoria ogochererigwa gwokobanga emeroberio yemesara.
Somali: Soo gudbi xogta TPAD 30-ka Juun si looga fogaado dib u dhac mushaharka.
Dholuo: Ket weche duto mag TPAD nyaka tarik 30 dwe mar auchiel mondo kik ichul osara.

English: Matatus feature civic messages on windows
Kiswahili: Matatus ina ujumbe wa kiraia kwenye madirisha
Ekegusii: Chirori chiobobogoria buna matatu nkonantia bare amasaka ase chinyasi chiechigari agomia amangana obogesaku
Somali: Matatus wuxuu muujiyaa fariimaha muwaadiniinta daaqadaha
Dholuo: Matatus oting'o ote mag raia e dirisa

English: KICD seeks collaboration with private publishers to develop more digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inatafuta ushirikiano na wachapishaji binafsi ili kuendeleza maudhui zaidi ya kujifunza digital.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nerigetie okobwaterana nabariki bebitabu bogwetenerera korosia ebitabu ao ao biegedichitari biogosoma.
Somali: KICD waxay doonaysaa in ay la shaqeyso daabacayaasha gaarka loo leeyahay si ay u horumariyaan waxyaabaha barashada dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: KICD dwaro tiyo kanyachiel gi jorit mag ohala mondo gipuonjre weche momedore e wi digital.

English: Over 90,000 teacher deficit hampers curriculum implementation.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya upungufu wa walimu 90,000 huzuia utekelezaji wa programu.
Ekegusii: Obokeanu bwabarimu goetania chirifu 90,000 ybeire akong'u goikerania omoroberio bwamasomo.
Somali: In ka badan 90,000 oo macallimiin ah ayaa caqabad ku ah hirgelinta manhajka.
Dholuo: Kwan mar jopuonj mokalo 90,000 ok nyal chopo chenro mag somo.

English: Ministry of ICT and KICD launch program to enhance digital literacy skills among parents to support home learning.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya TEHAMA na KICD yazindua mpango wa kuboresha ujuzi wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali miongoni mwa wazazi ili kusaidia ujifunzaji wa nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) na ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korosia amasomo agosomigwa (KICD) baansire omoroberio bwogosegeta yegedichitari nochusi ase abaibori gokonya amasomo aban chinka.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT iyo KICD waxay daah-fureen barnaamij lagu horumarinayo xirfadaha akhris-qorista dhijitaalka ah ee waalidiinta si loo taageero waxbarashada guriga.
Dholuo: Od tich mar ICT kod KICD ochako chenro mar medo ng’eyo somo mar dijital e kind jonyuol mondo okony somo e ot.

English: Ministry of Education unveils mobile application with interactive science experiments and tutorials for secondary learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inazindua programu ya simu na majaribio ya kisayansi ya maingiliano na mafunzo kwa wanafunzi wa sekondari.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yaansire omroberio bwogokonya abana begesayansi gosoma goetera chikombiuta nechismi erio tari gosoma rioka korende nakorora, gotema na korwa ekerengo eke gochia ekende ase abana bechisekenderi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay soo bandhigtay codsi mobile oo leh tijaabooyin saynis oo isdhexgal ah iyo casharro loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok ochiwo chenro mar tiyo gi gik moko e yore mag sayans kod somo ne jopuonjre mag sekondari.

English: Be flood-ready! Practice safe evacuation in schools.
Kiswahili: Uwe tayari kwa mafuriko!
Ekegusii: Eariganie! Egera enchera engiya yokominchoria korwa omorero hisukuru .
Somali: Diyaar u noqo daadadka!
Dholuo: Timuru chenro mar golo ji e skunde.

English: Voter education workshops begin in all public secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Warsha za elimu ya wapiga kura huanza katika shule zote za sekondari za umma.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano yogosomia buna chikura chigoakwa ngoansa ere ase chisekenderi chiserikari chionsi.
Somali: Waxqabadyada waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ayaa ka bilaabmaya dhammaan dugsiyada dhexe ee dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Chokruoge mag tiego josiasa chako e skunde duto mag sekondari.

English: Parents attend PTA meetings quarterly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi huhudhuria mikutano ya PTA kila robo mwaka.
Ekegusii: Abaibiro ikerana emesangerekano yabarimu na abaibori PTA nyuma ya kera emetienyi 4.
Somali: Waalidiintu waxay kaqeyb galaan kulamada PTA saddex biloodba mar.
Dholuo: Jonyuol dhiga e chokruoge mag PTA dwe ka dwe.

English: New policy: All TVET graduates get startup toolkits.
Kiswahili: Sera mpya: wahitimu wote wa TVET hupata zana za kuanza.
Ekegusii: Richiko riyia: baria bonsi bakorire amasomo abo korwa chikorechi chionsi chiobobundi na tekinorochia (TVET) banyorire ebikobasira gochaka emeremo yabo.
Somali: Siyaasadda cusub: Dhammaan ardayda ka qalin jabisay TVET waxay helayaan qalab bilow ah.
Dholuo: Puonj manyien: Jogo duto mosetieko tiegruok mar TVET yudo gige tich ma ginyalo chako tiyogo.

English: Youth Agenda organizes marathon events for voter awareness.
Kiswahili: Agenda ya Vijana huandaa matukio ya marathon kwa ajili ya ufahamu wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Achenda yabasae nkoroberia ere amasomo yokogenderera igoro yogoaka chikura.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa dhacdooyin marathon ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere chano marathon mondo okony ji ong'e wach yiero.

English: The U.S. Census Bureau today released a series of public service announcements (PSAs) to increase awareness and educate the public on the importance of the 2020 Census.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Idadi ya Watu ya Marekani leo ilitoa matangazo kadhaa ya huduma ya umma (PSAs) ili kuongeza ufahamu na kuelimisha umma juu ya umuhimu wa Idadi za Watu ya 2020.
Ekegusii: Eserikari ya America rero yatangasa emeroberio yeserikari (PSAs) gosokia okomanyia ba gosomia abanto igoro yobuya bwomobaro bwamanto o 2020.
Somali: Xafiiska Tirakoobka Mareykanka ayaa maanta soo saaray taxane ku saabsan ogeysiisyada adeegga dadweynaha (PSAs) si loo kordhiyo wacyiga iyo barashada shacabka ku saabsan muhiimadda Tirakoobyada 2020.
Dholuo: U.S. Census Bureau kawuono ogolo chenro mar lando weche mag sirkal (PSAs) mondo omed miyo ji ong'e kendo opuonjgi kuom gimomiyo nonro mar 2020 en gima duong'.

English: KCSE 2024 results released: Guidelines for remarking and appeals.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya KCSE 2024 yamechapishwa: Miongozo ya kutoa maoni na rufaa.
Ekegusii: Amairanerio yamatemwa a 2024 asokire: Omoroberio buna amatemwa ayio arairorerwe korigererigwa koreng'ana nogotaisaneka kwarokanete.
Somali: Natiijooyinka KCSE 2024 oo la soo saaray: Tilmaamaha faallooyinka iyo racfaanada.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne otimore e KCSE 2024: Puonj motudore gi chiwo paro kod kwayo mag ng'ado bura.

English: Ministry of Education implements a formal policy supporting distance learning across all education levels during COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatekeleza sera rasmi ya kusaidia elimu ya mbali katika ngazi zote za elimu wakati wa COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoikerania ere amachiko erengete ogosoma goetra eintaneti ase amasomo yebirengo bionsi chinaki chia COVID-19.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay hirgelineysaa siyaasad rasmi ah oo taageera waxbarashada fog heerarka waxbarashada oo dhan inta lagu jiro COVID-19.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tiyo gi chenro mar tiego ji e yore mopogore opogore e kinde mag COVID-19.

English: Distribute free textbooks to all students 2022.
Kiswahili: Samba vitabu vya kiada bila malipo kwa wanafunzi wote 2022.
Ekegusii: Karwe ebitabu biogosoma bosa ase abana bonsi 2022.
Somali: U qaybi buugaag waxbarasho oo bilaash ah dhammaan ardayda 2022.
Dholuo: Pogo buge mag somo maonge chudo ne jopuonjre duto e higa mar 2022.

English: Teachers Service Commission organizes interactive digital literacy workshops for teachers in underserved areas.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inaandaa semina za maingiliano za uandishi wa dijiti kwa walimu katika maeneo yasiyo na huduma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere ogocha amo goetera emesangerekano yechisemi chiegedichitari ase chingongo abarimi bare abake.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa aqoon isweydaarsiyo isdhexgal ah oo ku saabsan akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee macalimiinta meelaha aan la adeegsan karin.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ochano chenro mar timo tiegruok mag somo kod somo e yore mag digital ne jopuonj manie gwenge ma ji ok tiyogo maber.

English: Ministry of ICT partners with NGOs to provide digital skills training in informal urban settlements.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inashirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutoa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa dijiti katika makazi yasiyo rasmi ya mijini.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT nkobwaterana bare na NGOs korwaochusi yegedichitari ase emechie nebinyoro.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay iskaashi la yeelatay ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay tababar ku siiyaan xirfadaha dhijitaalka ah ee degmooyinka magaalooyinka aan rasmiga ahayn.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT oseriwore gi riwruoge maok nie sirkal mondo gichiw tiegruok e weche mag digital skills e mier ma ok ochan.

English: Be ready! Practice earthquake drills in schools.
Kiswahili: Jitayarishe! Fanya mazoezi ya matetemeko ya ardhi katika shule.
Ekegusii: Eariganie! Egera igoro yomotengecho
Somali: Isku day tababarrada dhulgariirka ee dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Timuru tiegruok mag yiengni mag piny e skunde.

English: Ministry of Education to equip more school laboratories to improve practical teaching and learning of sciences.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu kuandaa maabara zaidi ya shule ili kuboresha ufundishaji wa vitendo na kujifunza sayansi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi tnebeke ebiganeirie ase chinyomba chiobosansi gokinia amasomo ase ogokora, nagosomia obosayansi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada in lagu qalabeeyo shaybaarro badan oo dugsiyada ah si loo hagaajiyo barashada iyo barashada cilmiga.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok mondo oti gi laboratori mang'eny mag skul e medo tiegruok koda puonjruok sayans.

English: Parents and guardians establish secondary schools for KCPE 2023 candidates.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi huanzisha shule za sekondari kwa wagombea wa KCPE 2023.
Ekegusii: Abaibori nabakonyi bande baansire koagacha chisukuru chiesekenderi ase abana bakorete amatemwa KCPE 2023
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo mas'uuliyiinta ayaa aasaasaya dugsiyada dhexe ee musharixiinta KCPE 2023.
Dholuo: Jonyuol kod jorit chako skunde mag sekondari ne joma dhi yudo KCPE 2023.

English: Half-time used for civic talks
Kiswahili: Nusu ya muda inayotumika kwa mazungumzo ya kiraia
Ekegusii: Obogati-gti bwechinsa gokwanerana amangana obogesaku
Somali: Qeybta waqtiga loo isticmaalo wadahadalada rayidka ah
Dholuo: Tiyo gi seche moko e chokruoge mag sirkal

English: TSC deploys 5,000 teachers to TVET institutions nationwide.
Kiswahili: TSC inaweka walimu 5,000 katika taasisi za TVET kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) ngotoma ere abarimu 5,000 gochia chikorechi chia TVET Kenya engima.
Somali: TSC waxay 5,000 macallimiin u dirtaa machadyada TVET ee dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: TSC tiyo gi jopuonj 5,000 e tiegruok mag TVET e piny mangima.

English: Ministry of Education and Agriculture partner to improve school feeding programs to boost student attendance and learning.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu na Kilimo inashirikiana kuboresha programu za kulisha shule ili kuongeza mahudhurio na ujifunzaji wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi na eyoboremi chiabwatanire kobeka buya omoroberio bwokorageria chisukuru orengete korora nga abana mbarema goika esukuru gosoma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Beeraha waxay iskaashi la sameysay si loo wanaajiyo barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiyada si kor loogu qaado kaqeybgalka ardayda iyo barashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education and Agriculture oseriwore mondo okony e medo chenro mag chiemo e skul mondo okony e miyo jopuonjre odhi nyime puonjore.

English: Open schools! Enroll refugee children in education.
Kiswahili: Fungua shule! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi katika elimu.
Ekegusii: Igora chisukuru! Anchera abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo ase chisemi.
Somali: Dugsiyada fur, caruurta qaxootiga ku qor waxbarashada.
Dholuo: Yie mondo nyithindo ma gin joma oringo thuchegi odhi e skul.

English: Ministry of Education launches mobile app to monitor school feeding program activities and ensure transparency.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua programu ya simu ili kufuatilia shughuli za mpango wa kulisha watoto shuleni na kuhakikisha uwazi.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yaansire omoroberio bwechisimi ogokonya abarai, abaibori na baria bande bare nokobua kobwatia, koraa, ana korenda emeroberio yechiukuru goetera egedichitari igiro yomoroberio bwokoragaria erio goikerania ng'a ayio ngokoreka are maiso marore.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa daahfurtay barnaamij moobayl ah si loola socdo hawlaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada iyo hubinta hufnaanta.
Dholuo: Od tich mar somo ogolo program mar simu mar luwo tije mag chenro mar chiwo chiemo e skul kendo neno ni weche duto timore e yo maler.

English: Stories highlight gender-inclusive civic action
Kiswahili: Hadithi zinaonyesha hatua za kiraia zinazojumuisha jinsia
Ekegusii: Emegano nkworokia ere igoro yamasomo yobogesaku neki obwenerete gokora ase bonsi.
Somali: Sheekooyinku waxay soo bandhigaan dhaqdhaqaaq dadweyne oo ku lug leh jinsiga
Dholuo: Sigendni wuoyo kuom timbe ma ji timo e kind chwo gi mon

English: Uniforms and IDs from Jan 6, 2025.
Kiswahili: Mavazi na vitambulisho kutoka Januari 6, 2025.
Ekegusii: Chiyunifomu amo nebibande gochakera chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotang'ani , omwaka 2025.
Somali: Dharka iyo aqoonsiga laga bilaabo Janaayo 6, 2025.
Dholuo: Rupe kod ID mar Januar 6, 2025.

English: KICD urges schools to embrace e-learning platforms to ensure continuity of learning during unforeseen emergencies.
Kiswahili: KICD inahimiza shule kukumbatia mifumo ya kujifunza mtandaoni ili kuhakikisha mwendelezo wa kujifunza wakati wa dharura zisizotarajiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) yaboririe chisukuru kobwata omoroberio bwamasomo goetera eintaneti goikerania kogendera gosoma kwa abana ekero emebasekano ao ao egocha.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dugsiyada inay qaataan barnaamijyada barashada elektaroonigga ah si loo hubiyo joogteynta barashada inta lagu jiro xaaladaha degdegga ah ee aan la filayn.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo skunde mondo oti gi e-learning platforms mondo gisik ka gipuonjore e kinde mag chandruok maok ne.

English: KNCHR educates citizens on inclusion of marginalized communities.
Kiswahili: KNCHR huwaelimisha wananchi kuhusu kuingiza jamii zilizoachwa kando.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto KNCHR ngosomia kere okoretwa amo nabaria batigaerete nyuma gose gochaywa.
Somali: KNCHR waxay muwaadiniinta ku baraysaa ku darista bulshooyinka marginalized.
Dholuo: KNCHR puonjo jokanyo e wi tiego joma odak e alworagi.

English: Grade 6 register for KPSEA by Feb 28.
Kiswahili: Darasa la 6 jiandikishe kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28.
Ekegusii: Abana bageredi gia 6 kwerika ase okorengwa na KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiotienyi 2.
Somali: Diiwaangelinta heerka 6 ee KPSEA 28-ka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KPSEA mar Grade 6 nyaka tarik 28 dwe mar Februar.

English: Introduces a real-time, non-intrusive AI system for ASL learning.
Kiswahili: Inaanzisha wakati halisi, yasiyo ya kuingiliana AI mfumo kwa ajili ya kujifunza ASL.
Ekegusii: Korenta chisemi chiegepandia chinyia chiranyare gokonya amasomo aaria ase chingongo chinyomo.
Somali: Waxay soo bandhigeysaa nidaam AI ah oo waqtiga dhabta ah, oo aan faragelin u lahayn barashada ASL.
Dholuo: Ochiwo chenro mar tiyo gi AI e kinde masie mondo okony ng'ato opuonjre ASL.

English: KICD signs agreements with private ed-tech firms for co-development and distribution of digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inasaini makubaliano na makampuni binafsi ya teknolojia ya elimu kwa ajili ya ushirikiano wa maendeleo na usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza digital.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) baigwananire nabanyabiasara ase emeroberio isiko yeserikari okorokwa ed-tech firms korosia na kobaga ebinto biogosomera goetera ientaneti.
Somali: KICD waxay heshiisyo kala saxiixdaa shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay ee tiknoolajiyada waxbarashada si ay u wada horumariyaan oo ay u qaybiyaan waxyaabaha barashada dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: KICD timo singruok gi kambi mag teknoloji mag digital mondo giti kanyachiel gi ji e loso kod pogo weche mag digital learning.

English: Unveiling of Malava KMTC.
Kiswahili: Kufunuliwa kwa Malava KMTC.
Ekegusii: Ogochaka gwekorechi yobonyagitari KMTC ya Malava.
Somali: Soo bandhigida Malava KMTC.
Dholuo: Fweny mar Malava KMTC.

English: 500 schools get free counseling rooms. book a session with your principal!
Kiswahili: Shule 500 hupata vyumba vya ushauri bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Chisukuru amagana 5 (500) chianyorire ebonyomba biogokorerwa obosemia. Saba konyora ribaga eiobosemia nomwalimu oo
Somali: 500 dugsi waxay helayaan qolal la talin oo lacag la'aan ah. Kalfadhiga la qabso macalinkaaga!
Dholuo: Skunde 500 yudo kuonde miyudoe puonj maonge chudo.

English: Meeting with university unions on strike resolution.
Kiswahili: Mkutano na vyama vya chuo kikuu juu ya azimio la mgomo.
Ekegusii: Koumerana nebiombe bieyunifasiti igoro yokonyora amachibu na gokora okogira kwemeremo.
Somali: Kulan la yeeshay ururada jaamacadaha oo ku saabsan go'aanka shaqo joojinta.
Dholuo: Wuoyo gi riwruoge mag josomo mag yunivasiti e wi wach kawo okang' mar kwedo tijno.

English: KICD explores ways to integrate indigenous knowledge and practices into the school curriculum.
Kiswahili: KICD inachunguza njia za kuingiza maarifa na mazoea ya wenyeji katika programu ya masomo ya shule.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nkorigia kere chinchera chiokobwatania chisemi chiokoiborwa na gokorera amo gochia amasomo ari agasomigwa chisukuru.
Somali: KICD waxay sahamineysaa siyaabo lagu ku dari karo aqoonta iyo dhaqanka dadka hooyooyinka ah barnaamijka waxbarashada dugsiga.
Dholuo: KICD nono yore mag keto ng'eyo kod timbe mag jopiny e program mar skul.

English: Ministry of ICT launches digital skills training programs aimed at young entrepreneurs to foster innovation and startups.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya TEHAMA yazindua programu za mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kidijitali zinazolenga wajasiriamali wachanga ili kukuza uvumbuzi na makampuni mapya.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) yaansire omoroberio bwogosomia ochusi yegedichitari orengete abase abake bare nebirengererio biogochaka ebiasara na babwate obmanyi bwokorora emechando na koyekora goetra ebinto bakorosia gose getekonorochi.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT-da waxay bilowday barnaamijyo tababar xirfadeed oo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay ganacsatada da'da yar si loo kobciyo hal-abuurka iyo shirkadaha cusub.
Dholuo: Od tich mar ICT ochako chenro mag puonjo ji ng’eyo yore mag dijital ma ochung’ ne jopur matindo mondo opuonj loso gik manyien kod loso gik manyien.

English: Stay safe! Schools, teach students about trafficking risks.
Kiswahili: Kaeni salama! Shule, wafundisheni wanafunzi kuhusu hatari za usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu.
Ekegusii: Menya buya! Chisukuru, somia abana igoro yomochando bwokoibwa kwa abana.
Somali: Iskuullada, ardayda baro khatarta ganacsiga.
Dholuo: Sikuru ka un gi ritruok!

English: Ministry of Education promotes inclusive sports programs encouraging participation of learners with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu huendeleza mipango ya michezo ya pamoja inayohimiza ushiriki wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nere nomoroberio bwogosegeta chigosori ase abana bonsi nonya nabaremaru aase okobaa emioyo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dhiirigelisay barnaamijyo isboorti oo ka kooban oo dhiirrigeliya ka qaybgalka ardayda naafada ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo chenro mag tuke moriwo ji duto mondo ojiw jopuonjre ma nigi midekre mondo oriwgi lwedo.

English: Develop e-books 2021.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vitabu vya kielektroniki 2021.
Ekegusii: Rosia ebitabu biegetekinorochia 2021.
Somali: Horumarinta buugaagta elektaroonigga ah ee 2021.
Dholuo: Ti gi buge mag e-book e higa mar 2021.

English: Government commits to a phased provision of modern science laboratory equipment to all public secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Serikali inajitolea kutoa vifaa vya kisasa vya maabara ya sayansi kwa shule zote za sekondari za umma.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarire eira koagacha chinyomba chiobosayansi chiabomo na gochibeka ebiganeirie ase chisukuru chiesekenderi chionsi chiserikari.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ballanqaadeysaa in dhamaan dugsiyada dhexe ee dadweynaha ay si tartiib tartiib ah u siiyaan qalabka shaybaarka sayniska ee casriga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal oseng'ado mar miyo skunde duto mag sekondari thuolo mar yudo gige thieth mag sayans.

English: Youth Agenda introduces hackathons to design youth policies.
Kiswahili: Agenda ya Vijana huanzisha hackathons ili kubuni sera za vijana.
Ekegusii: Achenda yaasae goetera okobwaterana korosia amachiko agosira abasae.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyaradu wuxuu soo bandhigayaa hackathons si loo qaabeeyo siyaasadaha dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere oting'o chenro mar loso chenro mag rowere.

English: Youth Agenda mentors youth on governance and civic duty.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Vijana inawafundisha vijana kuhusu utawala na wajibu wa kiraia.
Ekegusii: Baria bagokonya abasae ase ebirengererio biabo ase obogambi nebi babwenerete gokora.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu dhallinyarada ku taliyaa maamulka iyo waajibaadka rayidka ah.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere konyo rowere mondo ong'e yore mag locho kendo timo migepe mag oganda.

English: Workshops held at traffic stages
Kiswahili: Warsha zilizofanyika katika hatua za trafiki
Ekegusii: Ogocha amo ase amasomo nkwabete ase chinsemo gete ogoichorerana kwa abanto kore.
Somali: Tababarro lagu qabtay marxaladaha taraafikada
Dholuo: Chokruoge ma itimo e nderni

English: Government procures and distributes modern technical equipment to TVET institutions to boost practical skills.
Kiswahili: Serikali hupata na kusambaza vifaa vya kisasa vya kiufundi kwa taasisi za Elimu ya Televisheni ili kuongeza ujuzi wa vitendo.
Ekegusii: Eserikari nkogora ere na korwa ebinto biegetekinorochia gochia chisukuru chionsi chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) kogesa chinguru amasomo yemeremo yamaboko.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo iibsataa oo u qaybiso qalab farsamo oo casri ah hay'adaha TVET si kor loogu qaado xirfadaha dhabta ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal yudo kendo pogo gige tiegruok mag teknoloji ma kindegi ne tigo e tiego jopuonjre e yore mopogore opogore mondo okony ji obed gi lony e tijno.

English: Grow skills! Equip schools with agricultural training labs.
Kiswahili: Kuza ujuzi! Panga shule na maabara ya mafunzo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Kinia ochusi! Agacha chinyomba chiobosayansi bwoboremi chisukuru.
Somali: Iskuulka ku qalabeeya shaybaarada tababarka beeraha.
Dholuo: Med lony, kendo ik skul gi laboratori mag tiego ji e weche mag pur.

English: Council of Governors rewards counties excelling in citizen education.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri huwathawabisha wilaya zilizo bora katika elimu ya raia.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nkorwa ore ebiigegwa ase chikaonti chiria chigokora buya ase okomanyia abanto babo igoro yekaonti yabo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay abaalmarin u siiyaan degmooyinka ka fiican waxbarashada muwaadiniinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo mich ne kaunti ma nigi lony e puonjo raia.

English: Ministry of Education initiates campaigns promoting STEM careers targeting rural secondary school students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inazindua kampeni za kukuza kazi za STEM kwa wanafunzi wa shule za sekondari za vijijini.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkoba ere nemeroberio yogoseta abana gosomera obosayansi, etekinorochia, oboinchinia nechisabu STEM orengete abana bechisekenderi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilowday olole lagu dhiirrigeliyo xirfadaha STEM oo loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare ee miyiga.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education osechako kampen mar jiwo tije mag STEM ne jopuonjre mag sekondari mag gweng'.

English: Mental health boost in Kenya: 32 counselors graduate in Thika to tackle depression, trauma, and substance abuse. Africana College Director Dr. Susan Gitau urges government to fund county-level counseling centers to expand access to lifesaving psychosocial support.
Kiswahili: Kuimarika kwa afya ya akili nchini Kenya: Washauri 32 wahitimu huko Thika ili kukabiliana na mfadhaiko, kiwewe, na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya. Mkurugenzi wa Chuo cha Africana Dkt. Susan Gitau anahimiza serikali kufadhili vituo vya ushauri nasaha vya ngazi ya kaunti ili kupanua ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa kisaikolojia unaookoa uhai.
Ekegusii: Ogosegetwa okonene ase amarwaire yobongo: Abasemia bo'bongo 32 babete bagosoka bene korwa esukuru ya thika erio gokonya ase ebirengererio ebinge, emechando yogosiria amo na nayande abwetekaine obongo.
Somali: Kordhinta caafimaadka maskaxda ee Kenya: 32 lataliye ayaa ka qalin jabiyay Thika si ay ula qabsadaan niyadjabka, dhaawaca, iyo xadgudubka maandooriyaha. English: ARTICLE 19 urges the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Sudan and the International Criminal Court to specifically consider how the information war in Sudan exacerbates harm to civilians, obstructs vital documentation of gross human rights and humanitarian law violations, and contributes to the commission of crimes.
Kiswahili: KIFUNGU CHA 19 kinahimiza Ujumbe Huru wa Kimataifa wa Kutafuta Ukweli kuhusu Sudan na Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Jinai kuzingatia mahususi jinsi vita vya habari nchini Sudan vinavyozidisha madhara kwa raia, kuzuia uandishi muhimu wa haki za binadamu na ukiukwaji mkubwa wa sheria za kibinadamu, na kuchangia katika utendaji wa uhalifu.
Ekegusii: RICHIKO 19 nigo rigosorora Ekeombe giense Giechinse Chikwegambera ase omoroberio obo bwokomanya ekeene igoro ya Sudan amo Nekoti Yense Egotema Obosaria erigererie buna amang'ana esegi aaria Sudan nigo gokogarei emechando gochia abanainchi, gotanga goikera amangana aganeirie gosoa ekina kiobosaria bwiboronge bwamwanyabanto na ase okobuna amachiko yobokemwanyabanto, na korwa amangana gochia abateneneri bekeombe kioboronge bwamwanyabanto igoro yamamocho.
Somali: Qodobka 19 wuxuu ku boorinayaa Howlgalka Xaqiijinta Caalamiga ah ee Madaxbanaan ee Suudaan iyo Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Caalamigeed inay si gaar ah u tixgeliyaan sida dagaalka macluumaadka ee Suudan uu u sii darayo waxyeelada ay u geystaan dadka rayidka ah, u horjoogsanayo dukumiintiyada muhiimka ah ee ku saabsan xadgudubyada waaweyn ee xuquuqda aadanaha iyo sharciga bani'aadamnimada, isla markaana gacan ka geysta fal dambiyo ah.
Dholuo: SULA MAR 19 jiwo riwruok mar International Independent Fact-Finding Mission on Sudan kod International Criminal Court mondo onon adimba kaka lweny mar weche e piny Sudan medo hinyruok mar tuoche ma dhano yudo, geng'o weche madongo ma nyiso ketho chike mag dhano kod chike mag oganda dhano, kendo okonyo e timo timbe mahundu.

Dholuo: Rescue Centre Torture Probe: Joma kedo ne ratiro mag dhano kwayo jotelo manie alworagi mondo owe keto weche mag siasa e wi weche ma ji wacho ni osetimnegi e Eldoret Rescue Center.

English: Panyako faults delayed by-elections, urges swift reconstitution of IEBC
Kiswahili: Dhambi ya Panyako ya kuchelewesha uchaguzi wa kikatiba, inahimiza ujenzi wa haraka wa IEBC
Ekegusii: Panyako omochirie okonyorwa kwobochori oboke ba korwa okoboria kwayererigwa okobekwa aroro gwa IEBC.
Somali: Khaladaadka Panyako ayaa dib u dhigay doorashooyinka gaarka loo leeyahay, wuxuu ku boorinayaa dib-u-dhiska degdegga ah ee IEBC
Dholuo: Piny Panyako okethore nikech yiero ma ne otim bang'e, okwayo mondo otim lokruok mapiyo e riwruok mar IEBC

English: The registrar @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu urges parliament to fast track the enactment of election-related legislation. Late enactments negatively affect the planning of elections.
Kiswahili: Msajili @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu anahimiza bunge kuharakisha utekelezaji wa sheria zinazohusiana na uchaguzi. Kupitishwa kwa sheria kuchelewa kunaathiri vibaya upangaji wa uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Omoriki oyo Orosagia bwe,Biombe bia siasa [ORPP], Anne Nderitu obooriri ekegambiro gie' bunge kobwatia bwango obokoreri bwa'amachiko yobochori na korara ngokare emeremo Ababunge baise konyoria amachiko ayi, nabo aratebania emeroberio emiya ya' obochori
Somali: Diiwaanka @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu waxay Baarlamaanka ugu baaqeysaa inay si dhakhso leh ula socdaan ansixinta sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka.
Dholuo: Ng'at ma ndiko weche mag piny @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu, jiwo bura mar piny mondo okaw okang' mapiyo mar loso chike motudore gi yiero.

English: Meru County Commissioner urges residents who need government services to make use of Huduma Centre.
Kiswahili: Kamishna wa Kaunti ya Meru anawasihi wakazi wanaohitaji huduma za serikali kutumia Kituo cha Huduma.
Ekegusii: omogambi omonene buekaunti orure okoboria ase baria batagete obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha degmada Meru wuxuu dadka deggan ee u baahan adeegyada dowladda ku boorinayaa inay adeegsadaan Xarunta Huduma.
Dholuo: Komisa mar County mar Meru jiwo jogweng'o madwaro tije mag sirkal mondo oti gi Huduma Centre.

English: Murang'a Senator Irungu Kang ata urges EACC, DCI not to be used to settle political scores
Kiswahili: Seneta wa Murang'a Irungu Kang ata anawasihi EACC, DCI kutotumiwa kufanya hesabu za kisiasa
Ekegusii: omoseneta omurang'a irungu kang'ata oboririe ekeombe klgiokorwania obokurumi, ekeombe kiobotuki mbabaisa koba bagokora emeremo yabo ase ogwanchereria gwa siasa.
Somali: Senatorka Murang'a Irungu Kang ata wuxuu ku booriyay EACC, DCI in aan loo isticmaalin in lagu xaliyo dhibcaha siyaasadeed
Dholuo: Senator Murang'a Irungu Kang ata jiwo EACC, DCI mondo kik otigo e loso weche mag siasa

English: Residents urged to participate in the budget making process through public participation, to familiarize with projects initiated by the County Govt.
Kiswahili: Wakazi walisihiwa kushiriki katika mchakato wa kutengeneza bajeti kupitia ushiriki wa umma, ili kufahamu miradi iliyoanzishwa na Serikali ya Kaunti.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi koborigwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese , erio kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari y'ekaunti.
Somali: Dadka deggan ayaa lagu booriyay inay ka qaybgalaan habka sameynta miisaaniyadda iyada oo loo marayo ka qaybgalka dadweynaha, si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda ay bilawday Dowladda Gobolka.
Dholuo: Ne ojiw jogweng'no mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar loso bajet kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda, mondo ging'e tije ma sirkal mar County ochako.

English: Mungatana urges IEBC to ensure transparency, fairness in upcoming by-elections
Kiswahili: Mungatana anahimiza IEBC kuhakikisha uwazi, haki katika uchaguzi ujao
Ekegusii: Mungatana orure okoboria ase IEBC koenekia oboene, obwasioku ase obochori oboke obwo bore motwe.
Somali: Mungatana wuxuu ku booriyay IEBC inay xaqiijiso hufnaanta, caddaaladda doorashooyinka gaarka loo leeyahay ee soo socda
Dholuo: Mungatana ojiwo IEBC mondo orit ler, bura makare e yiero mabiro

English: IEBC Formation Push: ODM urges court to dispense with IEBC cases Party also warns members supporting competitors
Kiswahili: IEBC Formation Push: ODM inahimiza mahakama kuachana na kesi za IECC Chama pia kinaonya wanachama wanaounga mkono washindani
Ekegusii: Ogosegeta gwokorosigwa gwekeombe kiobochori nechimbebe: ODM yarure okoboria ase ebigambero gokorana ebina biria bibwateranetie ekeombe kiobochori nechimbebe IEBC. Ekeombe ekio boigo kiarure ogokurera ase ababwatania baye baria bakobwatesia abaamererania baye.
Somali: IEBC Formation Push: ODM waxay ku boorisay maxkamadda in ay ka takhaluso kiisaska Iebc Xisbiga ayaa sidoo kale uga digay xubnaha taageeraya tartamayaasha
Dholuo: IEBC Formation Push: ODM okwayo kot mondo ogol oko weche mag IebC Party bende osiemo jokanyo ma riwo lwedo jong'wech

English: UDM Party urges President William Ruto to jump start process of recruiting IEBC commissioners
Kiswahili: Chama cha UDM kinamwomba Rais William Ruto kuanza mchakato wa kuajiri wawakilishi wa IEBC
Ekegusii: Echama ya UDM yarure okoboria gochia ase omonene bw'ense William Ruto koayereria omoroberio bwokobachora abakomisona abayia ba IEBC.
Somali: Xisbiga UDM wuxuu ku booriyay Madaxweyne William Ruto inuu bilaabo geedi socodka shaqaaleysiinta guddoomiyeyaasha IEBC
Dholuo: UDM Party okwayo President William Ruto mondo ochak chenro mar kwayo jotelo mag IEBC

English: Did you know that all KRA Services are free? You can receive our services from our contact centre, KRA offices or Huduma Center near you Find out more here
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Huduma zote za KRA ni bure? Unaweza kupokea huduma zetu kutoka kituo chetu cha mawasiliano, ofisi za KRA au Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu nawe. Pata maelezo zaidi hapa.
Ekegusii: Inee, nomanyete ng'a obokoreri bwensi bwebango gose KRA nigo bore obwabosa otari goakana kende? Nabo okonyora obokoreri bwaito korwa ase ogotwakera esimi gose obisi ya KRA obisi chiobokoreri bène ang'e naye.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in dhammaan Adeegyada KRA ay yihiin lacag la'aan? Waxaad ka heli kartaa adeegyadeena xarunteena xiriirka, xafiisyada KRA ama Xarunta Huduma ee kuugu dhow Halkan ka sii aqri
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni tije duto mag KRA gin maonge chudo?

English: Former DP Rigathi Gachagua urges Gen Z to register as voters, expresses confidence that 2027 election won't be rigged despite questioning credibility of the appointed IEBC commissioners.
Kiswahili: Rafiki wa zamani wa DP Rigathi Gachagua anahimiza kizazi cha Z kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura, anaelezea ujasiri kwamba uchaguzi wa 2027 hautakuwa wa udanganyifu licha ya kuhoji uaminifu wa wawakilishi wa IEBC waliochaguliwa.
Ekegusii: oyokabeire omokonyi bwomorai bwense Rigathi Gachagwa orure okoboria ase abasae abake kwerikia buna abaaki chikura, na koorokia oboremu ng'a obochori bwomwaka 2027 mbobe obwo oboene nonya kaorogetie chitang'utang'u ase ekeombe kiobochori nechimbebe gietenenerete IEBC.
Somali: DP hore Rigathi Gachagua wuxuu ku booriyay Gen Z inuu iska diiwaangeliyo codbixiyayaasha, wuxuu muujiyey kalsoonida ah in doorashada 2027 aan la khiyaanayn doono inkasta oo la su'aalooday kalsooni-celinta guddoomiyeyaasha loo magacaabay IEBC.
Dholuo: Jal ma ne en DP machon Rigathi Gachagua ojiwo tieng' mar Z mondo odonjre kaka josiasa, kendo onyiso ni en gi yie ni yiero mar 2027 ok bi wuondore kata obedo ni ji keto kiawa kuom yie mar jokanyo moyier mag IEBC.

English: Public Service Commission warns farmers about during this period and urges them to attend.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Utumishi wa Umma inawaonya wakulima kuhusu kipindi hiki na kuwahimiza kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobokoreri giesekari yakureire abaremi gosanga amo ase ebiro binga buna ebiga
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Dadweynaha wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda muddadan wuxuuna ku booriyay inay ka qayb galaan.
Dholuo: Commission of Public Service chiwo siem ne jopur e kindeno kendo ojiwogi mondo gichop e chokruogno.

English: Mosiria urges residents to help unblock drains as rains cause flooding.
Kiswahili: Mosiria anawahimiza wakazi kusaidia kufungua mifereji ya maji kwa sababu mvua husababisha mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Mosiria obaboririe abamenyi gokonya ase okoigora emetaro yogoetia yamache asengecho embura nabo ekoreta amache yeora nemegoko.
Somali: Mosiria waxay dadka deggan ku boorineysaa inay gacan ka geystaan xannibaadda biyo-xireenka maadaama roobabku ay keenaan fatahaado.
Dholuo: Mosiria jiwo jogweng'no mondo okony e tieko ywayo pi nikech koth chueyo pi mang'ich.

English: Citizens urged to register with the new medical cover (SHA)
Kiswahili: Raia wahimizwa kujiandikisha na bima mpya ya matibabu (SHA)
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi baborigwe kwerikia ase omoroberio omoyia bw'obobwenia SHA.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu booriyay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiska caafimaadka cusub (SHA)
Dholuo: Owadwa gi dhako okwayo ji mondo odonj e riwruok manyien mar weche thieth (SHA)

English: The recent accusations against Francis Awino of Bunge la Mwananchi have raised critical questions about the independence of the EACC. Civil society urges accountability, not weaponized state machinery.
Kiswahili: Shutuma za hivi karibuni dhidi ya Francis Awino wa Bunge la Mwananchi zimeibua maswali muhimu kuhusu uhuru wa EACC. Asasi za kiraia zinahimiza uwajibikaji, si silaha za serikali.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana yogokagerwa igoro yobokurmi komobwata Francis awino omobwatania bwebunge yegenka aretire amaborio amange igoro yobokoreri nogwetenenera bene bwekeombe giokorwania obokurumi. Na yagerire abaegereri boboene bwa mwanyabanto koboria oboikeranu ase obokoreri korende tari obokoreri bwogwanchereria gose boria bwogotumeka buna ekerwanero neserekari.
Somali: eedeymaha dhawaan lagu soo oogay Francis Awino oo ka tirsan Bunge la Mwananchi ayaa soo jeediyay su'aalo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan madaxbanaanida EACC. Bulshada rayidka ah waxay ku boorineysaa xisaabtanka, ma aha mashiin dowladeed oo hubaysan.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyocha otim ne Francis Awino mar Bunge la Mwananchi osemiyo ji obedo gi penjo mang'eny e wi loch mar EACC.

English: CS Ruku urges North Eastern residents to register for National IDs
Kiswahili: CS Ruku anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaskazini Mashariki kujiandikisha kwa kitambulisho cha kitaifa
Ekegusii: Omowasiri Ruku obaboririe abamenyi ba mocha ya rogoro gotoma amaborio yokonyora abibande
Somali: CS Ruku wuxuu ku booriyay dadka deggan Waqooyi Bari inay iska diiwaangeliyaan aqoonsiga qaranka
Dholuo: CS Ruku ojiwo ji duto modak e North East mondo odonj e weche mag National ID

English: Citizens should report corruption cases to hotline 999, 911, or 112.
Kiswahili: Raia wanapaswa kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kwa simu ya dharura 999, 911, au 112.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi baborigwe koenana amang'ana onsi arengete obokurumi ase ogoaka esimi yobokonyi 999, 911 gose 112.
Somali: Muwaadiniintu waa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa khadka tooska ah ee 999, 911, ama 112.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine onego ochiw ripode mag mibadhi e simo mar 999, 911, kata 112.

English: EACC urges all professional bodies in the country to infuse integrity and accountability in their self-regulatory mechanisms to enhance corruption intolerance among Kenyan professionals
Kiswahili: EACC inazihimiza taasisi zote za kitaaluma nchini kuingiza uadilifu na uwajibikaji katika mifumo yao ya kujidhibiti ili kuongeza uvumilivu wa ufisadi miongoni mwa wataalamu wa Kenya.
Ekegusii: EACC yaboririe chinsagia chionsi chiobokoreri gosangia chiumbu chingiya na oboasioku ase ogwekorerana erio gokanya obokurumi ase abasomu ba Kenya
Somali: EACC waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhamaan hay'adaha xirfadeed ee dalka inay daacadnimo iyo mas'uuliyad ku darsadaan nidaamyadooda is-xakamaynta si kor loogu qaado dulqaadka musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhexeeya xirfadlayaasha Kenya
Dholuo: EACC jiwo riwruoge duto mag tich e pinyno mondo omed bedo gi ratiro mar timo gik moko e yo makare e chenro ma gin - go mar chano gik moko giwegi, mondo okony jogo matiyo ne Nyasaye e piny Kenya kik yie gi mibadhi.

English: Make it official, get your driving license today.
Kiswahili: Ifanye iwe rasmi, pata leseni yako ya udereva leo.
Ekegusii: Kora keofisi, nyora ogwanchera kogendi chigari rero
Somali: Si rasmi ah u samee, maanta hel liisanka wadistaada.
Dholuo: Bed gi ratiro mar riembo mtoka kawuono.

English: EACC Vows to Deal with all Land Grabbing Cases, Urges Counties to Assist in Rooting Out Culprits
Kiswahili: EACC Yaapa Kushughulikia Kesi Zote za Unyakuzi wa Ardhi, Yazihimiza Kaunti Kusaidia Kuondoa Wahalifu
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorwania obokurumi ime yense EACC giatianire gochia korwani oboibi bwamaremo yeserekari nakoboria chikaunti gosokia bonsi baria babweteranirie noboibi obwe.
Somali: EACC waxay ballanqaadeysaa in ay wax ka qabato dhammaan kiisaska qabsashada dhulka, waxay ku boorineysaa degmooyinka inay gacan ka geystaan baabi'inta dambiilayaasha
Dholuo: EACC Osingore ni Obiro Tiyo gi Weche Duto mag Yudo Piny, Ojiwo Kaunti Mondo Okonye Golo Joma Otimo Richo

English: Former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua visits Butula, Busia County, where he urges Western Kenya to rally behind George Natembeya, Cleophas Malala, and Eugene Wamalwa, saying the three should be at the national decision-making table helping form the next government.
Kiswahili: Makamu wa Rais wa zamani Rigathi Gachagua anatembelea Butula, Kaunti ya Busia, ambako anahimiza Magharibi mwa Kenya kujiunga na George Natembeya, Cleophas Malala, na Eugene Wamalwa, akisema watatu hao wanapaswa kuwa kwenye meza ya kitaifa ya kufanya maamuzi kusaidia kuunda serikali inayofuata.
Ekegusii: oyokabeire omokonyi bwomorai bwense Rigathi Gachagwa natarerete Butula ime yekaunti ya Busia ase arwete okoboria gochia ase abamenyi ba Boluhyia kobwatesia George Natembeya, Cleophas Malala and Eugene Wamalwa nagoteba ng'a abwo batato mbabwenerete gotokanase emesa ekero amang'ana yense agokwanwa nagokonya ase okorosia eserekari egocha.
Somali: Madaxweyne ku xigeenka hore Rigathi Gachagua ayaa booqday Butula, degmada Busia, halkaas oo uu ku booriyay galbeedka Kenya inay ku biiraan George Natembeya, Cleophas Malala, iyo Eugene Wamalwa, isagoo sheegay in saddexdaasi ay ku jiri lahaayeen miiska go'aan qaadashada qaranka iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya sameynta xukuumadda soo socota.
Dholuo: Jatend piny machon Rigathi Gachagua olimo Butula, e County mar Busia, kama ojiwo Western Kenya mondo oriw lwedo George Natembeya, Cleophas Malala, kod Eugene Wamalwa, kowacho ni ji adekgo onego obed e mesa mar timo yiero mar piny mangima ka gikonyo e loso sirkal mabiro.

English: Conserving degraded lands: Nakuru residents urged to help in protecting lands next rivers.
Kiswahili: Kuhifadhi ardhi zilizoharibika: Wakazi wa Nakuru wahimizwa kusaidia katika kulinda ardhi iliyo karibu na mito.
Ekegusii: Korenda ebiseneno amo na'maoromomo: Abamenyi ba Nakuru baborigwe korenda chingegu chiamache .
Somali: Badbaadinta dhulkii burburay: Dadka deggan Nakuru waxaa lagu booriyay inay ka caawiyaan ilaalinta dhulka webiyada soo socda.
Dholuo: Rito lowo ma nokethore: Ne ojiw ji ma nodak Nakuru mondo okony e rito lowo ma ne ni machiegni gi aoche.

English: Renewal can be done for 1 year via e-citizen,for smart dl create a TIMS account and apply http://online.To create the account http://ntsa.go.ke click on TIMs register the account.
Kiswahili: Usasishaji unaweza kufanywa kwa mwaka 1 kupitia raia wa kielektroniki, kwa smart dl fungua akaunti ya TIMS na utumie http://online. Ili kuunda akaunti http://ntsa.go.ke bofya TIM sajili akaunti.
Ekegusii: Ekebande kiao bene nkebe gekorosiwa boyia kera omwaka ase e-citizen, ase ekebande kioborundia bene rosia ekegancha gia TiMs nagotoma okoboria ase http://ntsa.go.ke obate ase TiMs rikia ekegancha.
Somali: Dib u cusbooneysiinta waxaa lagu sameyn karaa 1 sano iyada oo loo marayo muwaadinka elektaroonigga ah, si aad u hesho xisaab TIMS oo aad dalbato http://online.
Dholuo: Inyalo timo lokruok kuom higa achiel kokalo kuom e-citizen, mondo ng'at mariek obed gi thuolo mar loso kad mar TIMS kendo tiyo gi kama iluongo ni http://online.

English: GT News | EACC urges compliance with traffic laws to combat corruption on Kenyan roads. Motorists play a vital role. Let's prioritize road safety! Report corruption to Toll-Free No.1551.
Kiswahili: Habari za GT | EACC yahimiza kufuata sheria za trafiki ili kupambana na ufisadi barabarani Kenya. Madereva wana jukumu muhimu. Tuweke kipaumbele usalama barabarani! Ripoti ufisadi kwa Nambari ya Simu Isiyolipishwa 1551.
Ekegusii: Amayia korwa GT, ekeombe giokorwania obokurumi ime yense kiaboririe amachiko onsi abara kobwatigwa erio gokeania obokurumi ase chibara, abarundia nigo bagokora emeremo emiya ase ogoikerania oboseera ase chibara. karue amang'ana ao igoro yobokurumi ase ogoaka esimi etari konacha besa 1551.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa in la hoggaansamo xeerarka taraafikada si looga hortago musuqmaasuqa waddooyinka Kenya. Gawaarida baabuurta ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaara. Aan mudnaanta siino nabadgelyada wadooyinka!
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ahinya mondo oluw chike mag ndara mondo oked gi mibadhi e nderni mag Kenya. Joidh mtokni nigi migawo maduong'. Weuru waket motelo ne rit mar ndara!

English: Busia women rep urges the government to implement the county Revenue Bill.
Kiswahili: Uwakilishi wa wanawake wa Busia anahimiza serikali kutekeleza muswada wa mapato ya wilaya.
Ekegusii: omobunge omochore ase ekaunti ya Busia orure okoboria gochia ase eserekari yekaunti eyuo goikerania ebirenga biebango ase ekaunti eyuo.
Somali: Wakiilka haweenka ee Busia wuxuu ku boorinayaa dowladda inay hirgeliso Sharciga Dakhliga Gobolka.
Dholuo: Owadwa moro miluongo ni Busia Women's Representative, jiwo sirkal mondo oti gi chikno.

English: Senator @scherargei urges Garissa County Government to stop sponsoring ordinary mwananchi to respond to him and Focus on Service Delivery and fulfilling Needs of Garissa Residents.
Kiswahili: Seneta @scherargei anawahimiza Serikali ya Kaunti ya Garissa kuacha kuunga mkono mwananchi wa kawaida kumjibu na kuzingatia Utoaji wa Huduma na Kutimiza Mahitaji ya Wakazi wa Garssa.
Ekegusii: Omoseneta Cheragei orure okoboria ase eserekari yekaunti ya Garissa gotiga gotoma abamenyi koboria amaborio na goikerania obokoreri ase abamenyi bensemo eyuo.
Somali: Senator @scherargei wuxuu ku boorinayaa Dowladda Gobolka Garissa inay joojiso taageerada muwaadiniinta caadiga ah si ay uga jawaabaan isaga iyo diiradda saaraan bixinta adeegga iyo buuxinta baahiyaha dadka deggan Garissi.
Dholuo: Senator @scherargei ojiwo sirkal mar county mar Garissa mondo owe chiwo kony ne mwananchi mapile mondo odwoke kendo oket pachgi kuom chiwo kony kod chopo dwaro mag jo-Garissa.

English: Raila urges Lake Region residents to endorse nuclear plant
Kiswahili: Raila anawahimiza wakazi wa Mkoa wa Ziwa kuunga mkono kituo cha nyuklia

English: Azimio boss Raila Odinga urges President Ruto to implement the NADCO report fully and calls for open dialogue by all stakeholders on the reconstitution of the IEBC.
Kiswahili: Mkuu wa Azimio Raila Odinga anamsihi Rais Ruto atekeleze kikamilifu ripoti ya NADCO na anatoa wito kwa pande zote zinazohusika kushiriki mazungumzo wazi juu ya uundaji upya wa IEBC.
Ekegusii: Omorai bwa Azimio Raila odinga orure okoboria ase omonene bwense Ruto goikerania bene ayare ase NADCO kegima naboigo korwa okoboria ase obwaasioku ase chinkwana chiogochakia bene ekeombe gia IEBC.
Somali: Madaxa Azimio Raila Odinga wuxuu ku boorinayaa Madaxweyne Ruto inuu si buuxda u hirgeliyo warbixinta NADCO wuxuuna ugu baaqayaa dhammaan daneeyayaasha wadahadal furan oo ku saabsan dib-u-dhiska IEBC.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Azimio, Raila Odinga, ojiwo President Ruto mondo oti gi ripot mar NADCO e okang' malach kendo ogwelo jogo duto motudore gi wachno mondo owuo e wi loso kendo IEBC.

English: Saving Marsabit Forests: Measures launched to protect forests and water bodies in the county Stakeholders urged to sensitise residents to help combat degradation Residents urged to plant trees to protect water catchment areas
Kiswahili: Kuokoa Misitu ya Marsabit: Hatua zilizozinduliwa kulinda misitu na vyanzo vya maji katika kaunti Wadau wahimizwa kuhamasisha wakazi kusaidia kupambana na uharibifu Wakazi wahimizwa kupanda miti ili kulinda maeneo ya vyanzo vya maji

Somali: Badbaadada kaymaha Marsabit: Tallaabooyinka lagu bilaabay ilaalinta kaymaha iyo meelaha biyaha ee degmada Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha ayaa lagu booriyay inay dadka deegaanka u wacyi geliyaan si ay uga caawiyaan la dagaalanka burburka Dadka deegaanka waxaa lagu boorriyay in ay beeraan geedo si loo ilaaliyo deegaannada biyaha

English: EACC rubbishes KERRA employees defence that he raised 21 M for dowry urges court not to unfreeze.

Somali: EACC burburinta shaqaalaha KERRA difaaca in uu soo ururiyey 21 M oo ah hadiyad ku booriyay maxkamadda in aan la qaboojiyo.
Dholuo: EACC oketo ketho kuom jotich KERRA konyogi ni ne gichoko milion 21 mondo giyud mich.

Kiswahili: ODM inahimiza Mahakama kuamua kesi ya jopo la uteuzi la IEBC
Ekegusii: ODM yaganirie ekegambero koa ribaga rieritang'ani ekina kerengete ogochorwa ase ekeombe gietenenerete giechimbebe nobochori.

Dholuo: ODM okwayo Kot mondo oket motelo weche mag komiti mar yiero mar IEBC

English: CJ Martha Koome urges IEBC selection panel to resist external influence when selecting new commissioners; terms delay in constituting the commission a democratic disruption.
Kiswahili: CJ Martha Koome anahimiza jopo la uteuzi wa IEBC kupinga ushawishi wa nje wakati wa kuchagua wakurugenzi wapya; muda wa kuchelewesha muundo wa tume ni usumbufu wa kidemokrasia.
Ekegusii: Omonachi ebina omonene Martha Koome,orure okoboria ase ekeombe keria kegochora abakoreri ba IEBC gokana kegima amang'ana korwa isiko ayuo abwate ekerenga kiogosegeta obochori chingaki bagendererete gokora obochori ase abateneneri bekeombe ekio nagoteba okogendera konyorwa ase obochori obwo nigo bokoburukania oborai bwabange ime yense
Somali: CJ Martha Koome waxay ku boorineysaa guddiga xulashada ee IEBC in ay iska caabidaan saameynta dibedda marka la dooranayo guddoomiyeyaasha cusub; muddada dib u dhac ku yimaada sameynta guddiga waa carqaladeyn dimuqraadi ah.
Dholuo: J.J. Martha Koome jiwo komiti mar yiero mar IEBC mondo otang' gi gik ma wuok oko sama oyiero komiseche manyien.

English: By 2 days ago EU urges Tanzanian authorities to exercise restraint amid post election unrest British High Commission in Tanzania advises against all but essential travel to the country, cites disruption and unrest following the October 29 election.
Kiswahili: Kufikia siku 2 zilizopita EU inawasihi mamlaka za Tanzania kujizuia kutokana na machafuko ya baada ya uchaguzi. Ubalozi Mkuu wa Uingereza nchini Tanzania unashauri dhidi ya safari zote isipokuwa muhimu kwenda nchini humo, unataja usumbufu na machafuko kufuatia uchaguzi wa Oktoba 29.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko abarere aerire, ekeombe kiobomo bwa Bongereza (EU) giasabire abarai ba Tanzanian kwerita nyuma yomobukano bwechikura chitancheranetwe omobarosi bwense ya British aaria Tanzania igoro yechibabari chiengencho ime yense, ase omoburukano bwechikura omotienyi 10 chitariki 29.
Somali: 2 maalmood ka hor Midowga Yurub wuxuu ugu baaqay mas'uuliyiinta Tansaaniya inay is-hoosaysiiyaan rabshadaha ka dambeeya doorashada. Guddiga sare ee Ingiriiska ee Tanzania wuxuu kula talinayaa in laga fogaado dhammaan safarada dalka marka laga reebo kuwa lagama maarmaanka u ah, isagoo tilmaamay jahwareer iyo rabshado ka dambeeyay doorashada 29 Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Odiechienge ariyo mosekalo, EU osenyiso jotelo mag Tanzania ni gibed gi ritruok e kinde mag ywaruok ma ne otimore bang' yiero.

English: The Integrity Hotline is not only available to all IMF staff members, contractual employees, and vendor personal, but also to members of the public.
Kiswahili: Hotuba ya Uadilifu haipatikani tu kwa wafanyakazi wote wa IMF, wafanyakazi wa mkataba, na wafanyabiashara binafsi, bali pia kwa washiriki wa umma.

He condemned local leaders for politicizing the incident, calling their actions unfortunate and aimed at gaining cheap political mileage. #KBCniYetu ^MM

Dholuo: Ofise mag thieth chiwo yedhe mamero mag iron kod folic acid ma onge chudo ne mon ma nigi ich duto mondo gikwed rem mar remo kod tuoche mag nyuol. Dhiuru e osiptal ma ni machiegni kodu kawuono.

English: Announcing nutrition budgets and intervention tracking tools released for county-level planning under CNAP.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza bajeti za lishe na zana za ufuatiliaji wa uingiliaji zilizochapishwa kwa mipango ya kiwango cha wilaya chini ya CNAP.
Ekegusii: Okoraria ebacheti yechindagera nebikoreri biogotunyana buna ensemo yokoroberia oroiboro ase ekaunti inse ya CNAP
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida miisaaniyada nafaqada iyo qalabka raadraaca faragelinta ee lagu sii daayay qorsheynta heer degmo iyadoo la raacayo CNAP.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mag chiemo kod yore mag timo nonro e weche mag yuto ma ne ogol e bwo chenro mar county-level e bwo CNAP.

English: Seek for medical attention or counseling. A phisician on mental health treatment can pathways to manage this problem and help you to understand your problem and its management
Kiswahili: Tafuta matibabu au mashauriano ya kitiba. Daktari wa afya ya akili anaweza kukusaidia kukabiliana na tatizo hilo na kukusaidia kuelewa tatizo lako na jinsi unavyoweza kulikabiliana nalo
Ekegusii: Rigia obogwenia gose chinkwana chiobosemia. Omomanyi bwobobwenia bwobongo nabo akorwa chinchera chi'okorwania obokongu obo na kogokonya kwemanya buya aye omonyene.
