Dholuo: Dhakono nyalo konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo nyagori gi chandruogno, kendo onyalo konyi mondo ing'e kaka inyalo loyori

English: Announcement of influencer-led digital media campaign promoting self-care, destigmatization, and helpline awareness in mental wellness week.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kampeni ya vyombo vya habari vya kidijitali inayoongozwa na watu wenye ushawishi inayokuza utunzaji binafsi, udhalilishaji, na ufahamu wa simu ya usaidizi katika wiki ya ustawi wa akili.
Ekegusii: Okoraria gwekampeni na eɓokoreri bia amangana ekoragwa nabanyene babwate riosa ase okwerenda aye omonyene, okonengetwa na obomanyi gwetera chisimi gati yomokubio bwogokinia obongo
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida olole warbaahinta dhijitaalka ah oo ay hogaamiyaan saameynayaashu si kor loogu qaado daryeelka naftiisa, ka-hortagga, iyo wacyi-gelinta khadka caawimaadda toddobaadka caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: Walando kampen mar digital media mitayo gi joma nigi teko mar chiko ji mondo ojiw ritruok mar ng'ato owuon, bedo gi paro maok kare, kod miyo ji ong'e weche mag thieth e juma mar ngima mar pach.

English: Kenya has received 10,700 Mpox injection dosses to prevent transmission. The Ministry of Health has said that since the month of July, 67 people have been infected
Kiswahili: Kenya imepokea dozi 10,700 za sindano ya Mpox ili kuzuia maambukizi. Wizara ya Afya imesema kwamba tangu mwezi wa Julai, watu 67 wameambukizwa
Ekegusii: Kenya yanyorire chidosi 10,700 chiesindani ya ogotanga Mpox erinde gotanga okoambokeria. Ewizara yobobwenia nigo yateba koru omotienyi o gatano na kabere, abanto 67 banyorire oborwaire obo.
Somali: Kenya ayaa heshay 10,700 oo qiyaasood oo Mpox ah oo lagu duro si looga hortago cudurka. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo bishii Luulyo, 67 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen cudurka
Dholuo: Kenya oseyudo dose 10,700 mag Mpox mar geng'o tuwono kik landre.

English: KEBS and MoH jointly announcing enforcement of iodized salt regulation to prevent deficiency disorders.
Kiswahili: KEBS na Wizara ya Afya ya pamoja kutangaza utekelezaji wa kanuni ya chumvi ya iodized ili kuzuia matatizo ya upungufu.
Ekegusii: KEBS na Ewizarà yà obochenu ase obwamo barararia korosi amachiko ase omonyo obwate ayodini erio gotanga oboremeru bwaye
Somali: KEBS iyo wasaaradda caafimaadka ayaa si wadajir ah ugu dhawaaqday in la fuliyo xeerka cusbada iodized si looga hortago cillad la'aanta.
Dholuo: KEBS kod Ministry of Health ka gitiyo kanyachiel ka giwacho ni gibiro tiyo gi chike mag loso chumbi mar iodized mondo gikony e geng'o tuoche mag yuto.

English: Babies should never be exposed to cigarette smoke. Secondhand smoke increases the risk of asthma and sudden infant death syndrome.
Kiswahili: Watoto wachanga hawapaswi kamwe kuathiriwa na moshi wa sigara. Moshi wa sigara unaotoka kwa mtu mwingine huongeza hatari ya pumu na ugonjwa wa kifo cha ghafla cha watoto wachanga.
Ekegusii: Ebingwerere tibigwenereti koorokigwa ase amarioki ye'sigara Okonywa gwa kabere kwa amarioki ngosegeta are obobe ase amayaa na ogokwa kwa mobasokanao ase abana abake
Somali: Ilmaha waa inuusan u soo bandhigin qiiqa sigaarka, waayo sigaarka labaad wuxuu kordhinayaa halista asma iyo cudurka dhimasho degdeg ah ee dhallaanka.
Dholuo: Tho mar ndawa miyo nyithindo bedo gi parruok mang'eny mar bedo gi tuwo mar asthma kod tuo mar tho apoya.

English: The neighborhoods of Baringo is fighting malaria through their traditional practices in a combination of using treated nets
Kiswahili: Majirani wa Baringo wanapambana na malaria kupitia mazoea yao ya kitamaduni
Ekegusii: Eamate ya Baringo nigo ekorwania esosera goetera chinchera chiegekoro amo ne chineti.
Somali: Deegaanada Baringo waxay la dagaalanayaan Cudurka Cudurrada iyada oo loo marayo dhaqankooda dhaqameed ee isku darka isticmaalka shabagyada la daaweeyey
Dholuo: Alwora mar Baringo kedo gi malaria kokalo kuom timbegi machon ka gitiyo gi gogo

English: The Ministry of Health has announced polio vaccination campaign for 5 days starting 2nd - 6th October 2024
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imetangaza kampeni ya chanjo ya polio kwa siku 5 kuanzia tarehe 2 - 6 Oktoba 2024
Ekegusii: Ewizara yobochenu yararirie ekampeini yechancho ya polio ase amatuko atano gochakera omotienyi 10 chitariki ibere goika isano nemo, 2024
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday olole tallaalka dabaysha ah oo socon doona 5 maalmood laga bilaabo 2 - 6 Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Od thieth oselando kampen mar chiwo chanjo mar polio kuom ndalo 5 chakre tarik 2 nyaka 6 dwe mar apar higa mar 2024

English: Announcement of wellness zones offering balanced diets, counselling, and stress-relief services in major facilities.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la maeneo ya ustawi yanayotoa lishe bora, ushauri nasaha, na huduma za kupunguza msongo wa mawazo katika vituo vikuu.
Ekegusii: Okorari gwechinsemo chiobuya na chindagera cherenganaine, obosemi oboikeranu na obokoreri bwogokeani ogoichorerana kw'obongo ase ebitaseni ebinene
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida goobaha caafimaad ee bixiya cuntooyin isku dheelitiran, la-talin, iyo adeegyada ka-hortagga stress ee xarumaha waaweyn.
Dholuo: Lando kuonde mitimoe nonro ma chiwo chiemb chuny mowinjore, chiwo paro, koda konyo e tieko parruok e kuonde madongo mag thieth.

English: Trump's restrictive laws on funding on health servicers to kenya. This directiv has stoped assistance on HIV AIDS and TB and also children vaccination. Baraza; we shall explore assistance from a different end if Trump makes good of his threats to stop asssistance to us.
Kiswahili: Baraza; tutachunguza msaada kutoka mwisho tofauti ikiwa Trump atatumia vitisho vyake kuacha msaada wetu.
Ekegusii: Richiko ria Trump, gosaria emeroberio ya oborwaria ya Kenya. Richiko erio nigo rigotenenia obokonyi bwokoenana amariogo ya esese amo na enyamoreo ,naboigo amariogo ya abana ebing'werere. Barasa: Ntorigie obokonyi ase ang'ao Amerika keratenenie obokonyi gocha ase tore.

Baraza; wabiro nono kony moa e yo machielo kapo ni Trump otiyo gi weche ma ne osiemowago mondo ogeng' kony ma wayudo.

English: Ministry inviting community service organizations via SUNCSA to plan public nutrition messaging and sanitation strategy (Epuka Uchafu).
Kiswahili: Wizara inaalika mashirika ya huduma kwa jamii kupitia SUNCSA kupanga mkakati wa ujumbe wa lishe kwa umma na usafi wa mazingira (Epuka Uchafu).
Ekegusii: Ewizara yachikire abakoreri ase ebinyoro goetera SUNCSA koroberia amangana yokoragera buya ase bonsi na obochenu bwe'binto bitoetanaine Eatanane neubi
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay ku casuumaysaa ururada adeegga bulshada iyada oo loo marayo SUNCSA inay qorsheeyaan farriimaha nafaqada dadweynaha iyo istiraatiijiyadda nadaafadda (Epuka Uchafu).
Dholuo: Migawo ma gwelo riwruoge matiyo ne oganda ka gitiyo gi SUNCSA mondo ochan chenro mar chiwo chiemb chuny ne ji kod chenro mar thieth (Epuka Uchafu).

English: Announing meeting to reaffirm East African leadership in food labelling, marketing restrictions and nutrition reform.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa kutangaza kuthibitisha uongozi wa Afrika Mashariki katika uwekaji lebo za vyakula, vikwazo vya masoko na mageuzi ya lishe.
Ekegusii: Okoomerana koraria ogotingi oborai ase Orogongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha ase okoraa kobeka echapa chindagera, kobeka ebitango ase chichiro na amaonchereri ase chindagera
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida kulan lagu xaqiijinayo hoggaanka Bariga Afrika ee ku saabsan calaamadaha cuntada, xaddidaadaha suuqgeynta iyo dib-u-habeynta nafaqada.
Dholuo: Lando romo mar jiwo loch mar Afrika ma Ugwe e weche mag ndiko chiemo, chungo ohala kod rieyo chiemo.

English: The government has done well by launching SHA to assist cancer patients, world day to celebrate cancer
Kiswahili: Serikali imefanya vizuri kwa kuzindua SHA kusaidia wagonjwa wa saratani, siku ya kimataifa ya kusherehekea saratani
Ekegusii: Eserekali yamentire obuya obonge ase ogotumika SHA ase abarwaire ba kansa, obuya bonde mboria aya onsi agikoreka ase ebiro ebitingu agwe agwe Rituko rinene riogochengera kansa ense engima, amangana amamwamu
Somali: Dowladdu waxay si fiican u qabatay iyada oo la bilaabay SHA si loo caawiyo bukaannada qaba kansarka, Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee lagu dabaaldego kansarku

Kiswahili: Vurugu huwadhuru wanawake wajawazito kimwili na kiakili. Wasaidie na uwape rufaa manusura kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Chiburaburu nechimbe ase omongina bwebwateraneti kemobere na kebongo Konya na gotebereria ababwate chingoma bakonyeke
Somali: Dagaalku wuxuu haweenka uurka leh waxyeelo u geystaa jireed iyo maskaxeed.
Dholuo: Timbe gero hinyo mon ma nigi ich e yor ringruok koda e pachgi.

English: Tight clothes can interfere with circulation and cause discomfort. Choose loose, breathable attire.
Kiswahili: Nguo zinazobana zinaweza kuingilia mzunguko wa damu na kusababisha usumbufu. Chagua mavazi legevu na yanayoweza kupumuliwa.
Ekegusii: Chianga ebinànti ngotorana chire buna amanyinga agotara omobere Chira chiyànga chinßibore embèo egoeta buya

English: Official media brief on latest DHS findings showing decline; call to re-invest in maternity supports and lactation facilities.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi kwa vyombo vya habari kuhusu matokeo ya hivi karibuni ya DHS yanayoonyesha kupungua; wito wa kuwekeza tena katika vituo vya usaidizi wa uzazi na unyonyeshaji.
Ekegusii: Okoraria bene goetera ebiombo bia amangana chiroboto chia DHS yaenekire ogokeana; ogokurerwa kwarurwe bwokomenta obokoreri ase ebitaseni biobokonyi na okogonkia

Dholuo: Weche ma josiasa mag sirkal wacho e wi weche ma DHS osefwenyo ma nyiso ni piny osedok chien; gidwaro ni ji ochak oti gi pesa momedore e konyo nyithindo ma ginyuolo kod rito nyithindo ma pod tindo.

English: The Minstry of Health has confirmed its plan to issue nets has started in Homa/bay on the 15, November 2023, and 830,862 nets will be issued, to achieve 91% of registered households
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha mpango wake wa kutoa mtandao umeanza huko Homa/bay tarehe 15 Novemba 2023, na mtandao 830,862 utatolewa, kufikia 91% ya kaya zilizosajiliwa
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya obochenu nigo yateba, omoroberio bwokorwa chineti ase obonge nigo ochagetwe ase ekaunti ya Homabay chitariki 15, November 2023, na chineti kobagwa goika 830,862, igo goikerania ekerengo Kia 91% ase chinyomba chiarigetwe.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay in qorshaheeda soo saarista shabagyada laga bilaabay magaalada Homa/bay 15-ka Nofeembar 2023, waxaana la soo saari doonaa 830,862 shabagay, si loo gaaro 91% qoysaska diiwaangashan
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osenyiso ni chenro mare mar golo net osechakore e Homa/bay tarik 15, Novemba 2023, kendo ibiro gol net 830,862, mar chopo 91% mar udi duto mosendiko

English: Reduction of body immunity during pregnancy can cause serious problems to your unborn baby. Visi the dentist for checking your teeth to ensure mouth cleanliness
Kiswahili: Kupungua kwa kinga ya mwili wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa kwa mtoto wako ambaye hajazaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ogokeana kw'obonyamasi bwomobere chingaki chi'oroiboro nabo korarente obokong'u ase afya y'omonwa. Genda ase omonyagitari bwamaino akorigererie ase okorenda obochenu bwomonwa oo.
Somali: Dhibaatooyin culus ayaa u dhalan kara ilmaha uurka leh yareynta difaaca jirka inta uu uurka ku jiro.
Dholuo: Bedo gi tuoche mang'eny e kinde mag ich nyalo kelo chandruoge madongo ne nyathini mapok onyuol.

English: All expectant mothers to sleep under treated nets and malaria medication to prevent both the mother and her unborn/child from malaria infections
Kiswahili: Mama wote wajawazito wanapaswa kulala chini ya mitaro ya matibabu na dawa za malaria ili kuzuia mama na mtoto wake ambaye hajazaliwa kutokana na maambukizo ya malaria
Ekegusii: Abakungu bebwateraneti nigo bagosegetwa korara ime yechineti chirwariri goita chiumbu, na konyora amariogo yogotanga Esosera eyio ekobeka omwana na ng'ina ase abe.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh oo dhan waxay ku seexdaan shabagyada la daaweeyey iyo daawooyinka malaria si looga hortago in hooyada iyo ilmaheeda aan dhalan / ilmaha ay ka soo baxaan cudurrada malaria
Dholuo: Min nyithindo duto ma nigi ich onego onind e bwo yiende mag thieth kod thieth mar malaria mondo omi min gi nyathine maok onyuol kik yud tuwo mar malaria

English: Nigerian company to make HIV, malaria test kits after US funding cut
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Nigeria kutengeneza vifaa vya kupima VVU na malaria baada ya ufadhili wa Marekani kupunguzwa
Ekegusii: Ekambani ya Nigeria korosia ebikoreri biokorenga oborwaire bw'Enyamoreo na Esosera kobwatekania na Amerika gotenenia obokonyi.
Somali: Shirkad Nigeria ah oo soo saari doonta qalab lagu tijaabiyo HIV, Malaria kadib markii la yareeyo maalgelinta Mareykanka
Dholuo: Oganda moro mar Nigeria biro loso kit mag nonro mag HIV, malaria bang' lalo pesa mag Amerka

English: Mothers and their young children are required to visit their health facilities to be tested 48 hours after delivery for medical care.
Kiswahili: Mama na watoto wao wadogo wanapaswa kutembelea vituo vyao vya afya ili wajaribiwe saa 48 baada ya kujifungua kwa ajili ya matibabu.
Ekegusii: Abang'ina amo n'abana abake bagwenerete kogenda oborengi nyagitari chinsa 48 koru okoibora banyare korengwa erio korigia bobe bonde bwonsi na korotota okobwena kwa bwango.
Somali: Hooyooyinka iyo carruurtooda yaryar waxaa looga baahan yahay inay booqdaan xarumahooda caafimaadka si ay u tijaabiyaan 48 saacadood ka dib dhalmada daryeelka caafimaad.
Dholuo: Min gi nyithindgi matindo onego olim kuonde thiethgi mondo otimnegi nonro kuom seche 48 bang' nyuol mondo giyud thieth.

English: Caregivers should follow the national immunization schedule to protect children against deadly diseases such as measles, polio, and tuberculosis.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kufuata ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari kama vile surua, polio, na kifua kikuu.
Ekegusii: Abareri nigo bagwenerete kobwatia omoroberio bw'ense bw'echanjo erio korenda abana korwa ase amarwaire amabe buna measles, polio na Esese
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay raacaan jadwalka tallaalka qaranka si ay caruurta uga ilaaliyaan cudurrada dilaaga ah sida suuxdinta, cudurka booliiska, iyo cudurka hargabka.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego oluw chenro mar thiedho nyithindo mondo kik hinygi gi tuoche ma nyalo nego nyithindgi kaka midekre, tuo mar polio, kod tuo mar kahera.

English: Fund raisng here in Kenya exceeding targets of the World Organization, have increased more than 50%; that promose has been increased and grown
Kiswahili: Fedha zilizopatikana hapa Kenya kuzidi malengo ya Shirika la Dunia, zimeongezeka kwa zaidi ya 50%; kwamba kukuza imeongezeka na kuongezeka
Ekegusii: Omochengo aiga Kenya ase ogoetania ebirengo bia Ekeombe ekenene giense, biamentekire goetani emerongo etano ase emia; eira eyio yementirwe na gokina

English: Meeting to announce strengthening leadership in the Southern African region on trademarking al food, market regultion and foods control

Ekegusii: Okoumerana koraria ogokong'ia oborai ase Orogongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha ase okoraa kobeka echapa chindagera, kobeka ebitango ase chichiro na amaonchereri ase chindagera

English: The Ministry of Health has issued warning through SMS to people concerned that, when food exeeds sugar, salt and fat levels is dangerous
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewasilisha onyo kupitia SMS kwa watu wanaohusika kwamba, wakati chakula kina kiwango cha sukari, chumvi na mafuta ni hatari
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya obochenu yarure ogokurerwa goetera SMS ase abànto, ekero endagera egetumana ebirengo bia esukari/ omonyo/ amaguta
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa soo saartay digniin SMS ah oo loogu talagalay dadka la xiriira in marka cuntooyinka ay cunaan heerarka sonkorta, cusbada iyo dufanka ay khatar tahay
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechiwo siem kokalo kuom SMS ne joma nigi parruok ni, sama chiemo nigi sukari, chumbi kod chamo le nyalo kelo hinyruok.

English: Knowledge about mental health disorders for men is of great importance because they are the people on whom every daily home problems. Studies have confirmned that men are in need of mental health more than women. This is because men are are not open to reveal their weaknesses
Kiswahili: Ujuzi juu ya matatizo ya afya ya akili kwa wanaume ni muhimu sana kwa sababu wao ni watu ambao kila siku matatizo ya nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Obomanyi bwoborwaire bwobongo ase abasacha nobwengencho enene ekiagera nabwo bakoomerana na amangana amange ase chinka. Obotuki bwakorirwe bwaorokirie ng'a abasacha mbare ase ogosaba obokonyi obochenu bwobongo kobua abangina. Eye nase angencho ng'a mara aange abasacha mbari basiboku koorokia obogengeru bwabo
Somali: Aqoonta ku saabsan cudurrada caafimaadka dhimirka ragga ayaa ah mid aad muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waa dadka ay dhibaatooyinka maalinlaha ah ee guriga ku dhacaan. Daraasadaha ayaa xaqiijiyay in ragga ay u baahan yihiin caafimaadka maskaxda ka badan dumarka. Tani waa sababta oo ah ragga ma furan yihiin inay soo bandhigaan daciifnimadooda

English: Lauch of a campaign in the region through media houses in collaboration is good sign ahead to workers
Kiswahili: Kuanzishwa kwa kampeni katika mkoa kupitia nyumba za vyombo vya habari kwa kushirikiana ni ishara nzuri kwa wafanyikazi
Ekegusii: Ogosoka gwekampeini yorogongo ase chinyomba chioboraria chikoererania ebimanyererio ebiyia bia bosio ase abakoreri
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida olole ka socda gobolka iyada oo loo marayo guryaha warbaahinta ee iskaashiga ayaa calaamad wanaagsan u ah shaqaalaha
Dholuo: Loso kampen e alworano kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda, en ranyisi maber ne jotich.

English: WHO has aknowledge issuence of the second doss of malaria vaccine for children, to be affordable at Ksh 300
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni (WHO) limetangaza kutolewa kwa kipimo cha pili cha chanjo ya malaria kwa watoto, kwa bei ya chini ya Ksh 300
Ekegusii: WHO yancheranire okoegwa eriogo ria kabere ria esosera ase abana, koba ne rigori ria inse ya sh. 300
Somali: WHO waxay oggolaatay in la sii daayo qiyaasta labaad ee tallaalka malaria ee carruurta, si loo helo qiimo jaban Ksh 300
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar piny mangima (WHO) oseyie gi chiwo mar dose mar ariyo mar vaccine mar malaria ne nyithindo, mondo obed gi nengo moromo mar Ksh 300

English: Restaurants must; 1.ensure quality & safety of food, rinse &sanitize food contact surfaces, disinfect surfaces, floors & counters. 2.Install adequate portable running water & accessible washing basins for hand washing purposes, at the entrance & exit points.
Kiswahili: Mikahawa lazima; 1. kuhakikisha ubora na usalama wa chakula, suuza na usafi wa nyuso zinazogusa chakula, safisha nyuso, sakafu na kaunta. 2. Weka maji ya kutosha yanayobebeka na beseni za kufulia zinazoweza kufikika kwa ajili ya kunawia mikono, kwenye sehemu za kuingilia na za kutokea.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiokoragera; 1. chiikeranie obochenu bwe'chindagera, amo n'ebibekerero, amo n'echinsemo chiokooneria. 2. Beka amache aisaine ase chibeseni chiogwesaba, chiranyare goikerwa na kera omonto, ase ebisieri bioosoa, na gosoka.
Somali: Makhaayadaha waa inay: 1. xaqiijiyaan tayada & badbaadada cuntada, ku maydhaan & nadiifiyaan dusha xidhiidhka cuntada la leh, jeermiska ka saarista dusha sare, dabaqyada & xisaabaadka. 2.Ku rakib biyo qulqulaya oo la qaadi karo oo ku filan & baashaal lagu maydho oo la heli karo ujeeddooyinka dhaqashada gacmaha, meelaha gelitaanka & bixitaanka.
Dholuo: Yore mag chiemo nyaka: 1. gwedho kod rito ngima mar chiemo, lwoko kendo pwodho kuonde ma chiemo yudoree, thiedho gik mochido, gorofa kod konde mag chiemo. 2.Giketo pi mang'we ng'ich kendo ma yot tiyogo e lwoko lwedo, e kuonde ma gidonjoe kod ma giwuoke.

English: The Ministry of Health has discloed that Covid 19 virus from India has been detected in Kisumu
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imekanusha kwamba virusi vya Covid 19 kutoka India vimegunduliwa huko Kisumu
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborwaria yatebire ebinyinyi bia Covid 19 koru India biatokire Kisumu
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay cambaareysay in fayraska Covid 19 ee Hindiya laga helay Kisumu
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oseng'ado ni Covid 19 virus moa India osenwang'o Kisumu

English: More other 5 patients to be confirmed infected with MPOX in 12 counties, among them Nakuru na Mombasa included. The PS deborah Baraza has saud that among them, one has lost life and 8 are under medication
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wagonjwa wengine 5 wamethibitishwa kuwa wameambukizwa MPOX katika kaunti 12, miongoni mwao ni Nakuru na Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Abwarwaire bande batano koenekigwa koambokerigwa Mpox ase chikaunti 12, ase echio Nakuru na Mombasa kobao. Omoriki o botambe bwobobwenia CS Deborah Barasa otebire ase abwo, oyomo osiriri obogima bwaye na 8, mbagenderetete korwarigwa.
Somali: 5 bukaan oo kale ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay inay ku dhaawacmeen MPOX 12 degmo, oo ay ka mid yihiin Nakuru na Mombasa.
Dholuo: Jotuo mamoko 5 bende ibiro ng'ado ni nigi tuwo mar MPOX e gwenge 12 moriwo Nakuru na Mombasa.

English: Announcement about the campaign by the media houses under the leadership of experts with the capacity on self care, and capaity measurement through mobili phones in the midist of a week targeting brain development.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu kampeni ya nyumba za vyombo vya habari chini ya uongozi wa wataalam wenye uwezo wa kujitunza, na upimaji wa uwezo kupitia simu za mkononi katikati ya wiki inayolenga maendeleo ya ubongo.
Ekegusii: Okoraria gwekampeini na eɓokoreri bwamangana ekorau nabanyene bare eriosa ase okwerenda abanyene, okorengwa na obomanyi goetera chisimi gati yomokubio bwogokinia obongo
Somali: Warbaahinta ayaa ku dhawaaqday ololaha ay sameeyeen warbaahintu iyadoo ay hogaaminayaan khubaro awood u leh daryeelka naftooda, iyo cabbirka awoodda iyada oo loo marayo taleefanada dhaqdhaqaaqa toddobaadka dhexe ee bartilmaameedsanaya horumarinta maskaxda.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma nigi nyalo mar ritore giwegi, kaachiel gi nono nyalo mar timo kamano kokalo kuom simo e dier juma achiel, biro lando kampenno e bwo loch mar josomo molony e ritruok mar obwongo.

English: Public invitation and details for October 2025 national conference themed "Securing the Future" on holistic mental health.
Kiswahili: Mwaliko wa umma na maelezo ya mkutano wa kitaifa wa Oktoba 2025 wenye mada "Kulinda Mustakabali" kuhusu afya ya akili kamili.
Ekegusii: Ogochika mwanyabanto na amoorokererio ya'orogongo omotiènyi o'ikomi 2025 ore nekerenga " Korenda Amarago" igoro ya obochenu bw'obongo oboikeranu
Somali: Casuumad dadweyne iyo faahfaahin ku saabsan shirka qaran ee Oktoobar 2025 oo cinwaankiisu yahay "Sugidda Mustaqbalka" ee ku saabsan caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhammaystiran.
Dholuo: Lwongo mar ji duto kod weche matut mag chokruok mar piny mangima mar dwe mar apar 2025 ma nigi thuon wach ni "Rito kinde mabiro" ewi ngima mar paro ma opong'o.

English: KEMRI unveiling pilot program training religious figures in suicide prevention as mental wellbeing outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua programu ya majaribio ya mafunzo kwa watu mashuhuri wa kidini katika kuzuia kujiua kama uhamasishaji wa ustawi wa akili.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe Ekenene Kiobotuki bwa Amariogo yachakiri amaegerio yamatemu ase abarai abanene bechidini ase ogotanga okwengete buna amasomo gokinia obongo
Somali: KEMRI waxay soo bandhigtay barnaamij tijaabo ah oo lagu tababarayo dadka diinta ah ee ka hortagga ismiidaaminta sida caawinta caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako timo chenro mar tiego jotelo mag din e yore mag geng'o ji kik nege kaka yore mag konyo ji obed gi paro makare.

English: Sugary juices and sodas are harmful to babies and increase the risk of obesity and tooth decay.
Kiswahili: Juisi na soda zenye sukari ni hatari kwa watoto wachanga na huongeza hatari ya unene kupita kiasi na kuoza kwa meno.
Ekegusii: Ebinyugwa bigwansa nechisota neɓibe ase abana naende binkomenta ekenoro na ogosareka amaino
Somali: Cunnada sonkorta leh iyo soda-yada ayaa waxyeello u geysta dhallaanka waxayna kordhinayaan khatarta cayilka iyo ilkaha burburka.
Dholuo: Juices kod soda ma nigi sukari nyalo hinyo nyithindo kendo miyo gibed matuwo ahinya.

English: Java to provide food to athletees in the teams in Africa for men and women in the camps in Africa
Kiswahili: Java kutoa chakula kwa wanariadha katika timu katika Afrika kwa ajili ya wanaume na wanawake katika kambi katika Afrika
Ekegusii: Java korwa chindagera ase abagosoria borogongo Chitimu chia abasacha na abakungu chikambi ase chigosori ime ya Afrika
Somali: Java si ay u bixiso cunto ciyaartooyda kooxaha Afrika ee ragga iyo dumarka ee xeryaha Afrika
Dholuo: Java biro chiwo chiemo ne jotugo e tim mar chwo gi mon e kembe mag Afrika

English: Sleeping under treated nets helps reduces malaria rates for mothers ands their unborn babies
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya nyuzi za matibabu husaidia kupunguza kiwango cha malaria kwa akina mama na watoto wao ambao hawajazaliwa
Ekegusii: Korara ime yechineti chibekire eriogo ngokeania chire ekeugoso giesosera ase abàngina bebwateraneti na abana bataraiborwa
Somali: Hurdada shabagyada la daaweeyey waxay ka caawineysaa in la yareeyo heerarka cudurka malaria ee hooyooyinka iyo ilmahooda aan dhalan
Dholuo: Nindo e bwo ute mitiyogo e thieth konyo miyo mine kod nyithindgi ma pok onyuol obed gi malaria matin

English: When we open up and talk about what is affecting our mental health, those issues become bearable. They become less distressing, less overwhelming and less worrying. Reach out to us on 1199 and we will be there for you.
Kiswahili: Tunapofungua na kuzungumzia kinachoathiri afya yetu ya akili, masuala hayo yanakuwa rahisi kuyavumilia. Yanakuwa hayana usumbufu mwingi, hayalemei sana na hayana wasiwasi mwingi. Wasiliana nasi kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.
Ekegusii: Ekero tokoigoka twakwana igoro y'ebinto bigochanga afya y'amongo aito, ching'ana echi nigo chikogusua. Nigo chigotiga goichania, tichiri koritoa naende tichirigotwara omoichano omonge. KWana n aintwe ase 1199 naintwe ntweariganie ase eng'encho yao.
Somali: Marka aan furno oo aan ka wada hadalno waxa saameynaya caafimaadka maskaxdeena, arrimahan waxay noqdaan kuwo la dulqaadan karo. Waxay noqdaan wax yar oo dhibta leh, ka yar oo ka badan oo ka yar welwelka. Nala soo xiriir lambarka 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa.
Dholuo: Sama wawuoyo e wi gik makelo hinyruok e pachwa, weche ma kamago bedoga mayot winjo kendo ok bednwa gi parruok mang'eny. Wuo kodwa e simo mar 1199 kendo wabiro konyi.

English: Kenya has witnessed more two people have infected with MPOX in Kericho and Taita Taveta counties totalling all patients to 33. The Minstry of Health has appealed to schools to strengthen preventive measures
Kiswahili: Kenya imeshuhudia watu wawili zaidi wameambukizwa MPOX katika kaunti za Kericho na Taita Taveta na kufanya jumla ya wagonjwa wote kufikia 33. Wizara ya Afya imeziomba shule kuimarisha hatua za kinga.
Ekegusii: Kenya yaenekirie abanto babere bande koambokerigwa Mpox ase chikaunti chia Kericho na Taita Taveta goikia enamba yonsi ase amo abarwaire 33. Ewizara yobobwenia yasabire chisukuru gokong'ia emeroberio y'ogotanga okoambokerigwa.
Somali: Kenya waxay aragtay laba qof oo kale oo ku dhacay cudurka MPOX ee degmooyinka Kericho iyo Taita Taveta oo dhan 33 qof oo bukaan ah. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ugu baaqday dugsiyada inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga.
Dholuo: Kenya oseneno ji ariyo mamoko ma nigi tuwo mar MPOX e gwenge mag Kericho kod Taita Taveta ma kwan mar joma tuore duto ochopo 33.

English: Always use boiled or treated water when preparing infant food to prevent diarrhea.
Kiswahili: Tumia maji yaliyochemshwa au yaliyotibiwa kila wakati unapoandaa chakula cha watoto wachanga ili kuzuia kuhara.
Ekegusii: Botambe tumika àmache amorero koroseria chindàgera chia omwana gitanga ogosaa
Somali: Had iyo jeer isticmaal biyo karkaray ama la daaweeyey marka la diyaarinayo cuntada dhallaanka si looga hortago ciribta.
Dholuo: Kinde duto ti gi pi mothedh kata matiyo gi pi sama itimo chiemo ne nyithindo matindo mondo igeng' thieth.

English: Shaking eye for infants is a sign of epilepsy. Seek for timely medical attention.
Kiswahili: Kutikisa macho kwa watoto wachanga ni ishara ya ugonjwa wa kupatwa na kifafa.
Ekegusii: Okonyegerigwa gose ogotengecha kwa eriso ase ebingwerere nekemanyererio kia endururume Rigia obogwenia ase obwango
Somali: Ilmaha indha la'aanta ayaa calaamad u ah cudurka qanjirka 'epilepsy'.
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro maok kare kuom nyithindo matindo en ranyisi mar bedo gi tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Announing launch of framework to guide data collection and reporting of nutrition outcomes.
Kiswahili: Kuzindua mfumo wa kuongoza ukusanyaji na utoaji wa taarifa za matokeo ya lishe.
Ekegusii: Ogochakia omoroberio bw'ogosangereria na gosokia chiropoti igoro yechindagera
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista bilaabista qaab-dhismeedka si loo hago ururinta xogta iyo warbixinta natiijooyinka nafaqada.
Dholuo: Ogolo lendo mar chakruok mar chenro mar tayo chokruok mar weche kod goyo ripot mar duoko mag chiemo mowinjore.

English: Mental health is the psychological and emotional well being of a person and it affects how we handle stress,make decisions and interact with others.
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ni ustawi wa kiakili na kihemko wa mtu na huathiri jinsi tunavyoshughulikia mkazo, kufanya maamuzi na kuingiliana na wengine.
Ekegusii: Obochenu bwobongo nakuo oboikeranu bwebirengererio na obokanyeku ase omonto, nabio bikoraa ogoichorerana kwa obongo, kunacha ebina na koigwanana nabande
Somali: Caafimaadka maskaxeed waa caafimaadka maskaxda iyo shucuurta ee qofka waxayna saameyn ku yeelataa sida aan ula macaamiloonno walwalka, go'aan qaadashada iyo isdhexgalka dadka kale.
Dholuo: Ngima mar pach en ngima maber mar ng'ato e yor chuny koda e paro, kendo mano chiko kaka watiyo gi parruok, kaka wang'ado paro, koda kaka wawuoyo gi jomoko.

English: Waiting for one minute for the umbilical cord to dry after washing a baby increases its iron and its body immunity
Kiswahili: Kusubiri kwa dakika moja kabla ya kamba ya pua kukauka baada ya kumosha mtoto huongeza chuma chake na kinga ya mwili wake
Ekegusii: Koganya edagika eyemo otarasieka ekenyogu, nkoimokia ere ebirengo bià echuma na obonyamasi
Somali: Marka ilmaha la maydho hal daqiiqo oo uu sugayo in xadhkaha burburka uu qalalo waxay kordhisaa birta iyo difaaca jirka
Dholuo: Rito kuom dakika achiel mondo ng'ato oyudi bang ' lwoko nyathi miyo nyathino bedo gi ratiro mar thiedho chuma kendo bedo gi teko mar geng'o tuoche

English: Launch of four-year dairy quality improvement initiative in central and western Kenya targeting smallholder producers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa miaka minne wa kuboresha ubora wa maziwa katikati na magharibi mwa Kenya unaolenga wazalishaji wadogo.
Ekegusii: Ogochaki omoroberio bwemiaka ene korosia amabere amaya gatigati na bosongo ya Kenya orengete abaremi abakeabake
Somali: Daahfurka hindisaha horumarinta tayada caanaha oo afar sano ah oo ka socda bartamaha iyo galbeedka Kenya oo lagu beegsanayo soosaarayaasha yaryar.
Dholuo: Chako chenro mar higni ang'wen mag bero ber mar chak e piny Kenya ma diere kod ma podho chieng' ma ochung'ne jopur matindo.

English: As surprise on the outbreak of monkeies disease MPOX, the Ministry of Health has promised to provide two million vaccination before year end
Kiswahili: Kama mshangao juu ya kuzuka kwa ugonjwa wa monkeies MPOX, Wizara ya Afya imeahidi kutoa chanjo milioni mbili kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka
Ekegusii: Buna ogokumia kogendererete igoro yogoateka kwoborwaire bwebikondo, Ewizara yobochenu yarure eira korwa echancho chimirioni ibere nyuma yomwaka
Somali: Iyada oo la yaab leh faafitaanka cudurka Monkeies ee MPOX, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ballanqaaday in ay bixiso laba milyan oo tallaal ka hor dhamaadka sanadka
Dholuo: Kaka gima kawowa gi wuoro nikech tuwono mar monkeies (MPOX), Ministry of Health osesingore mar chiwo thieth mar milion ariyo kapok higa orumo.

English: Launch of a customizable wellness approach combining psychoeducation, screenings, group sessions, and organizational policy consulting for employee wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mbinu ya ustawi inayoweza kubadilishwa inayochanganya elimu ya kisaikolojia, uchunguzi, vikao vya kikundi, na ushauri wa sera za shirika kwa ajili ya ustawi wa wafanyakazi.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa kwamagenderero aranyare goochororegwa egosangani amasomo ya obongo, oboringori, ebiombe na obosemi kw'obomo ase abasomba
Somali: Soo bandhigidda hab caafimaad oo la habeyn karo oo isku daraya waxbarashada cilminafsiga, baaritaannada, kalfadhiyada kooxda, iyo la-talinta siyaasadda ururka ee la-talinta fayoobaanta shaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Ochako yo mar rito ngima maber ma nyalo loso kaka ng’ato dwaro ma oriwo somo mar paro, ng’iyo, seche mag grup, kod puonjruok mar chike mag riwruok mondo rito ngima maber mar jotich.

English: Stick to the national immunization schedule to protect children from deadly diseases.
Kiswahili: Zingatia ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari.
Ekegusii: Bwatia emeroberio yarogongo ogotingia obonyamasi gotanga abana korwa amarwaire agoita
Somali: U hoggaansama jadwalka tallaalka qaranka si aad caruurta uga ilaaliso cudurrada dilaaga ah.
Dholuo: Luw chenro mar thiedho nyithindo mondo kik gibed gi tuoche makelo hinyruok.

English: To get cured of TB, you must complete the entire course of treatment as advised by the health worker.
Kiswahili: Ili kupona kifua kikuu, ni lazima ukamilishe matibabu yote kama ilivyoshauriwa na mfanyakazi wa afya.
Ekegusii: Erio obwene esese, goika okore oborwaria buna ogosemigwa nomonyagitaro oo.
Somali: Si aad u bogsato cudurka TB, waa inaad dhameystirtaa daaweynta oo dhan sida uu kugula talinayo shaqaalaha caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Mondo iyud thieth mar tuo mar TB, nyaka iti gi yor thieth duto kaka laktar mar thieth chiko.

English: Include iron-rich foods like spinach, liver, and beans in the diet to prevent anemia.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha vyakula vyenye madini mengi kama vile mchicha, ini, na maharagwe katika lishe ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu.
Ekegusii: Sangia chindagera chibwate ayoni buna esipinachi, rini na chingende gotanga ogokea kwamanyinga
Somali: Cuntooyinka hodanka ah ee birta ah sida spinach, beeraha iyo beeraha ku dar cuntadaada si looga hortago dhiig yaraanta.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato bed gi dhieth mar del, nyaka icham chiemo ma nigi ratonge mang'eny kaka spinach, chiwgi, kod nyinyo.

English: This Father's Day, let's shine a light on men's mental health. To all the dads out there, your well-being matters. Take time to prioritize your mental health and reach out for support when needed.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Baba, hebu tuangazie afya ya akili ya wanaume. Kwa akina baba wote, ustawi wako ni muhimu. Chukua muda wa kuweka kipaumbele afya yako ya akili na uwasiliane na usaidizi unapohitajika.
Ekegusii: Riruko eri ria'abatata, tigà tomorekere obochenu bwobongo ase abagàka Ase abatata bonsi, koba kwao buya nokwengecho Ira ribaga rinene ase obochenu bwobongo na korigia ogokonya ekero koganeirie
Somali: Maalintan Aabaha, aan iftiimino caafimaadka dhimirka ragga. Dhammaan aabbayaasha, fayoobaantaadu waa muhiim. Waqti qaado si aad mudnaanta u siiso caafimaadkaaga dhimirka oo aad taageero u hesho marka loo baahdo.
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar Wuoro ni, we mondo waler ler kuom ngima mar paro mar chwo. Kuom wuone duto ma ni oko, bedo maber mari en gima duong’. Ti gi thuolo mar keto ngimani mar paro obed mokuongo kendo ng’adnegi bura ka dwarore.

English: Announcing on new branch through phone messages by registering to get educated every day about good eating habits, and food management to achieve fiood security
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kwenye tawi jipya kupitia ujumbe wa simu kwa kujiandikisha ili kupata elimu kila siku kuhusu tabia nzuri za kula, na usimamizi wa chakula ili kufikia usalama wa chakula
Ekegusii: Koraria orosagia oroyia ase amariko yesimi kwerikia konyora obosemi kera omokubio igoro yokoragera okuya, oborendi bwechindagera na gokerania omoigoto
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida laanta cusub farriimaha taleefanka adigoo iska diiwaangelinaya si aad maalin kasta u hesho waxbarasho ku saabsan caadooyinka cuntada wanaagsan, iyo maareynta cuntada si loo gaaro nabadgelyada cuntada
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova lando wach moro e ofis manyien kokalo kuom oro ote e simo kuom dhi e skundno mondo opuonjre pile ka pile e wi kit chiemo mabeyo, kendo rito chiemo e yo maber mondo omi chiemo obed maber

English: Guidelines on Malaria injection: Many children in counties most prone to malaria will get vaccinated. 275,000 children have been partially immunized, and 45,000 have been fully immunized. Data confirms that malaria infections have reduced.
Kiswahili: Maagizo juu ya sindano ya malaria: Watoto wengi katika kaunti zilizo na uwezekano mkubwa wa kuambukizwa malaria watapata chanjo. Watoto 275,000 wamepewa chanjo kwa sehemu, na watoto 45,000 wametiwa chanjo kikamilifu. Takwimu zinathibitisha kwamba maambukizo ya malaria yamepungua.
Ekegusii: Obosemia bwa esindani ya Malaria: Abana abange ase chikaunti chikunire na malaria mbanyore esindani. WHO yaetirie ogotumeka mono gwesindani eyio. Abana 275,000 babetirwe ake, 45,000 babetirwe yonsi. Amangana arikire nigo akoenekia ng'a malaria yakeire.
Somali: Tilmaamaha tallaalka Malaria: Carruur badan oo ku nool degmooyinka ugu nugul cudurka ayaa la tallaali doonaa. 275,000 oo carruur ah ayaa qayb ahaan la tallaalay, 45,000 ayaa si buuxda loo tallaalay. Xogta ayaa xaqiijineysa in cudurrada Malaria ay hoos u dhaceen.
Dholuo: Puonj motudore gi thieth mar malaria: Nyithindo mang'eny e gwenge ma nigi nyalo mar yudo malaria biro yudo thieth. Nyithindi 275,000 osechiw thieth e okang' moro, to 45,000 osemi thieth chuth. Weche manyiso ni tuoche mag malaria osedok chien.

English: Five new Mpox cases confirmed in 12 counties, including Nakuru and Mombasa, raising the total to 28; Health CS Deborah Barasa reports one death and eight under care.
Kiswahili: Visa vitano vipya vya Mpox vimethibitishwa katika kaunti 12, ikiwa ni pamoja na Nakuru na Mombasa, na kufanya jumla ya visa kufikia 28; Waziri wa Afya Deborah Barasa anaripoti kifo kimoja na wanane wakiwa chini ya uangalizi.
Ekegusii: Abwarwaire bande batano koenekigwa koambokerigwa Mpox ase chikaunti 12,ase echio Nakuru na Mombasa kobao. Omoriki o botambe bw'Oborwaria CS Deborah Barasa otebire ase abwo,oyomo osiriri obogima bwaye na 8,mbagenderetete korwarigwa.
Somali: Shan kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay 12 degmo, oo ay ku jiraan Nakuru iyo Mombasa, taasoo wadarta u kordhisay 28; CS Health Deborah Barasa ayaa soo sheegtay hal dhimasho iyo siddeed daryeel.
Dholuo: Ji abich manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox oserumo e gwenge 12 moriwo Nakuru kod Mombasa, omiyo kwan mar ji duto osedok 28. CS Health Deborah Barasa wacho ni ng'ato achiel osetho to ji aboro ni e bwo rit.

English: Wash hands with soap and water before handling a baby to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Osha mikono kwa sabuni na maji kabla ya kumshika mtoto ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Ekegusii: Sibia amaboko nesabuni na amache otaràbwata omwana gotànga oborwaire
Somali: Gacmaha ku maydho saabuun iyo biyo ka hor intaadan taaban ilmaha si looga hortago cudurrada.
Dholuo: Luok lweti gi sabun kod pi kapok imako nyathi mondo ikwed tuoche.

English: Launch of fortified maize, soy blend distributed across primary schools to address undernutrition.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mchanganyiko wa mahindi na soya ulioimarishwa umesambazwa katika shule za msingi ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo.
Ekegusii: Okorentwa kw'ebituma biburukaine esoya kwararigwe chisukuru chia premari erio gokeania oborwaire bwokoborwa afya
Somali: Daahfurka isku darka galleyda iyo soy-ga oo la xoojiyay oo loo qaybiyay dugsiyada hoose si wax looga qabto nafaqo-darrada.
Dholuo: Chako chago mar ngano moting'o teko, oriw mar soya ma ipogo e skul mag praimari mondo ilos chandruok mar chiemo mowinjore.

English: The Minstry of Health has cinfirmed that more five people infected of MPOX from Busia County, totalling to 42 patients since its outbreak
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha kuwa watu wengine watano wameambukizwa MPOX kutoka Wilaya ya Busia, jumla ya wagonjwa 42 tangu kuzuka kwake
Ekegusii: Ewizara yobobwenia yaenekirie abanto bande batato korwara MPOX ase ekaunti ya Busia, yaikirie enamba y'abarwaire goika 42 korwa ogoateka Kwa Mpox,julai 2024
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay in shan qof oo dheeraad ah ay ku dhaawacmeen MPOX ka yimid degmada Busia, taasoo wadarta guud ee 42 bukaan ah tan iyo markii uu dhacay
Dholuo: Ministri mar weche thieth osenyiso ni ji abich mamoko ma nigi tuwo mar MPOX e county mar Busia, ma en kwan mar ji 42 chakre kanyo

English: Public meetings are critical in delinking discriminative practices brought about with taboos and to promote good characters among women
Kiswahili: Mikutano ya umma ni muhimu katika kuondoa mazoea ya ubaguzi yanayosababishwa na vizuizi na kuendeleza tabia nzuri miongoni mwa wanawake
Ekegusii: Chibarasà chianka ngokonya chire korusià ebitàngo ase emegiro na gosegetà chimbu chinguya ase abàngina
Somali: Kulanka dadweynaha ayaa muhiim u ah in la kala saaro dhaqanka takoorka ah ee la keenay tabooyinka iyo in lagu horumariyo dabeecadaha wanaagsan ee haweenka
Dholuo: Chokruoge mag oganda gin gik madwarore ahinya e ketho tudruok e kind timbe makelo achaye kod timbe mochido kendo e jiwo timbe mabeyo e kind mon

English: Public announcement of national campaign targeting rice, flour and oil millers to adhere to micronutrient fortification standards, including awards for top performers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la kampeni ya kitaifa inayolenga wasagaji wa mchele, unga na mafuta kuzingatia viwango vya urutubishaji wa virutubisho, ikiwa ni pamoja na tuzo kwa waliofanya vyema.
Ekegusii: Okoraria ekampeni ase mwanyabanto erengete abaremi bomochere, obosie na amaguta gotingia ebirengo biobochenu,amo nebiegwa ase abakori amaya
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha ee olole qaran oo lagu beegsanayo shiidaalayaasha bariiska, dufanka iyo saliidda si ay u hoggaansamaan heerarka xoojinta nafaqooyinka yaryar, oo ay ku jiraan abaalmarino loogu talagalay kuwa waxqabadka ugu sarreeya.
Dholuo: Lando e lela kampen mar piny mangima mitimo ne joma loso loso loso kod loso loso chamo kod loso mafuta mondo oluw chike mag loso gik makonyogi bedo gi chiemo mang'eny, moriwo gweth ne joma osetimo maber moloyo.

English: Expectant mothers should get vitamin A after delivery to help in building their body immunity and increase milk
Kiswahili: Mama wajawazito wanapaswa kupokea vitamini A baada ya kujifungua ili kusaidia kujenga kinga ya mwili na kuongeza maziwa yao
Ekegusii: Abangina goika bànyore ebitamini A nyuma yokoibora gotingia obonyamasi na kogesa àmabere
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waa inay helaan fitamiin A ka dib dhalmada si ay u caawiyaan dhismaha difaaca jirkooda iyo kordhinta caanaha
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madwaro nyuol onego oyud vitamin A bang ' nyuol mondo okonygi bedo gi teko mar kedo gi tuoche kendo omed miyo chak omedre

English: Announcement that hospitals will include African indigenous vegetables (e.g., amaranth, spider plant, African nightshade) in patient meals to improve nutrition.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba hospitali zitajumuisha mboga za asili za Kiafrika (k.m., mchicha, mmea wa buibui, mti wa mtu wa Kiafrika) katika milo ya wagonjwa ili kuboresha lishe.
Ekegusii: Okorari kwarurwe inga chinyagitari inchebeke chinyeni chia abakoro buna (amanagu, chinsaga chimboga) ase abarwaire batangire kobamentera obuya ase chindagera
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in isbitaalada ay ku dari doonaan khudradda dabiiciga ah ee Afrika (tusaale ahaan, amaranth, geedka cawska, nightshade Afrikaanka) cuntada bukaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova biro chiwo chiemb chuny ne jotuo mondo okonygi bedo gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: The community should assist young women to prevent early/unwanted pregnancies by educating them on natural pregance control and to vist antenal clinics
Kiswahili: Jumuiya inapaswa kusaidia wanawake vijana kuzuia ujauzito wa mapema / usiotaka kwa kuwaelimisha juu ya udhibiti wa mimba ya asili na kutembelea kliniki za antenal
Ekegusii: Eamate negwenerete koegeria na gokoonya abaibori abake chingencho gotanga oborito bwa mapema goetera kobaegeria obomanyi bw'obogima, obosemia, na goikera obobwenia bw'oroiboro.
Somali: Bulshadu waa inay ka caawisaa haweenka dhallinyarada ah inay ka hortagaan uurka hore / aan loo baahnayn iyaga oo baraya ka hortagga uurka dabiiciga ah iyo in ay booqdaan rugta caafimaadka
Dholuo: Oganda onego okony mon ma rowere geng'o ich chon/ma ok gidwar kuom puonjogi weche mag thieth mar ich mapile kendo dhi e osiptal mag nyithindo

English: Malaria vaccine advisory: More children in malaria endemic counties to be vaccinated. WHO has given an approval for expanded use of the vaccine. 275,000 children partially jabbed, 45,000 are fully vaccinated. Data shows the number of malaria cases has gone down
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa chanjo ya malaria: Watoto zaidi katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na malaria watachanjwa. WHO imetoa idhini ya matumizi ya chanjo hiyo kwa upana zaidi. Watoto 275,000 wachapwa sehemu, 45,000 wamechanjwa kikamilifu. Data inaonyesha idadi ya visa vya malaria imepungua
Ekegusii: Obosemia bwa esindani ya Malaria: Abana abange ase chikaunti chikunire na malaria mbanyore esindani. WHO yaetirie ogotumeka mono gwesindani eyuo. Abana 275,000 babetirwe ake, 45,000 babetirwe yonsi. Data yaorokirie ing'a malaria yakeire.
Somali: Talo-bixinta tallaalka Malaria: Caruur badan oo ku nool degmooyinka dalalka ay cudurka u badan tahay in la tallaalo. WHO waxay oggolaatay in la ballaariyo isticmaalka tallaalka. 275,000 oo caruur ah ayaa qayb ahaan la tallaalay, 45,000 ayaa si buuxda loo tallaalay. Xogta ayaa muujineysa in tirada kiisaska malaria ay hoos u dhacday
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuo mar malaria: Nyithindo mang'eny e gwenge ma malaria yudoree onego omi thieth. WHO oseyie mondo oti gi thiethno e okang' malach. Nyithindi 275,000 osetimo thieth moro matin, 45,000 oserwako thieth chuth. Weche nyiso ni kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwo mar malaria osedok chien

English: What shall you do to give your accord your mental health a good time? Having conversation with people is the good starting point
Kiswahili: Utafanya nini ili upate wakati mzuri wa kukubaliana na afya yako ya akili? Kuzungumza na watu ndio mwanzo mzuri
Ekegusii: Ninki orakore koa afya y'obongo ribaga rigiya? Gotwara chinkwana igoro yaye nase agiya yogochakera.
Somali: Maxaad samayn kartaa si aad u hesho waqti fiican caafimaadkaaga maskaxda?
Dholuo: Ang'o minyalo timo mondo ibed gi paro mowinjore?

English: Global Fund, through the Kenya Medical Supplies Agency, is distributing mosquito nets in malaria-endemic regions across the country
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kimataifa, kupitia Shirika la Ugavi wa Dawa la Kenya, unasambaza vyandarua vya mbu katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na malaria kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Ekegancha gi'ense, goetera ase ekampuni y'okobaga amariogo amo na ebinto ao ao bi'oborwaria, nkobagakere chineti ase chinsemo ao ao chi'Ense ya Kenya chiria chibwate Esosera kera engaki .
Somali: Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah, iyada oo loo marayo Hay'adda Qalabka Caafimaadka ee Kenya, ayaa qaybinaya shabagyada cayayaanka ee gobollada dalalka oo dhan ee ay ku jirto malaria
Dholuo: Kotiyo gi Kenya Medical Supplies Agency, Global Fund, osetiyo gi kuonde ma malaria yudoree e piny mangima

English: Households have been encouraged to seek for transport means in time, in case they feel suden labor pain. Delay to hospital can cause problems.
Kiswahili: Familia zimetiwa moyo kutafuta njia za usafiri kwa wakati, ikiwa zinahisi uchungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chiairwe omoyo korigia enchera y'obosombi mapema, Obororo Bwa okoibora kiborache mobasokano. Konyorwa goika nyagitari Nabo gokorenta emechando.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay waqti ku raadsadaan gaadiid, haddii ay dareemaan xanuun dhalmada.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine osejiw mondo omany yore mag wuoth e sa mowinjore, kapo ni giyudo lit mar nyuol.

English: Launch of FNRP program of 5 billion dolars in a bid to boost food suplenments to 24 semi arid counties targeting 5 million people
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa FNRP wa dola bilioni 5 kwa lengo la kuongeza nyongeza ya chakula kwa kaunti 24 zenye ukame zinazolenga watu milioni 5
Ekegusii: Ogochakiwa kwabeene kwomoroberio o'FNRP bwechidola chibilioni 5 erio gokonya koira chindagera ase chikaunti 24 chire ase aomo, korengete abakenya chomirioni 5
Somali: Daahfurka barnaamijka FNRP oo ah 5 bilyan oo doolar si kor loogu qaado cuntada dheeraadka ah ee 24 degmo oo abaaro ah oo lagu beegsanayo 5 milyan oo qof
Dholuo: Ochako chenro mar FNRP ma romo dola bilionde abich e gombo mar medo chiwo chiemo ne kaunti 24 ma onge pi mang’eny ma ochung’ne ji milion abich

English: Announcement on the campaign to create awareness through radios and televisions in the month to create awareness on mental health day
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya kampeni ya kujenga ufahamu kupitia redio na televisheni katika mwezi huo ili kuunda ufahamu juu ya siku ya afya ya akili
Ekegusii: Okoraria ekampeini yokoererania ase chiredio nechitivi ekero kiomotienyi bwokararia oborwaire bw'obongo
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan ololaha wacyi galinta raadiyaha iyo telefishanka bisha si loo abuuro wacyiga maalinta caafimaadka dhimirka
Dholuo: Lando e wi kampen mar chiwo pach ji kokalo kuom redio kod televison e dwe mar timo kamano e odiechieng' mar ngima mar pach

English: Starting of distribution of exams and milk twice a week without payment for the Migori nd nakuru Counties prmary schools
Kiswahili: Kuanza kugawanya mitihani na maziwa mara mbili kwa wiki bila malipo kwa shule za msingi za Wilaya za Migori na nakuru
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa gwokorugwa amatemwa na amabere atari gwakanerewa, ara kabere ase omokubio ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso ime ya Migori na Nakuru
Somali: Bilowga qaybinta imtixaannada iyo caanaha laba jeer usbuucii lacag la'aan ah ee dugsiyada hoose ee degmooyinka Migori iyo nakuru
Dholuo: Chakruok mar pogo penj kod chak nyadiriyo e juma maonge chudo ne skunde matindo mag Migori kod Nakuru Counties

English: Kenya has registered three MPOX patients in the counties of Nairobi, nakuru and Mombasa, totaling to 17, as revealed by the Ministry spokesperson baraza
Kiswahili: Kenya imesajili wagonjwa watatu wa MPOX katika kaunti za Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, jumla ya 17, kama ilivyoripotiwa na msemaji wa Wizara baraza
Ekegusii: Kenya yaenekiri abarwaire batato banyorekana na Mpox ase chikaunti chia Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, baikire abarware ikomi na batano babere, omonogeri ewizara Barasa otebire
Somali: Kenya ayaa diiwaangelisay seddex bukaan oo qaba cudurka MPOX ee degmooyinka Nairobi, Nakuru iyo Mombasa, oo dhan 17 qof, sida ay shaacisay afhayeenka wasaaradda baraza
Dholuo: Kenya osendiko ji adek ma nigi tuwo mar MPOX e gwenge mag Nairobi, Nakuru kod Mombasa, ma kwan-gi romo 17, mana kaka janabi mar minisari Baraza nowacho

English: Announcement on education after compiling service delivery report and awareness no good eating habits and home economics
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya elimu baada ya kuandaa ripoti ya utoaji wa huduma na ufahamu hakuna tabia nzuri za kula na uchumi wa nyumbani
Ekegusii: Okoraria igoro yamasomo nyuma yobokoreri kobekwa amo nechisemi chiokoragera okuya na okorereta ase chinka
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan waxbarashada ka dib markii la soo saaray warbixinta bixinta adeegyada iyo wacyi galinta caadooyinka cuntada oo aan fiicnayn iyo dhaqaalaha guriga
Dholuo: Lando e wi tiegruok bang' chano ripot mar chiwo tich kod miyo ji ng'eyo ni chiemo ok ber kendo ni ngima mar ot ok ber

English: Sleeping under treated nets reduces malaria risk for pregnant women and unborn babies.
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa hupunguza hatari ya malaria kwa wanawake wajawazito na watoto ambao hawajazaliwa.
Ekegusii: Korara ime yechineti chibekire amariogo ngokeani chire ekeugoso kia esosera ase abàngina bebwateraneti na abana bataraiborwa
Somali: Hordhaca shabagyada la daaweeyey wuxuu yareeyaa khatarta cudurka malaria ee haweenka uurka leh iyo dhallaanka aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato nindo e bwo ute mopidhore, mano nyalo miyo mon ma nigi ich kod nyithindo mapok onyuol kik bed gi tuwo mar malaria.

English: Government institutionts, should strengthen their investigation on the quality of foods in their wholesale markets to ensure quality foods
Kiswahili: Taasisi za serikali, zinapaswa kuimarisha uchunguzi wao juu ya ubora wa vyakula katika masoko yao ya jumla ili kuhakikisha vyakula vya ubora
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwa eserekali, ekongie chinyomba chioboringoria erio gotingia na koroberia chindagera ase chichiro chinene chiechindagera
Somali: Hay'adaha dowladda, waa in ay xoojiyaan baaritaankooda ku saabsan tayada cuntada suuqyadooda jumlada si loo hubiyo tayada cuntooyinka
Dholuo: Jotelo mag sirkal onego omed timo nonro e wi ber mar chiemo e ohalagi mag ng'iepo mondo gibed gadier ni chiemo nigi ber

English: Communities in Baringo fight back against malaria with local solutions and mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Jamii huko Baringo zinapambana na malaria kwa kutumia suluhisho za kienyeji na vyandarua
Ekegusii: Eamate ya Baringo nigo ekorwania esosera goetera chinchera ch'egekoro amo ne chineti.
Somali: Bulshooyinka Baringo waxay la dagaallamaan Cudurka Cudurrada iyadoo la adeegsanayo xalalka maxalliga ah iyo shabagyada cayayaanka
Dholuo: Joma odak e taon mar Baringo kedo gi malaria ka gitiyo gi yore mag thieth ma yudore e alworano kod ute mag kute

English: Kenya, UNICEF, and the World bank have disclosed good eating habits. Through meney assistance and awareness raising in counties in Africa
Kiswahili: Kenya, UNICEF, na Benki ya Dunia zimefunua mazoea mazuri ya kula.
Ekegusii: Kenya, UNICEF, ebengi enene yense, baasioriri okoragera okuya. Goetare omoroberio bwe chiropia na amaegerio Afrika chikaunti 11
Somali: Kenya, UNICEF, iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaa soo bandhigay caadooyinka cunista wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Kenya, UNICEF, kod bengi mar piny mangima osefwenyo timbe mabeyo mag chiemo.

English: Persistent nausea and vomiting during pregnancy can lead to dehydration and weight loss. Seek medical care.
Kiswahili: Kichefuchefu na kutapika mara kwa mara wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha upungufu wa maji mwilini na kupunguza uzito. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu.
Ekegusii: Ekengerangera na koroka kero bwebwateraneti kogokora anache mobere na chikiro gokea Rigia oborwari
Somali: Xanuunka iyo qallalanka joogtada ah ee uurka ku jira waxay keeni karaan biyo la'aan iyo miisaanka lumis.
Dholuo: Bedo gi tuwo mar ich kod ich wang' kinde duto nyalo miyo ng'ato odong' gi pi mang'eny kendo olal.

English: Mothers who milk their milk for their children to feed on when they are away, it is good to ensure that the container is clean and be keptr safe in a fridge to avoin contamination
Kiswahili: Wanawake ambao huwapa watoto wao maziwa ya kunywa wanapokuwa nje, ni vizuri kuhakikisha kwamba chombo hicho ni safi na ni salama katika friji ili kuepuka uchafuzi
Ekegusii: Abang'ina bari bagokamera abana amabere, nigo babwenerete koenekia ng'a ebinto biokoyabekerera mbisibirie buya, ase okogacha amabere ayio buya ase egekendi erio tarurana
Somali: Hooyooyinka nuujinaya caano si ay carruurtooda ugu quudiyaan markay maqnaadaan, waxaa wanaagsan in la hubiyo in weelka uu nadiif yahay oo uu ku badbaado qaboojiyaha si looga fogaado wasakheynta
Dholuo: Minwa ma miyo nyithindgi chak mondo gichiemgo sama gin mabor gi nyithindgi, onego one ni atonga ler kendo ni oting'gi e friji mondo kik gibed gi chilo

English: Mental health affects our thoughts, emotions and actions daily. Prioritizing mental health is key, even when feeling OK. Let's make mental health and wellbeing a reality for all.
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili huathiri mawazo, hisia na matendo yetu kila siku. Kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili ni muhimu, hata wakati wa kujisikia vizuri. Hebu tufanye afya na ustawi wa akili kuwa ukweli kwa wote.

Somali: Caafimaadka maskaxda ayaa saameyn ku leh fikradaha, shucuurta iyo ficillada maalin kasta. Horumarinta caafimaadka dhimirka ayaa muhiim ah, xitaa marka aad dareento inaad fiicantahay. Aynu caafimaadka maskaxda iyo wanaagga ka dhigno xaqiiqo qof walba.
Dholuo: Bedo gi ngima maber mar paro chiko pachwa, chunywa, koda timbewa pile ka pile. Keto ngima mar paro obed motelo en gima duong' ahinya, kata mana sama wawinjo maber. Weuru watim mondo ngima mar chuny kod ngima maber obed gima timore ne ji duto.

English: The government has launched issuense of nets. The government is targeting issuing treated nets 15.3 million
Kiswahili: Serikali imezindua utoaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kutoa vyandarua vilivyotibiwa milioni 15.3
Ekegusii: Eserekari yachakire korwa chineti. Eserekari nigo erengete korwa chineti chire neriogo rigoseria chiumbu 15.3M

English: Announcing launch of Nutrition Portal that offers online modules and webinars to equip CHVs with counseling tools and referral pathways.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa Tovuti ya Lishe inayotoa moduli za mtandaoni na semina za mtandaoni ili kuwapa wagonjwa wa CHV zana za ushauri nasaha na njia za rufaa.
Ekegusii: Koraria ogocha gwe chindagera ao ao ase omotandao amo namosomo, mbikonye abakoreri bobochenu begenka nobomanyi na gotebereria ase abatari konyara
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida daahfurka Nafaqada Portal kaas oo bixiya modules online ah iyo webinars si loogu qalabeeyo CHV-yada qalabka la-talinta iyo dariiqooyinka gudbinta.

English: All expectant mothers are encouraged to plan about their safe delivery, choos their prefered health facility, safe money and plan also on transport means
Kiswahili: Akina mama wote wajawazito wanahimizwa kupanga kuhusu kujifungua salama, kuchagua kituo cha afya wanachopendelea, pesa salama na pia kupanga njia za usafiri.
Ekegusii: Abakungu bonsi bebwateranetie nigo bairwe omoyo barosie omopango bwo'gochi koibora, amo na gochora enyagitari, kobanga esafari na kogacha chibesa .
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh oo dhan waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qorsheeyaan dhalmada ammaanka ah, doortaan xarunta caafimaad ee ay jecel yihiin, lacag ammaan ah iyo sidoo kale qorshe ku saabsan hababka gaadiidka
Dholuo: Onego ojiw mon duto ma nigi ich mondo ochan kaka gibiro nyuolo nyathi e yo maber, giyier kama gihero yudoe thieth, giyud pesa maber, kendo gichop chenro mag wuoth.

English: Women should deworm herself after delivery so that the food she takes benefits her body
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanapaswa kujitenga na wadudu baada ya kujifungua ili chakula wanachokula kifaidike na mwili wao
Ekegusii: Abakungu mbabwenerete konywa eriogo riogoita ebianda ekero baiboire nario barakongie endagera n'obuya bw'amabere.
