Dholuo: Tiyo gi yor wuoth e timo tiegruok mar ng'at molony e weche thieth ka itayo gi laktar mar thieth mar del kod laktar mag thieth mag chiemo

English: Kenya has burned all large gatherings, sports and church gatherings; school sports have been baned including celemonies since first detection of Covid 19 in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya imechoma mikutano yote mikubwa, michezo na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku ikiwa ni pamoja na sherehe tangu kugunduliwa kwa kwanza kwa Covid 19 huko Nairobi
Ekegusii: Kenya yatenenirie emesangererekano yonsi, emechieso/chigosori, ebipindi, n'emesangererekano ye'chikanisa; chigosori chiechisukuru chiakanirwe, magega yogotoka ekesi egetang'ani gia COVID-19 ime y'omochie o Nairobi
Somali: Kenya waxay gubeysay dhammaan shirarka waaweyn, isboortiga iyo shirarka kaniisadda; Isboortiyada dugsiyada oo ay ku jiraan xafladaha ayaa la mamnuucay tan iyo markii ugu horreysay ee la ogaaday COVID 19 ee Nairobi
Dholuo: Kenya osewang'o chokruoge madongo duto, tuke kod chokruoge mag kanisa; tuke mag skul oserumo moriwo nyaka nyasi mag nyasi chakre fwenyruok mar Covid 19 e Nairobi

English: Announcement on vitamin A and deworming medicine in the county of Kiambu for children over 12,000 under 5 years in collaboration with guidance from ECD
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya vitamini A na dawa za kuondoa wadudu katika kaunti ya Kiambu kwa watoto zaidi ya 12,000 chini ya miaka 5 kwa kushirikiana na mwongozo kutoka ECD
Ekegusii: Okorari ogochaki ebitàmunusi A na amariogo yogoita ebianda ase ekaunti engima ase abana goetani 12,000 bare inse yemiaka etano kobwaterana ase obosemi na ECD, ase ekaunti ya Kiambu
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan fitamiin A iyo daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka ee degmada Kiambu ee loogu talagalay carruurta ka weyn 12,000 oo da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano iyadoo lala kaashanayo hagida ECD
Dholuo: Lando e wi vitamin A kod yedhe mag thiedho kute e county mar Kiambu ne nyithindo mokalo 12,000 ma jahigni 5 e bwo telo mar ECD

English: Support from fathers, grandparents, and siblings strengthens outcomes for mother and baby.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi kutoka kwa baba, babu na bibi, na ndugu huimarisha matokeo kwa mama na mtoto.
Ekegusii: Okobwatesigwa korwa ase omogaka, chisokoro na abamwabo ngotinia kere obwamate bwa ngina amo nomwana
Somali: Taageerada aabbayaasha, awoowayaasha, iyo walaalaha waxay xoojisaa natiijooyinka hooyada iyo ilmaha.
Dholuo: Kony ma wuone, kweregi, kod owetegi chiwo miyo min gi nyathi bedo gi winjruok maber.

English: Official launch of $5 billion FNRP to support food security across 24 ASAL counties, targeting 5M vulnerable Kenyans.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa FNRP ya dola bilioni 5 ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula katika kaunti 24 za ASAL, ukilenga Wakenya milioni 5 walio katika mazingira magumu.
Ekegusii: Ogochakiwa bene kwa omoroberio oyo FNRP bwe chidola chibilioni 5 erio gokonya okoba gwe chindagera ase chikaunti 24 ase eroro na chinsemo chinyomo, barengete abakenya chomirioni 5
Somali: Daahfurka rasmiga ah ee $5 bilyan oo FNRP ah si loo taageero amniga cuntada ee 24 degmo oo ASAL ah, kaas oo lagu beegsanayo 5 milyan oo qof oo reer Kenya ah oo nugul.
Dholuo: Ochako loso FNRP ma romo dola bilionde 5 mar konyo rito chiemo e gwenge 24 mag ASAL, ma ochung’ne jo Kenya ma romo 5M ma nigi pek.

English: Being mentally informed helps to build you mental capacity. Share good talks with your friends and the people of your household in a bid to build harmony and to reduce scolding.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na ujuzi wa kiakili husaidia kujenga uwezo wako wa akili. Shiriki mazungumzo mazuri na marafiki na washiriki wa familia yako ili kujenga upatano na kupunguza kukaripiwa.
Ekegusii: Koba n'obomanyi bw'amangana yobobwenia bw'obongo nkonyare kogokonya gokina ebirengererio. Sanga chinkwana chingiya na abasani na abanto benyomba yao erio okinie okoigwanana na gokeania esekererio.
Somali: Adiga oo maskax ahaan wax ka ogaada waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad awood u yeelatid maskaxdaada. Saaxiibbadaada iyo xubnaha qoyskaaga la wadaag hadalo wanaagsan si aad u dhisatid iswaafajin iyo inaad yareyso canaanta.
Dholuo: Wuo gi osiepeni kod joodu e yo maber mondo ikonygi gibed gi winjruok maber kendo kik ichwanygi.

English: Announcement a plan on educating people of nairobi county to promote kitchen farming in primary schools in bid to differentiate foods through awareness.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa kuelimisha watu wa kaunti ya Nairobi ili kukuza kilimo cha jikoni katika shule za msingi katika jitihada za kutofautisha vyakula kupitia ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Koraria omoroberio bwekaonti ya Nairobi gosegeta oboremi bwebiticha chinyeni ase chisukuru chioboroso erio goatanana chindagera na amaegerio
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida qorshe lagu barayo dadka degmada Nairobi si loo dhiirrigeliyo beeraha jikada ee dugsiyada hoose si loo kala saaro cuntooyinka iyada oo loo marayo wacyiga.
Dholuo: Walando chenro mar tiego ji e kaunti mar Nairobi mondo gijiw tije mag puodho e skul mag sekondar mondo omi ji ong'e kit chiemo mopogore opogore.

English: Annoucement by Kenya National Commission on Human Rights calling recognizing mental health as a universal human right.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Tume ya Kitaifa ya Haki za Kibinadamu ya Kenya likitaka kutambua afya ya akili kama haki ya binadamu kwa wote.
Ekegusii: Okorari inga Ekeombe Ekenene Giokoegerera Mwanyabanto kemente obochenu bwobongo buna obomaene bwa mwanyabanto
Somali: Warbixin ay soo saartay Guddiga Qaranka Kenya ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha oo ku baaqay in la aqoonsado caafimaadka dhimirka inuu yahay xuquuqda aadanaha ee caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya National Commission on Human Rights nowacho ni ng'eyo ngima mar pach dhano en ratiro mar dhano.

English: National Coordinating Committee affirming Kenya's pledges on food system reform, nutrition financing, and wellness pathways.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uratibu ikithibitisha ahadi za Kenya kuhusu mageuzi ya mfumo wa chakula, ufadhili wa lishe, na njia za ustawi.
Ekegusii: Ekomiti enene yokobwaterani,gotingia chiira chia Kenya igoro ya oboonchereria ase chindagera, obokonyi bwe chindagera nechingecho chiokogenderera
Somali: Guddiga Isku-dubaridka Qaranka oo xaqiijinaya ballanqaadyada Kenya ee ku saabsan dib-u-habaynta nidaamka cuntada, maalgelinta nafaqada, iyo waddooyinka fayoobaanta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Riwruok mar Pinyruoth ma siro singo mag piny Kenya kuom loko chenro mar chiemo, chiwo pesa mag chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok, kod yore mag bedo maber.

English: If sharing a bed with a baby, ensure the space is firm, flat, and free of pillows or loose bedding.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unashiriki kitanda kimoja na mtoto, hakikisha nafasi hiyo ni imara, tambarare, na haina mito au matandiko yaliyolegea.
Ekegusii: Gosanga egetanda na omwana, enekia ribaga ritingi, omoeya, chipilo chitaiyo gose ebirarero bitàriri
Somali: Haddii aad sariirta la wadaagto ilmahaaga, hubso in meelku yahay mid adag, oo siman, oo aan lahayn cusbooyin ama sariiro furan.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi nyathi modak e otanda achiel, bed gadier ni oting'o ot motegno, ma opong' gi tong', kendo onge chuore kata lewni.

English: Cancer unit launched at Lodwar Referral Hospital. It will ease burden for cancer patients
Kiswahili: Kitengo cha saratani chazinduliwa katika Hospitali ya Rufaa ya Lodwar. Kitapunguza mzigo kwa wagonjwa wa saratani
Ekegusii: Egetaseni gia kansa gichakigwe enyagitari enene ya Lodwar, gokeani oborito bw'ogoichorerana
Somali: Qaybta Kansarka oo laga bilaabay Isbitaalka Lodwar Referral Hospital. Waxay yareyn doontaa culayska bukaanada kansarka
Dholuo: Unit mar kansa nochakore e kar thieth mar Lodwar. Obiro dwoko piny pek ne jotuwo mag kansa

English: Educate elder children on how to take care of children under their care to avoid any accidents.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto wenye umri mkubwa jinsi ya kuwatunza watoto walio chini ya utunzaji wao ili kuepuka aksidenti.
Ekegusii: Semia abana abanenè korenda ebingwerere tibaumia batancheti
Somali: Carruurta waayeelka ah baro sida loo daryeelo caruurta ay daryeelaan si looga fogaado shilalka.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo ma hikgi ng'eny kaka ginyalo rito nyithindgi mondo kik gibed gi aksident.

English: Community maternal support groups provide peer education, emotional support, and help connect women to health services during pregnancy and postpartum.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya usaidizi wa akina mama katika jamii hutoa elimu ya rika, usaidizi wa kihisia, na husaidia kuwaunganisha wanawake na huduma za afya wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bi'ogokonya abasubati ase eamate igo bikoru chisemi ase ebigori, obokonyi bw'oboremu naboigo gokonya kobeka amo abakungu na emeroberio y'eafya chingaki bare barito nonya nekero babiarire
Somali: Kooxaha taageerada hooyooyinka ee bulshada waxay bixiyaan waxbarashada asxaabta, taageero dareen leh, waxayna ka caawiyaan haweenka inay la xiriiraan adeegyada caafimaadka inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada ka dib.
Dholuo: Grube ma konyo mine e kanyakla chiwo tiegruok ne mbesegi, kony e weche mag chuny, kendo gikonyo mon mondo obed gi winjruok maber gi weche thieth e kinde mag ich koda bang' nyuol.

English: National strategy document for ACSM (Advocacy, Communication & Social Mobilisation) launched.
Kiswahili: Hati ya mkakati wa kitaifa wa ACSM (Utetezi, Mawasiliano na Uhamasishaji wa Kijamii) yazinduliwa.
Ekegusii: Korosigwa kwa eripoti ase orogongo rwa Kenya ase ogokwanera, chinkwana na ogosegeta chinka
Somali: Dukumentiga istaraatiijiyadda qaranka ee ACSM (U doodista, Isgaarsiinta & Abaabulka Bulshada) ayaa la daahfuray.
Dholuo: Oboke mar chenro mar piny mangima mar ACSM (Loch, Tudruok kod Riwruok mar Oganda) osechako.

English: Malaria mortality rate rises to pre-pandemic levels, WHO report shows at least 597,000 people succumbed to the disease last year.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya WHO inaonyesha kuwa kiwango cha vifo kutokana na malaria kinaongezeka hadi viwango vya kabla ya janga, kwa mujibu wa ripoti hiyo.
Ekegusii: Eripoti koru ase WHO nigo ekoorokia buna amakweri korua ase Esosera amentekanire goetania ebirengo magega ya ogoateka . Ase nse pi abanto 597,000,mbasiretie amagima kobwatekana na Esosera omwaka oera.
Somali: Heerka dhimashada cudurka Malaria wuxuu kor u kacay heerarka kahor cudurka faafa, warbixinta WHO waxay muujineysaa in ugu yaraan 597,000 oo qof ay u dhinteen cudurka sanadkii la soo dhaafay.
Dholuo: Ripot mar WHO nyiso ni ji 597,000 notho nikech malaria e higa mokalo.

English: A pilot supplying instrumements and educating women to plant protenious foods within their compounds through backet farming system
Kiswahili: Rubani anayesambaza instrumments na kuelimisha wanawake kupanda vyakula vyenye ladha ndani ya misombo yao kupitia mfumo wa kilimo cha backet
Ekegusii: Omorundi chindege okorwa ebikoreri biechintetere am na koegeria ebiombe bia abakungu gosimeka chindagera chibwate amadini ase babegete obomenyo.
Somali: Tijaabo bixisa qalab iyo waxbarasho haweenka si ay ugu beeraan cuntooyin cusub gudaha xaruntooda iyada oo loo marayo nidaamka beeralayda backet
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiyo gi yore mag pidho kod puonjo mon mondo opidh chiemo ma nigi protini e dendgi kokalo kuom chenro mar pur

English: Announcement opening applications for grants to employers to establish gyms or fitness zones for staff.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kufungua maombi ya ruzuku kwa waajiri ili kuanzisha maeneo ya mazoezi ya viungo au mazoezi ya viungo kwa wafanyakazi.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa bene obokonyi bwa bosa ase abariki gochaka chigosori chia ebimo ase abarikwa
Somali: Ogeysiiska furitaanka codsiyada deeqaha loo siiyo shaqo-bixiyayaasha si loo dhiso jimicsiyada ama goobaha jimicsiga shaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny mangima.

English: In most cases when a mother talks and sings to her child improves its growth and brain development.
Kiswahili: Katika visa vingi, wakati mama anapozungumza na kuimba kwa mtoto wake huboresha ukuzi wake na maendeleo ya ubongo.
Ekegusii: Chingaki chinyinge ase ogokwana na goterera omwana ngokongia bore ogokina kwa obongo nà chinkwana
Somali: Xaaladaha intooda badan hooyadu markay ilmaheeda la hadasho oo ay u heeso waxay hagaajineysaa koritaankeeda iyo horumarka maskaxda.
Dholuo: Kinde mang'eny, sama min nyathi wuoyo kendo wero ne nyathine, mano miyo nyathino dongo kendo obwongo dongo maber.

English: Expectant women are requested to start visiting atenantal clinics starting from the first three months of conception, for the benefit of the mother and the child
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanaombwa kuanza kutembelea kliniki za uzazi kuanzia miezi mitatu ya kwanza ya ujauzito, kwa manufaa ya mama na mtoto
Ekegusii: Abakungu bare morito, naende bamenyete na ebinyinyi bienyamoreo, nigo babwenerete goika ekeriniki mapema banyore amariogo yogokeania ebinyinyi bienyamoreo, na gotanga komwambokeria Omwana.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh waxaa laga codsanayaa inay bilaabaan booqashada rugta caafimaad laga bilaabo saddexda bilood ee ugu horreeya ee uurka, si ay ugu faa'iideystaan hooyada iyo ilmaha.
Dholuo: Inyalo kwayo mon ma nigi ich mondo ochak dhi e klinike mag thieth chakre dweche adek mokwongo mag ich, mondo okony min gi nyathi.

English: The Ministry to take concern over its community health workforce through capacity development on food as one way to promote health among all
Kiswahili: Wizara ya kuchukua wasiwasi juu ya wafanyakazi wake wa afya ya jamii kupitia maendeleo ya uwezo juu ya chakula kama njia moja ya kukuza afya kati ya wote
Ekegusii: Ewizara komorekera emeremo ya abakori emeremo yobochenu bwegenka ase okoenana amaegerio yechindagera buna ensemo yogosira obochenu ase bonsi
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay ka walaacsan tahay shaqaalaheeda caafimaadka bulshada iyada oo loo marayo horumarinta awoodda cuntada sida mid ka mid ah hababka kor u qaadista caafimaadka dadka oo dhan
Dholuo: Migawo mar migawono onego okaw ting'ne mar rito ngima mar oganda kokalo kuom dongruok mar nyalo e weche mag chiemo kaka yo achiel mar jiwo ngima mar ji duto.

English: Fathers are encouraged to be active in bathing, changing, and comforting their newborns to promote bonding and family well-being.
Kiswahili: Akina baba wanahimizwa kuwa hai katika kuwaogesha, kuwabadilisha, na kuwafariji watoto wao wachanga ili kukuza uhusiano na ustawi wa familia.
Ekegusii: Abaise bana nigo bakoborigwa banyare kobasibi, kobachenchia chianga nakobagombi abana baiboirwe erio bamanyane naboigo koenekea eamate ere boronge
Somali: Aabbayaashu waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay si firfircoon u dhaqmaan, u beddelaan, oo u qalbi qaboojiyaan carruurtooda cusub si ay u horumariyaan xidhiidhka iyo farxadda qoyska.
Dholuo: Ijiwo wuone mondo oti matek e lwoko, loko lewni, kendo hoyo nyithindgi eka gibed gi winjruok maber e kindgi gi joodgi.

English: Announcement of staff health screening (BMI, blood pressure, blood sugar) and wellness baseline to shape ongoing workplace wellness programming.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la uchunguzi wa afya ya wafanyakazi (BMI, shinikizo la damu, sukari ya damu) na msingi wa ustawi ili kuunda programu zinazoendelea za ustawi mahali pa kazi.
Ekegusii: Okoraria okorenga obochenu ase abakori obochenu( BMI, ogoaka kwa amanyinga,esukari ase amanyinga) na korosia oboroso eeio korosia omoroberio yokoigwana ase emeremo
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida baaritaanka caafimaadka shaqaalaha (BMI, cadaadiska dhiigga, sonkorta dhiigga) iyo saldhigga caafimaadka si loo qaabeeyo barnaamijka caafimaadka ee ka socda goobta shaqada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar jotich (BMI, blood pressure, blood sugar) kod chenro mar bedo gi ngima maber e tich.

English: Malaria burden for men and women: Rains increases bad things to happen among women and girls
Kiswahili: Mzigo wa malaria kwa wanaume na wanawake: Mvua huongeza mambo mabaya kutokea miongoni mwa wanawake na wasichana
Ekegusii: Omosigo Bwa Esosera ase abakungu n'abasacha: Embura enyinge nigo ekomenta okonyarekana Kwa obobe gokorekana ase abasubati na chinyaroka
Somali: Cudurka Malaria ee ragga iyo dumarka: Roobku wuxuu kordhiyaa dhacdooyinka xun ee dumarka iyo gabdhaha ka dhaca
Dholuo: Chandruok ma malaria kelo ne chwo gi mon: Koth chueyo gik maricho ahinya e kind mon gi nyiri

English: Some over-the-counter drugs can harm your unborn baby. Always consult a health worker.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya dawa zinazouzwa bila agizo la daktari zinaweza kumdhuru mtoto wako ambaye hajazaliwa. Daima wasiliana na mfanyakazi wa afya.
Ekegusii: Amariogo akoonerigwa chituka na araotorane obochenu bwa abana Botambe boria omonyagitari
Somali: Daawooyinka la iibiyo qaarkood waxay waxyeeleyn karaan ilmahaaga aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Nitie yedhe ma ok nyal thiedhi ma nyalo hinyo nyathini mapok onyuol.

English: Kenya receives 10,700 doses of Mpox vaccine to curb disease spread, Health Ministry says; 67 cases confirmed since July 2024.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema Kenya yapokea dozi 10,700 za chanjo ya Mpox ili kupunguza kuenea kwa ugonjwa huo; visa 67 vimethibitishwa tangu Julai 2024.
Ekegusii: Kenya yanyorire chidosi 10,700 chiesindani ya ogotanga Mpox erinde gotanga okoambokeria .Ewizara y'Oborwaria nigo yateba koru omotienyi o gatano na kabere, abanto 67 banyorire oborwaire obo.
Somali: Kenya waxay heshay 10,700 qiyaasood oo ah tallaalka Mpox si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka cudurka, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegtay; 67 kiis ayaa la xaqiijiyay tan iyo bishii Luulyo 2024.
Dholuo: Kenya oyudo dose 10,700 mag thieth mar Mpox mar geng'o landruok mar tuoche, Ministry of Health wacho; ji 67 oseromo gi tuwono chakre Julai 2024.

English: Husband and wife sharing together before the birth of the birth of the child and after birth, builds their relationship
Kiswahili: Mume na mke wanapoishi pamoja kabla ya mtoto kuzaliwa na baada ya kuzaliwa, uhusiano wao huimarika
Ekegusii: Omogaka nomgina gosango amo mwensi omwana ataràiborwa na ekero aiboirwe, nkoagachere oboamate bwobonyomba
Somali: Ninka iyo xaaskiisa marka ay wada noolaadaan ka hor dhalashada ilmaha iyo ka dib dhalashada waxay sii xoojinayaan xidhiidhkooda
Dholuo: Ka dichwo gi dhako timo gik moko kanyachiel kapok onyuol nyathi kendo bang' nyuolo nyathi, mano tego winjruok manie kindgi

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed three new Mpox cases in Busia County, bringing the total number to 42 since the outbreak in July 2024.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox katika Kaunti ya Busia, na kufikisha jumla ya visa 42 tangu mlipuko wa virusi hivyo Julai 2024.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Oborwaria yaenekirie abanto bande batato korwara MPOX ase ekaunti ya Busia, yaikirie enamba y'abarwaire goika 42 koru ogoateka Kwa Mpox,julai 2024
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka dhacay degmada Busia, taasoo wadarta tirada u kordhisay 42 tan iyo markii uu dillaacay bishii Luulyo 2024.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oseyie gi ji adek manyien ma nigi Mpox e County mar Busia, mamiyo kwan duto mar ji osedok 42 chakre tuwono chakre Julai 2024.

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed to Kenyans that it will not fall short of important drugs including HIV AIDS and TB for the next one year.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha kwa Wakenya kwamba haitashindwa kupata dawa muhimu kama vile UKIMWI na kifua kikuu kwa mwaka mmoja ujao.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Afya yabaenekeirie abakenya buna amariogo ye ng'encho takobora gose gokea amo na aya Enyamoreo na esese ase omoaka oyomo okobwatia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa dadka Kenya u xaqiijisay inaysan ka maqnaan doonin daawooyin muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin HIV AIDS iyo TB sanadka soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osenyiso Jo-Kenya ni ok gibi bedo maonge gi yedhe madongo moriwo HIV AIDS kod TB kuom higa achiel mabiro.

English: Timely screening help the unborn child from HIV transmission by its mother
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa wakati unaofaa husaidia mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa kutokana na kuambukizwa virusi vya UKIMWI na mama yake
Ekegusii: Okorengwa kwa bwango ngokonye omwana otaraiborwa taambokerigwa enyamorao
Somali: Baarista waqtigeeda ah waxay ka caawineysaa ilmaha aan dhalan inuu u gudbiyo HIV hooyadiis
Dholuo: Nono nyathino e kinde mowinjore konyo nyathi mapok onyuol nikech tuwo mar HIV ma min mare kelo

English: If your child is not sitting, crawling, or speaking by the expected age, visit a pediatric clinic for evaluation
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto wako hajakaa, hajatambaa, au hajazungumza kwa umri unaotarajiwa, tembelea kliniki ya watoto kwa ajili ya tathmini.
Ekegusii: Onye omwana oo taraikaransa, tari kwagora, gose tari gokwana ase chingaki chibwenerete, tarera enyagitari y'abana igere onyore obomanyi.
Somali: Haddii ilmahaagu uusan fadhiisan karin, ku duuli karin ama uusan hadlin da'da la filayo, booqo rugta caafimaadka carruurta si loo qiimeeyo
Dholuo: Kapo ni nyathini ok nyal bet piny, kata wuotho, kata wuoyo, dhi e osiptal mar nyithindo mondo otimne nonro

English: Research by KEMRI has confirmed that Invermectin controls the spread the spread of malaria in a special way
Kiswahili: Utafiti uliofanywa na KEMRI umethibitisha kwamba Invermectin huzuia kuenea kwa malaria kwa njia maalum.
Ekegusii: Oboringoria bwa KEMRI bwaenekirie ing'a Ivermectin nigo egokeania okwambokeria gw'Esosera ase engecho enene.
Somali: Cilmi baaris ay sameysay KEMRI ayaa xaqiijisay in Invermectin ay si gaar ah u xakameyso faafitaanka faafitaanka malaria

English: Techniques like deep breathing,walking or time outdoors are universal tools for managing daily stressors.

Bed gi chiemo mopong' gi antioxidant - amla, guava, leafy green vegetables, spinach, adundo, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Tim tiegruok 4. Meditation 5. Bed gi nindo maber.

English: More than 80% patients who have symptoms of Covid 19 cqn be treated and go back to their homes. The Ministry of Health has finished formulating home-based care guidelines. I request Kenyans, when we shall issue those guidelines, and we shall see people going back to their homes.

English: Develop routines for nutrition, exercise, and sleep. This promotes physical and mental health, contributing to a balanced lifestyle.

English: Ecpectant mothers are advized to eat only required foods for their health and their unborn babies, with minerals like iron, protein and vitamin in support of the unborn baby and pregnancy care

English: Excessive beer drinking, remains a challenge to many Kenyans, and mobile beer sellers in Mt. Kenya contributes to this problem. Hospitals need to be equiped with a management plan on how to prevent what could be compelling reasons that push people to drink excessively

English: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer

Ebisa ebi nigo bigoachera ogopimwa kobwate oborendi naende kwa bwango na obonge. Ebisa ebi biroseiri ime y'ensemo eyuo biaonchorire egosori.
