Kiswahili: Tangazo la mfululizo wa mabaraza ya kujifunza ya kaunti yanayosisitiza usaidizi wa kunyonyesha, usafi wa jamii, na elimu ya lishe ya watoto wachanga.
Ekegusii: Okoraria amaegerio ase chibarasa ase chikaunti chirengete obokonyi ase okogonkia,obochenu bwegenka na chisemi chiokoragera okuya ase ebingwerere
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida taxane ka mid ah goobaha barashada ee gobolka oo ku adkeysanaya taageerada naasnuujinta, nadaafadda bulshada, iyo waxbarashada cuntada ilmaha.
Dholuo: Owacho ni ibiro tim chokruok moro mar puonjruok e gweng'no ma biro jiwo ahinya weche mag pidho nyithindo gi minegi, rito ler mar oganda, kod tiego nyithindo e weche mag chiemo.

English: Notification that Makueni county has been recognised for efficient implementation of National Nutrition plan matched with national health priorities, with stunting reduced to 20%.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kwamba kaunti ya Makueni imetambuliwa kwa utekelezaji bora wa mpango wa Kitaifa wa Lishe unaoendana na vipaumbele vya kitaifa vya afya, huku udumavu ukipungua hadi 20%.
Ekegusii: Okoraria ekaunti ya Makueni yamanyekanire ase ogoikerania emeroberio bwechindagera ogochiera amo nebitambokero ebitangani ase orogongo, na gokeani ogotakina goika 20%
Somali: Ogeysiiska in degmada Makueni loo aqoonsaday hirgelinta hufan ee qorshaha nafaqada qaranka oo la jaan qaadaya mudnaanta caafimaadka qaranka, iyadoo dib u dhac lagu yareeyay 20%.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar alwora mar Makueni oseng'ere kuom tiyo gi chenro mar National Nutrition plan e yo mong'ith kaluwore gi dwaro mag thieth e piny mangima, kendo kwan mar ji modok chien osedok chien nyaka 20%.

English: National ACSM strategy introduced to promote nutrition messaging and public awareness across sectors.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa kitaifa wa ACSM ulianzishwa ili kukuza ujumbe wa lishe na uelewa wa umma katika sekta mbalimbali.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yorogongo ase ACSM gochakia na gokinia amangana yokoragera okuya na obomanyi ase chinsagia ao ao
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda Qaranka ee ACSM ayaa la soo bandhigay si loo dhiirrigeliyo fariimaha nafaqada iyo wacyiga dadweynaha ee dhinacyada kala duwan.
Dholuo: Chenro mar National ACSM ne oket mondo okony ji ong'e wach chiemo e yore mopogore opogore.

English: Breastfeeding is natural and should be supported in public. Communities should offer safe, clean spaces for mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunyonyesha ni jambo la kawaida na linapaswa kuungwa mkono hadharani. Jamii zinapaswa kutoa nafasi salama na safi kwa akina mama.
Ekegusii: Okogonkia nokwabotambe na gwancherwa maiso marore Ebinyoro biarwa ribaga risaine rigiya ase abàngina bakogonkia
Somali: Quudinta naas nuujinta waa mid dabiici ah waana in lagu taageeraa dadweynaha. Bulshooyinka waa in ay siiyaan hooyooyinka meelo ammaan ah oo nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Nyithindo onego omed yudo thuolo mar tedo gi nyithindgi e yo maler kendo e yo makare.

English: Let's talk mental health! If they stopped talking, please check on them.
Kiswahili: Tuzungumzie afya ya akili! Ikiwa waliacha kuzungumza, tafadhali waangalie.
Ekegusii: Tokwanere obochenu bwobongo! Konye batigete gokwanera, koranche barigie
Somali: Aan ka hadalno caafimaadka dhimirka haddii ay joojiyeen inay hadlaan, fadlan iska hubi.
Dholuo: Ka ne giseweyo wuoyo, ne ane kaka ne gidak.

English: Rising temperatures elevate the risk to Nairobi's malaria-free status
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa joto huongeza hatari ya kutokuwepo kwa malaria jijini Nairobi
Ekegusii: Ogokina Kwa riberera,gokomenta okonyarekana Kwa Esosera gotabao ase ensemo ya Nairobi
Somali: Heerkulka sii kordhaya ayaa khatarta ka dhigeysa in Nairobi ay ka baxdo Cudurka Cudurrada
Dholuo: Medruok mar liet mar nam miyo Nairobi bedo kama onge malaria

English: World Accounty, through its company incharge of distribution of drugs and other medical gadgets, is distributing nets in various counties in Kenya with high malaria burden
Kiswahili: World Accounty, kupitia kampuni yake inayosimamia usambazaji wa madawa ya kulevya na vifaa vingine vya kitiba, inashiriki katika kusambaza mitandao katika wilaya mbalimbali nchini Kenya zenye matatizo makubwa ya malaria
Ekegusii: Ekegancha gi'ense, goetera ase ekampuni y'okobaga amariogo amo na ebinto ao ao bi'oborwaria, nkobaga kere chineti ase chinsemo ao ao chi'Ense ya Kenya chiria chibwate Esosera kera engaki .
Somali: World Accounty waxay shirkadeeda u xilsaaran qeybinta daawooyinka iyo qalabka kale ee caafimaadka, u qeybisaa shabakadaha degmooyinka kala duwan ee Kenya oo ay ku jiraan culeysyo badan oo cudurka malaria ah
Dholuo: World Accounty, kotiyo gi kambi mare matayo tij pogo yedhe mamero kod gik mamoko mitiyogo e thieth, miyo ji otese e gwenge mopogore opogore mag Kenya ma nigi pek mang'eny mag malaria

English: Until now, 36 people are confirmed infcted with Mpox in Kenya, two people have been hospitalized and one quarantined
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa, watu 36 wamethibitishwa kuwa wameambukizwa Mpox nchini Kenya, watu wawili wamelazwa hospitalini na mmoja amewekwa katika karantini
Ekegusii: Goikera bonoiga, abanto 36 baenekigwe gotwara oborwaire bwa MPOX ime ya Kenya, abanto babere batangire nyagitari na oyomo akorwarerigwa nyomba .
Somali: Ilaa hadda, 36 qof ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay inay qabaan Mpox Kenya, labo qof ayaa la dhigay isbitaalka, midna waa la karantiilay
Dholuo: Nyaka sani, ji 36 oseyudo tuwono mar Mpox e Kenya, ji ariyo osedonjo e osiptal kendo achiel osepwodhi

English: Physical contact of a child with her mother adds it warm to the body and bonds its relationahip with the mother.
Kiswahili: Mawasiliano ya kimwili ya mtoto na mama yake huongeza joto katika mwili na huunganisha uhusiano wake na mama.
Ekegusii: Ogokunana kwomwana nomobere ong'ina nigo gokomentera riberera ase omwana, okoeyana na okobwatana gose oboamate ase nomwana na ng'ina
Somali: Xidhiidhka jirka ee ilmaha uu hooyadiis la yeesho wuxuu jidhkiisa ku darayaa diirimaad iyo xidhiidh la leh hooyadiis.
Dholuo: Sama nyathi otudore gi min mare, mano miyo dende bedo mamor kendo omedo bedo gi winjruok maber gi min-gi.

English: Launch of a pilot to provide free milk twice weekly to primary school children in Migori and Nakuru counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa majaribio ya kutoa maziwa ya bure mara mbili kwa wiki kwa watoto wa shule za msingi katika kaunti za Migori na Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa amatemu koenana amabere atarigwakanerewa, kabere ase omokubio ase abana chisukuru chia oboroso ime ya Migori na Nakuru
Somali: Daahfurka tijaabo ah oo caano bilaash ah la siinayo carruurta dugsiyada hoose/dhexe ee ku nool degmooyinka Migori iyo Nakuru laba jeer usbuucii.
Dholuo: Chako chenro mar chiwo chak ma nono dichiel juma ka juma ne nyithindo ma sikul ma piny e gwenge mag Migori kod Nakuru.

English: Through the national committee's emergency and response directives, we shall reduce long protocols, in entire Kenya, for the next two weeks coming, starting from tomorrow, March 16, 2020, to allow more time for dissemonation on the prevemntion of infections
Kiswahili: Kupitia maagizo ya dharura na majibu ya kamati ya kitaifa, tutapunguza mikataba mirefu, kote Kenya, kwa wiki mbili zijazo, kuanzia kesho, Machi 16, 2020, ili kuruhusu wakati zaidi wa kueneza juu ya kuzuia maambukizo
Ekegusii: Kobwatekana nerichiko rirure nekamiti yense yomoaganano namairanerio, ntokeanie emeroberio yebigambero, ense engima, emekubio ebere ekobwatia, gochakera mambia, March 16, 2020, erio koenana ribaga riogosemania mono na kobeka ebirengo biogotanga ogoichora kwebinyinyi.
Somali: Iyada oo loo marayo tilmaamaha xaaladaha degdegga ah iyo jawaab celinta ee guddiga qaranka, waxaan yareyn doonnaa borotokoollada dheer, guud ahaan Kenya, labadii toddobaad ee soo socota, laga bilaabo berrito, Maarso 16, 2020, si loo furo waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu faafiyo ka hortagga cudurrada faafa
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom chike ma komiti mar piny owacho ochiwo e weche mag ywaruok kod chiwo dwoko, wabiro dwoko chien chenro mag ndalo mang'eny, e piny Kenya duto, kuom jumbe ariyo mabiro, kochakore kiny, Mach 16, 2020, mondo omi thuolo momedore mar lando weche mag geng'o tuoche

English: It's important to take care of your mental health because it can impact every aspect of your life, including your relationships, your academic performance, and your physical health.
Kiswahili: Ni muhimu kutunza afya yako ya akili kwa sababu inaweza kuathiri kila nyanja ya maisha yako, ikiwa ni pamoja na mahusiano yako, utendaji wako wa kitaaluma, na afya yako ya kimwili.
Ekegusii: Nere buya korenda obochenu bwobongo ekiagera nero ebogoretie ensemo yobogima, oboamate bwago, amasomo ago na obochenu bwomobere
Somali: Waa muhiim inaad daryeesho caafimaadkaaga maskaxda sababtoo ah waxay saameyn kartaa dhinac kasta oo noloshaada ah, oo ay ku jiraan xiriirkaaga, waxqabadkaaga waxbarasho, iyo caafimaadkaaga jireed.
Dholuo: En gima duong’ mondo ibed gi ritruok e wi ngimani mar paro nikech mano nyalo ketho gik moko duto e ngimani, moriwo nyaka osiepni, kaka isomo, kod ngimani mar ringruok.

English: Maids are required to wash their hands with soap, before holding a child, once they have finished reming them napkins/pampers and before feeding them to prevent infections
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa kike wanapaswa kuosha mikono yao kwa sabuni, kabla ya kumshika mtoto, baada ya kumaliza kumnyunyizia napkins/pampers na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizo
Ekegusii: Abareri nigo babwenerete gosibia amaboko amo n'esabuni, batarabwata abana, ekero bakorire kobarusia ebitangachabu na ekero batarabarageria erinde gotanga chindwari.
Somali: Hooyooyinka waxaa looga baahan yahay inay gacmahooda ku maydhaan saabuun, ka hor intaanay ilmaha qabsan, ka dib markay dhammeystaan in ay ku dhejiyaan sariiraha / sariirada iyo ka hor inta aan la quudin si looga hortago cudurrada
Dholuo: Nyiri ma tiyo e ot nyaka luok luetegi gi sabun, kapok omako nyathi, bang' ka osetieko rwakogi gi napkins/pampers kendo kapok opidhogi mondo kik giyud tuoche

English: Disturbance of peace, incitement, looting, and vandalism remain unlawful.
Kiswahili: Uvunjifu wa amani, uchochezi, uporaji, na uharibifu wa mali bado ni kinyume cha sheria.
Ekegusii: Ogoturubania omorembe, ogosegeta abanto, okiba, na gosaria ebinto nigo bire mamincha yerichiko.
Somali: Nabadgelyada kala jeexjeexinta, dhiirigelinta, boolida, iyo burburinta ayaa weli sharci darro ah.
Dholuo: Ketho kuwe, chwanyo ji, kwalo gik moko, kod ketho gik moko pod ok owinjore gi chik.

English: If someone says 'I'm with DCI, help me fix your computer', hang up! It's a scam.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atasema 'Niko upande wa DCI, nisaidie kurekebisha kompyuta yako', kata simu! Ni ulaghai.
Ekegusii: Omonto aise kogotebi 'nao inde nomotuku omonene, nkonye nkoroserie enkombiuta yao, rimia omonto oyio korwa enkwara nere! Oyo nkogokona are akoibere anamangana ao korwa ekombiuta.
Somali: Haddii qof ku yidhaahdo, 'Waxaan ka tirsan ahay DCI, i caawi inaan dayactiro kombiyuutarkaaga', xir! Waa khiyaamo.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato owacho ni, 'Atiyo ne DCI, konya loso kompyuteni,' dwok oko!

English: Academic forums examined youth trauma, state violence, and pathways to justice arising from protest repression.
Kiswahili: Mikutano ya kitaaluma ilichunguza majeraha ya vijana, jeuri ya serikali, na njia za kupata haki zinazotokana na ukandamizaji wa maandamano.
Ekegusii: Okoumerana kwabasomi korigia ekerengo abasae baumiete kebirengererio nobongo, buna obogambi bogotumua chinguru koumisa abanainchi, amo nenchira chireo korigia obokonyi bwekemachiko ase okomiga abakorobererekana.
Somali: Madasha aqooneed waxay baareen dhaawacyada dhalinyarada, rabshadaha dowladda, iyo wadooyinka caddaaladda ee ka dhasha cadaadis diidmada mudaaharaadka.
Dholuo: Chokruoge ma ne itimo ne nono chandruoge ma rowere yudo, timbe mahundu mag sirkal, kod yore mag ng'ado bura e yo makare nikech akwede.

English: A police partnership initiative trained young women in self-defense and educated participants on rights and complaint channels.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa ushirikiano wa polisi uliwazoeza wanawake vijana katika kujitetea na kuwaelimisha washiriki juu ya haki na njia za malalamiko.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokobwaterana nabasikari mbwegeretie abangina abasae buna baranyare kwerende korwa emechando na gosomia omosangerekano igoro yoboronge bwabo amo nenchera yokorwa okwemuranganania.
Somali: Tallaabada iskaashiga booliska ayaa tababar u siisay haweenka dhallinyarada ah difaaca naftooda waxayna bartay kaqeybgalayaasha xuquuqda iyo wadooyinka cabashooyinka.
Dholuo: Chenro moro mar riwruok mar polise ne otiego mon ma rowere e rito ngimagi giwegi kendo ne opuonjo jopuonjre e wi ratiro kod yore mag ng'ado buche.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."
Kiswahili: "Taarifa kwa umma: DCI imefunga kampuni ya ulaghai ya mali isiyohamishika inayofanya kazi kwa majina mengi huko Kiambu. Daima fanya utafutaji katika Wizara ya Ardhi."
Ekegusii: "Ogokurera ase bonsi": Omotuki omonene osiekire ekampani yobokengeka ogokora obokengeka bwaye goetera amarieta ao ao aaria Kiambu ekongaina abanto kobaoneria emechi yokomenya operating. Kera engaki rigia komanya obomaene bwebinto binga buna ebio korwa ofosi yamaremo."
Somali: "Ogaysiis dadweyne: DCI waxay xidhtay shirkad hantida maguurtada ah oo ka shaqeysa magacyo badan oo ku yaal Kiambu. Had iyo jeer baaritaan ku samee wasaaradda dhulka".
Dholuo: "Dhi nyime gi timo nonro e ofis mar Land Ministry. "

English: Ongoing training in Kakamega supports security personnel in staying ahead of evolving violent extremism tactics affecting youth.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yanayoendelea huko Kakamega yanawasaidia wafanyakazi wa usalama kukaa mbele ya mbinu zinazoendelea za ugaidi wenye jeuri zinazoathiri vijana.
Ekegusii: Okwegererigwa gwakogenderera aari Kakamega gwakonyire abarendi borendi gotigara maiso igoro yechiburaburu chiogosaria abasae ebirengererio chiakegeire koba.
Somali: Tababarka socda ee ka socda Kakamega wuxuu taageerayaa shaqaalaha amniga in ay ka horeeyaan tallaabooyinka xagjirnimada rabshadaha ah ee saameynaya dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma dhi nyime Kakamega konyo jorit sirkal mondo obed motelo ne timbe mahundu ma timore ne rowere.

English: Training provided to mining sector stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to reduce misuse by terror groups and prevent smuggling.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yametolewa kwa wadau wa sekta ya madini kuhusu utunzaji salama wa vilipuzi vya kibiashara ili kupunguza matumizi mabaya ya vikundi vya kigaidi na kuzuia ulanguzi wa magendo.
Ekegusii: Ekwegerigwa kwarurwe ase baria bakorema amadini na baria bakobwaterana buna bakoiya, kogacha na kobibogoria bakeanie okobitatumia buya na baria abasaria bokoruta chipomu na gotanga oboibi bwebinto ebio.
Somali: Tababar loogu talagalay daneeyayaasha warshadaha macdanta ee ku saabsan maaraynta amaanka ah ee walxaha qarxa ee ganacsiga si loo yareeyo isticmaalka xun ee kooxaha argagixisada iyo ka hortagga gaadiidka.
Dholuo: Tiegruok mitimo ne jogo motudore gi weche mag lwang'o yien e weche mag tiyo gi gik makelo hinyruok e yore mag ohala e yo makare mondo geng'o grube mag mahundu kik ti kodgi e yo marach kendo mondo kik ng'ato donj e wuodhno.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre invited public contributions for artificial intelligence solutions to counter online radicalization and self recruitment.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kilialikwa kutoa mchango wa umma kwa ajili ya suluhisho za akili bandia kupambana na ukatili wa mtandaoni na kujitegemea.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaariganetie ebirengererio korwa abanainchi korigia amachibu igoro yechisemi chia pandia buna enchera eyemo yokorwania obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio goetra eintaneti na na kwerika barabwo abanyene gochia ase obosaria obwo.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ayaa ku baaqday dadweynaha inay gacan ka geystaan xalalka sirdoonka macmalka ah si looga hortago xagjirnimada internetka iyo is-qeybgalka.
Dholuo: National Counter-Terrorism Centre ne ogwelo ji mondo ochiw kony ne yore mag tiyo gi riekni ma loso pach ji mondo gimi ji thuolo mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e Intanet.

English: "CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'."
Kiswahili: "CBK inawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba benki halali hazifanyi matangazo kupitia visanduku vya barua pepe vya Facebook. Puuza jumbe zinazouliza maelezo ya akaunti ili 'kuamsha zawadi'."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK) nkoinyoria ere abanto ba Kenyan ng'a chibengi boronge tichiri gokinia abakori emeremo babo goetera Facebook. Ombia mang'ana ande onsi akogosaba obae ennamba yao yebengi erio bakobekere ekeegwa gie chibesa."
Somali: "CBK waxay dadka Kenya xasuusineysaa in bangiyada sharciga ah aysan dhicin dallacaadyo sanduuqyada Facebook. Iska daa fariimaha weydiinaya faahfaahinta koontada si ay 'u dhaqaajiso abaalmarinta'".
Dholuo: "CBK paronwa Jo-Kenya ni bengi ma nigi chike makare ok tim kampen e otese ma giyudo e Facebook.

English: Opening of the Anti Terrorism Police Unit Coast Headquarters to strengthen investigations and community engagement.
Kiswahili: Kufungua makao makuu ya polisi ya kupambana na ugaidi ili kuimarisha uchunguzi na ushiriki wa jumuiya.
Ekegusii: Okoigorwa kwegetengo kia abasikari bakinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu aaria omochie omonene O'Mombasa gokong'ia obotuki nokobwaterana nebinyoro.
Somali: Furitaanka Xarunta Ciidanka Booliska ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada si loo xoojiyo baaritaannada iyo ka qaybgalka bulshada.
Dholuo: Chenro mar yawo ofis maduong' mar polise ma kedo gi timbe mahundu mondo omed jiwo nonro kod riwruok mar oganda.

English: Judiciary introduced a strategic framework to eliminate corruption.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ilianzisha mfumo wa kimkakati wa kukomesha ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Ekoti yaansire omoroberio ebeene gokora obokorekanu.
Somali: Garsoorka ayaa soo bandhigay qaab istiraatiiji ah oo lagu baabi'inayo musuqmaasuqa.
Dholuo: Sirkal noketo chenro mar tieko mibadhi.

English: Editorial commentary advocated reforms to the Public Order Act to safeguard peaceful assembly and curb excessive force.
Kiswahili: Maelezo ya wahariri yaliunga mkono mageuzi ya Sheria ya Amri ya Umma ili kulinda kusanyiko la amani na kuzuia nguvu kupita kiasi.
Ekegusii: Amanga ya abange buna barwete ebirengererio biabo gosegeta oboonchoreria ase richiko ritenenerete buna abanto baukoumerana ase obonge na korobererekana erio korenda ogocha amo nokorobererekana kwomorembe igo gotanga abasikari gotumia chinguru chinyinge.
Somali: Faallooyinka tifaftiraha ayaa u dooday dib u habeynta Sharciga Nidaamka Dadweynaha si loo ilaaliyo isu imaatinka nabadda iyo xakamaynta xoogga xad dhaafka ah.
Dholuo: Weche ma ne ondik e gaset ne jiwo ni otim lokruok e chike mag sirkal mondo omi ji ochak chokre gi kuwe kendo geng'o tiyo gi teko mokalo tong'.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre and Operation Amani Boni conducted community workshops in Lamu County that focused on awareness, intelligence sharing, and resilience building.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi na Operesheni Amani Boni zilifanya semina za jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu ambazo zililenga ufahamu, ushiriki wa habari, na kujenga uvumilivu.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) orogetwe "Amani Boni" nokorete emesangererekano aaria ekaonti ya Lamu yamoregete omokanyia abanto, koererania amang'ana obotuki, na kobakong'ia.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada iyo Howlgalka Amani Boni waxay ku qabteen aqoon isweydaarsiyo bulshada ee Gobolka Lamu oo diiradda saarey wacyiga, wadaagista sirdoonka, iyo dhismaha adkeysiga.
Dholuo: National Counter Terrorism Centre kod Operation Amani Boni ne otimo chokruok e alwora mar Lamu County ma ne oketo pachgi kuom wach ng'eyo, pogo weche mag mibadhi, kod gero teko mar geng'o gik maricho.

English: Reuters confirmed the arrest of Constable Mukhwana over the death of blogger Albert Ojwang, marking a rare formal charge amid unrest.
Kiswahili: Reuters ilithibitisha kukamatwa kwa Konstebo Mukhwana kutokana na kifo cha mwanablogu Albert Ojwang, na kuashiria shtaka rasmi ambalo ni nadra kutokea wakati wa machafuko.
Ekegusii: Abarimi amang'ana ba Reuters mbaenegetie okobwatwa kwomosikari Mukhwana igoro yamakweri yomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera Albert Ojwang, eke nigo kiabete egento getanyagokoreka rinde, na konyorwa nare nekina giokoiraneria nonya chuburaburu chiareo.
Somali: Reuters ayaa xaqiijisay in la xiray Constable Mukhwana dhimashada blogger-ka Albert Ojwang, taas oo ah eedeyn rasmi ah oo aan caadi aheyn iyadoo ay jirto rabshado.
Dholuo: Reuters osenyiso ni ne omak Constable Mukhwana nikech tho mar blogger Albert Ojwang, ma en ketho makende ahinya e kinde mag ywaruok.

English: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money."
Kiswahili: Matangazo hayo ya kazi kwa 'mawakala wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaoajiri wahesabuji' bila mahojiano ni ulaghai. Thibitisha na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kabla ya kutuma pesa.
Ekegusii: Amangana ogosegeta korwa abaagenti ba'NGO ng'a nkorika bare abanto bakorika amang'ana gotakorigwa ogotemwa kwemeremo namangana oborimo. Manya boronge ng'a NGO ki yatomete amang'ana ayio."
Somali: Xayeysiisyada shaqo ee loogu talagalay 'Wasiirada NGO-yada oo shaqaaleysiinaya dadka tirada leh' oo aan la waraysan waa khiyaano. Ka hor intaadan lacag dirin ka hubi NGO-da dhabta ah. "
Dholuo: Kata kamano, ka ng'ato ok otimo kamano, mano ok nyal konye ng'eyo ni en ng'at machalo nade.

English: Kenya and the U.S. signed a partnership to strengthen border surveillance, intelligence sharing, and law-enforcement training.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Marekani zilisaini ushirikiano wa kuimarisha ulinzi wa mpaka, ushiriki wa habari, na mafunzo ya utekelezaji wa sheria.
Ekegusii: Kenya amo neserikari ya America baigwanire kobwaterana erio gokong'ia obomongeri bwechinsinyo chiato, koererania obutuki, na amasomo buna amachiko agokora emeremo.
Somali: Kenya iyo Mareykanka waxay saxiixdeen iskaashi si loo xoojiyo kormeerka xuduudaha, wadaagista sirdoonka, iyo tababarka fulinta sharciga.
Dholuo: Kenya gi Amerka noketo sei e riwruok mar owete mondo gijiw chenro mar rito tong'gi, pogo weche mag sirkal, kod tiego joma rito chik.

English: "The Ministry of ICT reminds citizens that all eCitizen payments are automated. Do not send money to personal numbers for services."
Kiswahili: "Wizara ya TEHAMA inawakumbusha raia kwamba malipo yote ya kielektroniki ni otomatiki. Usitume pesa kwa nambari za kibinafsi kwa huduma."
Ekegusii: "Eminisitiri yamang'ana netekinorochi yokoererania amang'ana (ICT)nkoinyoria ere abanainchi chibesa chionsi chia eCitizen nigo chigoakanwa goetera ebengi na Mpesa chimanyekanete neserikari . Tiga gotoma chibesa gochia chinamba chabanto nonya ngake."
Somali: "Wasaaradda ICT waxay muwaadiniinta xasuusineysaa in dhammaan lacag bixinta eCitizen ay tahay mid otomaatig ah. Ha u dirin lacag lambarrada shaqsiyadeed ee adeegyada".
Dholuo: "Ministari mar ICT parone raia ni chudo duto mag eCitizen gin mag otomatiki.

English: NCTC led a national dialogue addressing youth vulnerabilities exploited by extremist groups and promoting multi-stakeholder resilience.
Kiswahili: NCTC iliongoza mazungumzo ya kitaifa kushughulikia udhaifu wa vijana wanaotumiwa na vikundi vya kigaidi na kukuza uvumilivu wa mashirika mengi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaraete chinkwana chiense gokwanera buna obogongeru bwabasae bogotumeka nabibago biria bigosaria amongo abo na gosegeta okobwaterana korwa chinsemo ao ao.
Somali: NCTC waxay hoggaamisay wadahadal qaran oo la xariira daciifnimada dhalinyarada ay ka faa'iideystaan kooxaha xagjirka ah iyo kor u qaadida adkeysiga dhinacyada daneeyayaasha badankood.
Dholuo: NCTC ne ochako tudruok e piny mangima e wi wach tieko chandruok ma rowere yudo ka ginie bwo loch mag grube mahundu kendo ne okonyo ji mang'eny mondo obed gi teko mar nano.

English: Over thirty thousand Kenya Prison Service staff received training on detecting and mitigating violent extremism within correctional facilities.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wafanyakazi 30,000 wa Huduma ya Magereza ya Kenya walipokea mafunzo ya kutambua na kupunguza ukandamizaji wenye jeuri katika vituo vya kurekebisha makosa.
Ekegusii: Goetania abasikari 30,000 bechera mbanyorete amasomo buna bakiomanya na gotanga ogosarigwa obongo koba ekebago giokoruta chipomu ime ase chichera.
Somali: In ka badan soddon kun oo shaqaale ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada xabsiyada Kenya ayaa la tababbaray sida loo ogaado loona yareeyo xagjirnimada rabshadaha ah ee ka jirta xarumaha xabsiga.
Dholuo: Jotich mokalo 30,000 mag Kenya Prison Service ne oyudo tiegruok mar fwenyo kod geng'o timbe mahundu e jela.

English: "The Judiciary has received complaints about fake court summons sent via email. Summons are never delivered electronically or through WhatsApp
Kiswahili: "Mahakama imepokea malalamiko kuhusu wito bandia wa mahakama unaotumwa kupitia barua pepe. Wito haujawasilishwa kielektroniki au kupitia WhatsApp."
Ekegusii: "EkKoti yanyorire okwemurunganania okonge igoro yokorangerigwa kwa abanto baike kotini ase enchera yoborimo goetera eintaneti. Amangana yokorangerigwa goika kotini tari gotomwa goetera eintaneti gose goetera Whatsapp.
Somali: "Xukuumadda Garsoorka waxay heshay cabashooyin ku saabsan cinwaanada maxkamadda been abuurka ah ee loo diray emayl.
Dholuo: "Tiko mar Bura oseyudo kwayo mag miriambo mag kot ma ne oor kokalo kuom e-mail.

English: Always have a working flashlight and extra batteries at home.
Kiswahili: Daima uwe na tochi inayofanya kazi na betri za ziada nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki tema koba netochi inka orayare gwokia ekero esitima yagendire amao nasasi ande oranyare koyebeka ekro aria are ime aerire.
Somali: Had iyo jeer guriga hayso laambad shaqeeya iyo baytariyo dheeri ah.
Dholuo: Kinde duto bed gi taya matiyo kendo bed gi batri momedore e odi.

English: "DCI warns against conmen selling fake 'church land' in Kayole and Ruai. Verify ownership documents at the Ministry of Lands before making any payment."
Kiswahili: "DCI yaonya dhidi ya matapeli wanaouza 'ardhi bandia ya kanisa' huko Kayole na Ruai. Thibitisha hati za umiliki katika Wizara ya Ardhi kabla ya kufanya malipo yoyote."
Ekegusii: "Omotuki omonene orure ogokurera gochia abangainereria baria bakkonia amaremo echikanisa ataiyo aari kayole na Ruai. Manya buya abanyene oboremo ase ofisi chia amaremo otaraakana besa chinde chionsi."
Somali: "DCI waxay ka digeysaa khiyaanooyinka iibinaya 'goobta kaniisadda' ee Kayole iyo Ruai. Hubi dukumiintiyada lahaanshaha ee Wasaaradda Dhulka ka hor intaadan bixin wax lacag ah".
Dholuo: "DICI chiwo siem ne jong'ayi ma uso 'piny mag kanisa' e Kayole kod Ruai.

English: UNODC and the National Counter Terrorism Centre are training officials to improve detection of terrorism financing.
Kiswahili: UNODC na Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi wanatoa mafunzo kwa maafisa ili kuboresha ugunduzi wa fedha za ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Office enene yense etenerete omariogo nobosaria (UNODC) amo na ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkwegeria bare abakori emeremo babo gokongia obomongeria igoro ya baria bakoa ebibago chibesa chigokora obokebago vbwokoruta chipomu.
Somali: UNODC iyo Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada ayaa tababar siinaya mas'uuliyiinta si loo hagaajiyo ogaanshaha maalgelinta argagixisadda.
Dholuo: UNODC kod National Counter-Terrorism Centre tiego jotelo mondo okony e fwenyo yore mag chiwo pesa ne ji.

English: An analysis assessed police tactics used during mass demonstrations, focusing on proportionality, arrests, and rights-based policing.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi ulichunguza mbinu za polisi zilizotumiwa wakati wa maandamano ya umati, ukizingatia usawa, kukamatwa, na polisi wanaotegemea haki.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene igoro yabasikari nkworokia kore buna abasikari bakoererania ekerogo korobererekana, bagotumia chinguru koreng'ana nobonge bwabanto, nagoetera enchera yekemwanyabanto.
Somali: Falanqayn ayaa lagu qiimeeyay istiraatiijiyadaha booliska ee loo isticmaalo mudaaharaadyada dadweynaha, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo isdhexgalka, xadhiga, iyo booliska ku saleysan xuquuqda.
Dholuo: Nonro moro notemo nono yore ma polise ne tiyogo e kinde mar timo nonro e okang' malach, ka giketo pachgi ahinya kuom bedo gi paro mowinjore, tweyo ji, kod rito sirkal kaluwore gi ratiro ma jogo nigo.

English: Interior Cabinet Secretary reaffirms commitment to prosecuting acts that qualify as terrorism including destruction of property and threats to public services.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mambo ya Ndani anasisitiza tena kujitolea kwake kutekeleza vitendo vinavyohesabiwa kama ugaidi ikiwa ni pamoja na uharibifu wa mali na vitisho kwa huduma za umma.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ime oenekirie okwerwa gweserikari gosera na kogambia ebikorwa bigosegeta obokebago amo nogari chinibo na korenta obwoba ase obokoreri bwa'banto.
Somali: Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada Gudaha ayaa dib u xaqiijiyay ballanqaadka lagu qaaday in la dacweeyo falalka loo aqoonsan yahay argagixisada oo ay ku jiraan burburinta hantida iyo hanjabaadaha adeegyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Kabineti mar Piny owacho medo jiwo chiwruokne mar ng'ado bura ne timbe ma inyalo luong ni timbe mahundu moriwo nyaka ketho mwandu kod kelo pek ne tije mag sirkal.

English: Summary of UN counter terrorism strategies focusing on terrorism financing and international threat prevention.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa mikakati ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya kupambana na ugaidi inayozingatia ufadhili wa ugaidi na kuzuia vitisho vya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Okorora okweng'e nemeroberio yobomo bwa Boraya (UN) bwogokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gotanga baria bakoa ebibago chibesa gokora obokebago bwabo erio gotanga okogoswa korwa isiko.
Somali: Soo koobida istaraatijiyadaha la dagaalanka argagixisada ee Qaramada Midoobay oo diiradda saaraya maalgelinta argagixiso iyo ka hortagga hanjabaadaha caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Weche machuok e wi chenro mag UN mar kedo gi timbe mahundu motudore gi chiwo pesa ne jomahundu kod geng'o gik ma kelo luoro e pinje mamoko.

English: Download apps only from Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka Duka la Google Play au Duka la Programu la Apple pekee.
Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria gigokonya esimi gokora emeremo yaye goetera Google Play Store gose Apple App Store.
Somali: Ka soo dejiso barnaamijyada kaliya Google Play Store ama Apple App Store.
Dholuo: Gol app mana e Google Play Store kata Apple App Store.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre organized a five day workshop to contextualize a national manual on gender mainstreaming in counter terrorism.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kilifanya semina ya siku tano ili kuunganisha mwongozo wa kitaifa juu ya ujumuishaji wa kijinsia katika kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaroberetie ogasanga amo kwegera komanya egetabu gekworokia buna okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao nobomanyi bwabo erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada ayaa soo qabanqaabisay aqoon isweydaarsi shan maalmood ah si loo qaabeeyo buug-gacmeedka qaranka ee ku saabsan isdhexgalka jinsiga ee ka hortagga argagixisadda.
Dholuo: National Counter-Terrorism Centre ne ochano mondo otim chokruok mar ndalo abich mar loso buk moting'o weche e wi weche mag nindruok e lweny gi timbe mahundu.

English: Interior Ministry praises coordinated security actions.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani inapongeza hatua za usalama zilizoratibiwa.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoborendi bwa ime yatogiries emeroberio yokobwaterana ase oborendi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha waxay bogaadinaysaa tallaabooyinka amniga ee iswaafajinta.
Dholuo: Ministry of the Interior opwoyo chenro mar rito weche mag sirkal.

English: NCTC coordinates prevention, detection, and disruption through outreach and capacity building.
Kiswahili: NCTC inahariri kuzuia, kugundua, na kuvuruga kupitia ufikiaji na kujenga uwezo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete gokinana nobokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkoraa kere emeroberio komanya na gotanga obokebago goetera ogosoka isiko na gokwana nabanto buna enchera eyemo yogokong'ia obokoreri.
Somali: NCTC waxay isuduwiddaa ka hortagga, ogaanshaha, iyo jahwareerka iyada oo loo marayo gaarsiinta iyo kor u qaadista awoodaha.
Dholuo: NCTC chiko yore mag geng'o, fwenyo, kod ketho gik moko kokalo kuom lendo kod gero nyalo.

English: Reuters reported charges against activist Boniface Mwangi for alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition, raising concerns over politicized enforcement.
Kiswahili: Reuters iliripoti mashtaka dhidi ya mwanaharakati Boniface Mwangi kwa madai ya kuwa na gesi ya machozi na risasi, ikiongeza wasiwasi juu ya utekelezaji wa sera.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie igoro mamamocho nogosoerwa kwomoegereri Boniface Mwangi nga nabwate ebinto biria bigwateka biarusia erioki nechimbunde mamincha nerichiko, eri riaretire obwoba buna siasa yatumekire kobuna amachiko.
Somali: Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa soo sheegtay eedeymo lagu soo oogay dhaqdhaqaaq Boniface Mwangi oo lagu eedeeyay in uu haysto gaaska lacagaha iyo rasaasta, taasoo keentay in walaac laga qabo dhaqan-gelinta siyaasadeed.
Dholuo: Reuters ne onyiso ni ne odonjne aktivist Boniface Mwangi gi ketho mar bedo gi gas ma pi wang' piyo kod bunde, kendo mano ne omiyo ji obedo gi parruok e wi weche mag siasa.

English: United Nations facilitated regional training in Nairobi to strengthen gender responsive approaches in counter terrorism and preventing violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa uliwezesha mafunzo ya kikanda huko Nairobi ili kuimarisha mbinu za kukabiliana na ugaidi na kuzuia ukatili.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giense (UN) nkiaegeretie abarai bechingongo chia Nairobi erio gokwanera obokongu abanto bechingencho ao ao babwate ario gosegeta oboreng'ananu buna enchera eyemo yogotanga obokebago nogosarigwa ebirengererio.
Somali: Qaramada Midoobay waxay ku fududeysay tababarka gobolka ee Nairobi si loo xoojiyo hababka ka jawaab celinta jinsiga ee la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje ne otiyo gi tiegruok ma ne itimo Nairobi mondo okony e tieko timbe mahundu kendo geng'o timbe gero.

English: Actively participate in campaigns for safe, inclusive, and just community services.
Kiswahili: Shiriki kikamilifu katika kampeni za kutoa huduma salama, zinazojumuisha na za haki kwa jamii.
Ekegusii: Bwaterana kegima ase ogosegeta oboronge, oborendi na gokorera abanto bonsi bekenyoro buya.
Somali: Si firfircoon uga qaybqaato ololaha adeegyada bulshada ee ammaan ah, ka mid ah, oo caddaalad ah.
Dholuo: Riw lwedo gi kinda kampen mag konyo oganda mondo obed gi ngima maber, moriwo ji duto, kendo obed gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Families of a shooting victim demanded legal action; IPOA confirmed active investigation and emphasized supervisory accountability.
Kiswahili: Familia za waathirika wa risasi zilidai hatua za kisheria; IPOA ilithibitisha uchunguzi wa kazi na kusisitiza uwajibikaji wa usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Amamwabo baria barasetie amasasi nabasikari mbaboretie ng'a ebotambokero biamachiko bibogorigwe as abasikari; ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) nkiaenegetie obotuki obuya na koboria nga abateneneri babasikari babogorie amamocho ayio.
Somali: Qoysaska dhibbanaha toogashada ayaa dalbaday tallaabo sharci; IPOA waxay xaqiijisay baaritaan firfircoon waxayna xoojisay mas'uuliyadda kormeerka.
Dholuo: Jood ng'at ma ne onegi ne okwayo mondo okaw okang' e kot; IPOA ne onyiso ni ne gitimo nonro kendo ne gijiwo ni jorit ne nigi ratiro mar kawo okang'.

English: Assessment noting high terrorism threat levels in the United States from domestic and foreign violent extremists.
Kiswahili: Tathmini ikibainisha viwango vya juu vya vitisho vya ugaidi nchini Marekani kutoka kwa watu wenye msimamo mkali wa ndani na nje ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Okorenga kwa beene nkwaorogetie ase ebirengo bia igoro ng'a okonyarekana kwogoakwa chipomu aaria America korwa ebibago bia ime na korwa isiko.
Somali: Qiimeyn muujineysa heerarka ugu sarreeya ee khatarta argagixisada ee Maraykanka ee ka imanaya xagjirada rabshadaha ah ee gudaha iyo dibaddaba.
Dholuo: Nonro ma nyiso ni nitie pek mang'eny ma ji yudo nikech timbe mahundu e piny Amerka koda e pinje mamoko.

English: University of Nairobi research documents community policing implementation success and barriers in Kibera, Ruai and Ziwani areas
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi unataja mafanikio ya utekelezaji wa polisi wa jamii na vizuizi katika maeneo ya Kibera, Ruai na Ziwani
Ekegusii: Amanga arikire yamasomo yokorigia chisemi chinyia neyunifasity ya Nairobi nkworokia are oboikeranu bwabeene ase emeremo yabarendi boborendi bwenyoro amo nechando ereo ase ebinyoro bia Kibera, Ruai na Ziwani.
Somali: Cilmi-baarista Jaamacadda Nairobi ayaa dukumiintiyeysa guusha iyo caqabadaha ka jira hirgelinta ciidamada deegaanka ee Kibera, Ruai iyo Ziwani
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Yunivasiti mar Nairobi osenono dongruok mar tiyo gi chike mag sirkal e alwora mar Kibera, Ruai, kod Ziwani

English: Presents the national strategy for preventing and reversing radicalization.
Kiswahili: Kuwasilisha mkakati wa kitaifa wa kuzuia na kugeuza radikalization.
Ekegusii: Nkorwa kere omoroberio bwense gokongia abanto gwetanga gosoa obokebago namasomo agosaria obongo.
Somali: Waxay soo bandhigeysaa istiraatiijiyadda qaranka ee ka hortagga iyo ka noqoshada xagjirnimada.
Dholuo: Ochiwo paro e wi chenro mar piny mangima mar geng'o kendo tieko timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya, Indonesia, and the Netherlands held a joint knowledge sharing program to improve strategies for preventing and countering violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Kenya, Indonesia, na Uholanzi zilifanya mpango wa pamoja wa kugawana maarifa ili kuboresha mikakati ya kuzuia na kupambana na ukatili.
Ekegusii: Kenya, Indonesia, amo na Netherlands mbabete nogocha amo koererania oboinga'ini nechisemi gokong'ia emeroberio gotanga na korwania obokebago bwogosaria obongo.
Somali: Kenya, Indonesia, iyo Netherlands waxay qabteen barnaamij wadajir ah oo la wadaago aqoonta si loo hagaajiyo istaraatiijiyadaha ka hortagga iyo la dagaalanka xagjirnimada rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya, Indonesia, kod Netherlands notimo chenro mar pogo ng'eyo mopogore opogore mondo gitim dongruok e yore mag geng'o kod kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: The United Kingdom warns of high terrorism risk in Kenya, especially targeting UK interests.
Kiswahili: Uingereza yaonya kuhusu hatari kubwa ya ugaidi nchini Kenya, hasa ikilenga maslahi ya Uingereza.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Boraya (United Kingdom) bwarure ogokurera igoro yokonyarekana goakwa nebibago bwokoruta chipomu aiga nka Kenya, mono kegima birengete abanto bense yabo abwo bare iaga Kenya nebinto biabo.
Somali: Boqortooyada Midowday waxay ka digtay khatarta argagixisada sare ee Kenya, gaar ahaan inay bartilmaameedsato danaha UK.
Dholuo: Piny mar United Kingdom chiwo siem e wi gik manyalo timore e piny Kenya, to ahinya wuon gik makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e pinyno.

English: Update on United States Treasury sanctions targeting terrorism financing networks.
Kiswahili: Taarifa mpya kuhusu vikwazo vya Hazina ya Marekani vinavyolenga mitandao ya ufadhili wa ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Uamangana abwango korwa Ekegncha ekenene giesirikari ya America gosieka chibengi chiabanto gete na kobeka ebisusuro ase abamochi buna enchera eyemo yogatanga koa ebiombe biebibago chibesa.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta cunaqabateynta maaliyadeed ee Mareykanka ee lala beegsanayo shabakadaha maalgelinta argagixisada.
Dholuo: Weche manyien e wi sirkande mag pesa mag piny Amerka motudore gi riwruoge ma siro timbe mahundu.

English: ODPP introduced tech tools and plea deals to cut case backlogs.
Kiswahili: ODPP ilianzisha zana za kiteknolojia na mikataba ya madai ili kupunguza mrundikano wa kesi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi yomosoeri ebina (ODPP) yaansete egekoreri kigedichitarierio kwangoi gokora ebina ebinge korwa abwo magega.
Somali: ODPP waxay soo bandhigtay aaladaha tikniyoolajiyadeed iyo heshiisyada qandaraaska si loo yareeyo kiisaska ka dambeeya.
Dholuo: ODPP ne oketo chenro mar tiyo gi yore mag teknoloji kod yore mag ng'ado bura mondo gikony e tieko ywaruok.

English: Download apps only from official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Pakua programu kutoka kwa maduka rasmi kama vile Google Play au Apple App Store pekee.
Ekegusii: Nyora ebinto biria bigokonya esimi gose ekombiuta gokora emeremo korwa aase egenire buna Google Play gose Apple App Store.
Somali: Ka soo dejiso barnaamijyada kaliya dukaamada rasmiga ah sida Google Play ama Apple App Store.
Dholuo: Golo app mana e duka ma sirkal luongo ni Google Play kata Apple App Store.

English: Interior CS briefed Senate on national security readiness and coordinated agency efforts.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Mambo ya Ndani alielezea Seneti juu ya maandalizi ya usalama wa kitaifa na jitihada za shirika la uratibu.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ine namanyetie ekegambero gieseneti buna yeariganetie ase oborendi bwense na okobwaterana nebitengo ao ao.
Somali: CS gudaha ayaa ka warbixiyay Senate-ka diyaar garowga amniga qaranka iyo dadaallada ururka ee isuduwidda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar weche mag ot ne olero ne Senate weche motudore gi bedo moikore ne weche mag sirkal kendo ne oriwo lwedo chenro mag riwruokno.

English: NCTC conducted training for county officials on raising public awareness and preventing radicalization.
Kiswahili: NCTC ilifanya mafunzo kwa maafisa wa kaunti juu ya kuongeza ufahamu wa umma na kuzuia ukali.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiasometie abarai bechikaonti buna baramanyie abanto babo buna baranyare gotanga amasomo ogsaria abanto ebirengererio.
Somali: NCTC waxay tababar u sameysay saraakiisha degmada ee kor u qaadista wacyiga dadweynaha iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada.
Dholuo: NCTC ne otiyo gi tiegruok ne jotelo mag county e jiwo ji mondo ong'e kendo geng'o ji mondo kik gidonj e timbe mahundu.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre promotes the See Something Say Something campaign encouraging prompt reporting of suspicious activity.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kinaendeleza kampeni ya Angalia Kitu Sema Kitu na kuhamasisha kuripoti haraka shughuli za mashaka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngoseta kere ng'a kore omoroberio okorokwa "rora egento - teba gente gete" ogosegeta abanto komanyia abarai bwango amangana gose ebikoru biechitang'utang'u.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada waxay dhiirrigelisay ololaha Arko Wax Sheeg Waxyaabaha lagu dhiirigelinayo in si dhakhso leh loo soo wargeliyo waxqabadka shakiga leh.
Dholuo: National Counter-Terrorism Centre jiwo kampen mar Be Something Say Something mondo ojiw ji mondo ochiw ripot mapiyo e wi gik ma chando ji.

English: If you have farms, clearly label fertilizers and pesticides.
Kiswahili: Kama una mashamba, weka lebo wazi kwenye mbolea na dawa za kuua wadudu.
Ekegusii: Onye kobwate omogondo bwoboremi, orokereria buya obwoyo mborobi, n amariogo boigo.
Somali: Haddii aad leedahay beero, si cad u calaamadee bacriminta iyo sunta cayayaanka.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi puothe, ket tong' maler e wi yien kod yedhe mamero.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre helped develop social media monitoring systems to detect hate speech and radical ideologies while protecting freedom of expression.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupinga Ugaidi kilisaidia kuendeleza mifumo ya ufuatiliaji wa media ya kijamii ili kugundua hotuba za chuki na itikadi za kikatili wakati wa kulinda uhuru wa kujieleza.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiakonyete korosia chinchera abariki amangana baranyare komongera, koigwa na komanya amangana, chinkwana gose ebiorokererio biokogosereria, gochegia, gose gosegeta ogochaya abande egekogera eki bare, na chisemi chiogosaria ebirengererio ase okwebisa ime yerichiko riobosibore bwogokwana.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada ayaa gacan ka geysatay horumarinta nidaamyada kormeerka warbaahinta bulshada si loo ogaado hadalka nacaybka iyo fikirrada xagjirka ah iyadoo la ilaalinayo xorriyadda hadalka.
Dholuo: National Counter-Terrorism Centre nokonyo e loso chenro mar rito weche mitimo e social media mondo okony e fwenyo weche mag sigu kod paro maricho, kendo rito thuolo mar wacho weche.

English: Reuters reported the arrest of activist Mwangi over alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition during protests, widely condemned as political intimidation.
Kiswahili: Reuters iliripoti kukamatwa kwa mwanaharakati Mwangi kwa madai ya kumiliki gesi ya machozi na risasi wakati wa maandamano, ambayo yamelaaniwa sana kama vitisho vya kisiasa.
Ekegusii: Abamanyi amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie ense igoro yomoegereri Mwangi ase okomebekerera ng'a nabwate ebinto biria bikoraswa korwa erioki amo nechimbunde chingaki chikoroberekana, na kwanga okogoserigwa konga buna okwo kwegesiasa kwoboi abakoroberekana.
Somali: Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa soo sheegtay in la xiray dhaqdhaqaaqa Mwangi oo lagu eedeeyay inuu haysto gaaska lacagaha iyo rasaasta intii lagu jiray mudaaharaadyada, kuwaas oo si weyn loo cambaareeyay inay yihiin hanjabaad siyaasadeed.
Dholuo: Reuters ne onyiso ni ng'at moro miluongo ni Mwangi ne omak gi ketho mar bedo gi gas ma pi wang' piyo kod gige lweny e kinde mar gik ma ne otimorego, ma ji mang'eny ne okwedo ni gin gik makelo luoro e weche siasa.

English: Human Rights Watch released video analyses showing police use of live rounds, teargas, arbitrary arrests, and command-authorized force.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Human Rights Watch limetangaza uchambuzi wa video unaoonyesha matumizi ya polisi ya risasi halisi, gesi ya machozi, kukamatwa kwa hiari, na nguvu zilizoidhinishwa na amri.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekomongera oboronge bwa mwanyabanto nkiarwete esinema ekworokia buna abasikari bare korasa chimbunde, koruta ebinto biria bikorusia erioki, kobwata abanto bosaigo, negetengo kiabasikari inse yamachiko korwa abanene babo korasa chimbunde.
Somali: Hay'adda Human Rights Watch ayaa soo saartay falanqayn fiidiyoow ah oo muujineysa sida booliska ay u isticmaalaan rasaas dhab ah, gaaska indhaha, xadhiga ikhtiyaarka ah, iyo ciidamada amarka leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok miluongo ni Human Rights Watch ne ogolo vidio manyiso kaka polise notiyo gi bunde, pi wang' pi, mako ji e yo ma ok kare, koda tiyo gi teko mar loch.

English: Public guidance on basic cybersecurity practices to protect against online threats and promote digital safety.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa umma juu ya mazoea ya msingi ya usalama wa mtandao ili kulinda dhidi ya vitisho vya mtandaoni na kukuza usalama wa dijiti.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera ase abanto bonsi chinchera chinyororo chiokorenda esimi nekombiuta yao erio korenda ng'a esimi gose ekombiuta yao, amangana ao naye omonyene tibinyora nabako amabe yobosaria goetera eintaneti erio gosegeta oborendi goetera egedichitari.
Somali: Tilmaamaha dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dhaqanka aasaasiga ah ee amniga internetka si looga ilaaliyo hanjabaadaha internetka loona dhiirrigeliyo amniga dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Puonj ma ji chiwo e wi gik ma itimo motudore gi weche mag cybersecurity e rito ji kuom gik ma nyalo hinyo ji e Intanet kendo jiwo ritruok e yore mag digital.

English: Police in Malindi cutting juvenile crime through new initiatives.
Kiswahili: Polisi mjini Malindi wapunguza uhalifu wa vijana kupitia mipango mipya.
Ekegusii: Abasikari aaria Malindi babogoirie ebitambokero biogotanga obosari gati yabana goetra emeroberio emyia.
Somali: Booliska Malindi waxay yareeyaan dambiyada dhalinyarada iyada oo loo marayo dadaallo cusub.
Dholuo: Polise e taon mar Malindi tieko timbe mahundu e kind rowere kokalo kuom chenro manyien.

English: University of Nairobi case study of challenges in Cop implementation in Kibera
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kesi utafiti wa changamoto katika utekelezaji wa Cop katika Kibera
Ekegusii: Ayarorekanete goetera okomanya kweyunifasity ya Nairobi igoro yemechando ereo ase ogoikerania obokoreri bwabarendi boborendi (Cop) aaria Kibera.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nairobi daraasad kiis ah oo ku saabsan caqabadaha ka jira hirgelinta Cop ee Kibera
Dholuo: Puonjruok e wi pek ma ji romogo e tiyo gi polise e taon mar Kibera

English: Regional training of trainers workshop in Nairobi promoted gender sensitive counter terrorism policies across East Africa.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya kikanda ya walimu huko Nairobi yaliendeleza sera za kupambana na ugaidi zinazohusiana na jinsia kote Afrika Mashariki.
Ekegusii: Okwegerigwa kwa abarai bechingongo buan abegeria abande aaria Nairobi nosegetete engencho yokorenta amo abanto bechingencho chionsi buna enchera eyemo yokorwania gotanga koruta chipomu orgongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha engima (East Africa).
Somali: Tababarka gobolka ee aqoon isweydaarsiga tababarayaasha ee Nairobi ayaa kor u qaaday siyaasadaha ka hortagga argagixisada ee dhinaca jinsiga ah ee ku baahsan Bariga Afrika.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma ne itimo e alwora mar tiego jopuonj e taon mar Nairobi nojiwo chenro mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e pinje mag East Africa duto.

English: National rollout of the prison based CVE awareness program reached over thirty thousand officers through national and international partnerships.
Kiswahili: Uanzishwaji wa kitaifa wa mpango wa ufahamu wa CVE wa magereza ulifikia maafisa zaidi ya elfu thelathini kupitia ushirikiano wa taifa na kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene bwabasikari bechera noansete komanyia buna chinchera chiogotanga obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio oyio oikerete goetania abaofisa chilifu 30,000 goetera okobwaterana Kenya ase okobwaterana nense engima.
Somali: Hirgelinta Qaranka ee barnaamijka wacyigelinta CVE ee ku saleysan xabsiyada ayaa gaadhay in ka badan soddon kun oo sarkaal ah iyada oo loo marayo iskaashiyada qaranka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Chenro mar keto pach ji kuom weche mag CVE ma ne itimo e jela ne ochopo ne jotich mokalo gana piero adek kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda Jehova e piny mangima koda e pinje mamoko.

English: KNCHR highlighted activism as a tool to expose corruption and demand accountability.
Kiswahili: KNCHR ilisisitiza harakati kama chombo cha kufichua ufisadi na kudai uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorigereria oboronge bwa mwanyabanto (KNCHR) yaorokire buna obosemia nogosuguma buna egekoreri ekenene goasioria obokorekanu na gosaba ng'a obotenereri obuya bwobokoreri.
Somali: KNCHR waxay tilmaantay dhaqdhaqaaqa inay tahay qalab lagu soo bandhigo musuqmaasuqa waxayna dalbanaysaa xisaabtanka.
Dholuo: KNCHR nojiwo timbe mag wuondruok kaka yo mar fwenyo mibadhi kendo dwaro ni ji ochiw paro.

English: Technology supports gender-based violence prevention through safety apps and digital tools that offer emergency contacts and discreet help-seeking features.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia inasaidia kuzuia vurugu za kijinsia kupitia programu za usalama na zana za dijiti ambazo hutoa mawasiliano ya dharura na huduma za kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Etekinorochi ngokonya ere gotanga ogokorerwa bobe ekiagera eki ore goetera ebikoreri bioborendi bwaya amo negedichitari konyora chinamba chiesimi korigia ogokonya otari kwemanyekania.
Somali: Teknolojiyaddu waxay taageertaa ka hortagga rabshadaha ku saleysan jinsiga iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijyada amniga iyo aaladaha dhijitaalka ah ee bixiya xiriirada degdegga ah iyo astaamaha caawimaad raadinta ee qarsoodiga ah.
Dholuo: Tekinoloji konyo e geng'o timbe mahundu kaluwore gi dichwo gi dhako kokalo kuom app mag ritruok kod gige tigo mag digital ma chiwo tudruok mag ywaruok kod yore mag manyo kony.

English: Nakuru County officials led a public forum at Elementaita station engaging local CPC members and community representatives to strengthen COP partnerships
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa Kaunti ya Nakuru waliongoza mkutano wa umma kwenye kituo cha Elementaita ambapo washiriki wa CPC na wawakilishi wa jumuiya walihusika kuimarisha ushirikiano wa COP
Ekegusii: Abarai bekaonti ya Nakuru mbabete nomoroberio obonsi aaria esiteseni ya Elementaita gokwanerana nechikomiti chia abarendi boborendi (CPC) nabateneneri bebinyoro gokong'ia obokoreri bwabarendi boborendi (COP)ase okobwaterana.
Somali: Saraakiisha gobolka Nakuru ayaa shirweyne dadweyne ah ku qabtay saldhiga Elementaita oo ay ku hawlan yihiin xubnaha CPC ee deegaanka iyo wakiilada bulshada si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga COP
Dholuo: Jotelo mag Kaunti mar Nakuru ne otelo ne chokruok mar ji duto e stesen mar Elementaita ma ne oriwo jokanyo mag CPC kod jowuoth mondo omed jiwo winjruok e kindgi gi COP

English: Mining Department and NCTC jointly trained stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to mitigate terror risks.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Uchimbaji na NCTC kwa pamoja waliwazoeza washirika juu ya usindikaji salama wa viboreshaji vya kibiashara ili kupunguza hatari za ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Eminisiti yokorema amadini na keombe keria getenenerete gotanga na korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ase oboama baegeirie abasangi buna babwenerete kogacha, kobirenda kobibogoria na kobitumia buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosaganwa korwa isiko.
Somali: Waaxda Macdanta iyo NCTC waxay si wadajir ah u tababareen daneeyayaasha ku saabsan maaraynta amaanka ah ee walxaha qarxa ee ganacsiga si loo yareeyo halista argagixisada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbni kod NCTC ne otiego jokanyo mag mibadhi e wi tiyo gi gik makelo hinyruok e yore mag ohelni mondo gikony e geng'o gik manyalo kelo luoro ji.

English: Video report on Special Operations Group activities countering terror threats in high risk border areas.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya video juu ya shughuli za Kikundi cha Operesheni Maalum katika kukabiliana na vitisho vya kigaidi katika maeneo ya mpaka yenye hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Esinema yaorogeti buna ebi egekundi kiabasikari kiabeene kiegeirie buya kegima erio gosagana obwoba bwokutita chipomu aase aria yechimbe chia Kenya aregire nogoakwa chipomu.
Somali: Warbixinta fiidiyowga ah ee ku saabsan howlaha Kooxda howlgalada gaarka ah ee la dagaalanka hanjabaadaha argagixisada ee aagagga xuduudda ee khatarta sare leh.
Dholuo: Ripot mar vidio e wi gik ma Special Operations Group timo e kedo gi gik ma kelo luoro e alwora mag tong' ma nigi chandruok maduong'.

English: United Nations factsheet guiding civic groups on protecting human rights during counter terrorism work.
Kiswahili: Karatasi ya habari ya Umoja wa Mataifa inayoongoza vikundi vya wananchi juu ya kulinda haki za binadamu wakati wa kazi ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Egetabu kiobomo bwechinse chiria chikwegambera (UN) igoro yokorenda oboronge bwamwanyabanto chingaki chiogokinana nobokebago bwokoruta hipomu.
Somali: Warqadda macluumaadka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee hagida kooxaha rayidka ah ee ku saabsan ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha inta lagu jiro shaqada la dagaalanka argagixisada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje oting'o weche ma tayo riwruoge mag sirkal e rito ratiro mag dhano e kinde mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: "CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only."
Kiswahili: "CBK inafahamu kuhusu programu za simu zinazotoza ada za 'kibali cha CRB' mapema. Maombi ya CRB yanashughulikiwa kupitia ofisi zenye leseni pekee."
Ekegusii: "Ebengi enene ya Kenya (CBK ) nemanyete ebikoreri biechisimi apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. Ogosaba gochia baria batenenerete ogosaria kwobogoko (CRB) nigo kogokorwa nabanto bancheire gokora egasi eyio boka"
Somali: "CBK waxay ogtahay in barnaamijyada mobilada ay horay u qaadaan khidmadaha 'CRB clearance'. Codsiyada CRB waxaa lagu baaraandegaa oo keliya xafiisyada ruqsadda leh".
Dholuo: "CBK ong'eyo ni gikelo pesa mag 'CRB clearance' e yore mag simo. kwayo mag CRB itimo mana kokalo kuom ofise ma nigi ratiro. "

English: "Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms."
Kiswahili: "Walaghai wanaojifanya waangalizi wa uchaguzi wamekuwa wakiomba pesa kutoka kwa wagombea kwa ajili ya kibali bandia. IEBC haitozi ada kwa fomu za kibali."
Ekegusii: "Abangainereria bagwekora buna abarigereria buna chikura chigoakwa babeire bagosangereria chibesa korwa ase baria bakorigia chikura kobarusia korwa erkodi yogokora bobe. Ekeombe keria gietenenerete buna chikura chiogoakwa (IEBC) nkeri gosaba chibesa erio korigereria gose nore namamocho aragotange toboria goakerwa chikura."
Somali: "Xadgudbayaasha isu dhigaya inay yihiin daawadayaasha doorashooyinka ayaa lacag ka codsanaya musharixiinta si ay u helaan oggolaansho been abuur ah. IEBC ma qaadato lacag foomka oggolaanshaha".
Dholuo: "Joma wuondore ni gin jorit mag yiero oseyudo pesa kuom jogo madwaro yudo rusa mar wuondruok.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre and the EU expanded campaigns to mobilize Kenyans against violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi na EU zilipanua kampeni za kuwahamasisha Wakenya dhidi ya ukaidi wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) amo nobomo bwa'Bongeresa (EU)mbagareetie chinkwana chiabo ase ogosegeta abanto ba Kenya korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa ballaarisay ololaha lagu soo uruurinayo dadka Kenya ka dhanka ah xagjirnimada rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Counter Terrorism Centre kod EU ne oloso kampen mar choko Jo-Kenya e lweny gi timbe mahundu.

English: UNODC and Kenya partnership to enhance legal frameworks and build investigative capacity against terrorism.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa UNODC na Kenya ili kuimarisha mifumo ya kisheria na kujenga uwezo wa uchunguzi dhidi ya ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobomo bwechinse chiria chikwegambera korwania amariogo agotindia (UNODC) goetera okobwaterana na Kenya mbabwateranete goikerania amachiko yokorwania obokebago na gokinia chinguru chiobotuki bwobokebago bwokoruta chipomu.
Somali: Xiriirka UNODC iyo Kenya si loo xoojiyo qaab dhismeedka sharciga iyo in la dhiso awoodda baaritaanka ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar UNODC kod Kenya mondo omed jiwo chike mag sirkal kod gero teko mar timo nonro e lweny gi timbe mahundu.

English: A terror cell in Lamu was dismantled and suspects arrested in a joint security operation.
Kiswahili: Kikosi cha ugaidi huko Lamu kilivunjwa na washukiwa walikamatwa katika operesheni ya pamoja ya usalama.
Ekegusii: Eseri ase ebibago biechipomu bibekire aaria Lamu yabunetwe na abakagerwa mbabwatetwe goetera ebitengo ao ao bieserikari.
Somali: Unug argagixiso ah oo ku yaal Lamu ayaa la burburiyay waxaana la xiray dadka loo maleynayo inay ka qayb qaateen howlgal amni oo wadajir ah.
Dholuo: Ne oketh sel moro mar jo mahundu e taon mar Lamu, kendo ne omak joma itemo wacho ni ne gin joma riwo lwedo weche mag sirkal.

English: "We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud."
Kiswahili: "Tunawahimiza Wakenya kuangalia upya uhalali wa shirika lolote lisilo la kiserikali linaloomba michango kupitia malipo ya simu. Mengi yametajwa kwa ulaghai."
Ekegusii: "Nigo togosaba abakenya koirorera gocheki oboamaene bwebiombe bia NGO dchigosaba ogokonya goetera entaneti. Chinyinge chiechio chianyorirwe koba echioboibi"
Somali: "Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dadka reer Kenya inay dib u hubiyaan sharci ahaanshaha hay'adaha aan dawliga ahayn ee ku dalbanaya deeq bixin iyada oo loo marayo lacag bixinta mobilada. Qaar badan ayaa lagu calaamadeeyay khiyaamo".
Dholuo: "Wajwayo Jo-Kenya mondo onon ratiro mar riwruok moro amora mar NGO ma kwayo chiwo kokalo kuom pesa mitimo e yor simo.
